Welcome to File Navigator - Your Ultimate File Sorting Solution!

fdroid:com.deva.knot.name: Knot
fdroid:com.deva.knot.summary: Minimal memo/note app with only one note possible.
fdroid:com.deva.knot.description:
Minimal, memo/note app without option, distraction free, no ads, no tracker, FOSS, only one note possible, simple and fast so every idea can be saved easily with a dark and light mode following the system theme. 
About the concept and name:
An antiquated form of memory aid. The basic idea is that you tie a knot in the corner of your handkerchief the night before you have to perform some task. When you go to blow your nose or wipe your face or perform any of the other actions associated with a handkerchief you will see the knot and remember your duty.
Problems arise, however, when it comes to recalling precisely what it is you are supposed to remember. Also, with the rise of the paper tissue, and the decline of the handkerchief, this practice has fallen out of use. Nowadays it is far easier to use a memo app on your mobile phone.

fdroid:com.gero.newpass.name: NewPass
fdroid:com.gero.newpass.summary: Securely store and manage passwords of your digital realm with NewPass.
fdroid:com.gero.newpass.description:
NewPass is a secure password management application designed to generate and store strong passwords locally on your device. With NewPass, you can create highly secure passwords for your accounts and services without the need to remember them.
 Key Features: 
 Password Generation: NewPass provides a robust password generator that allows you to create complex and secure passwords tailored to your specific requirements. You can customize the length and the character set (Uppercase, Numbers and Special).
 Local Storage: Your passwords are stored locally on your device, ensuring complete privacy and control over your data. NewPass does not store any passwords on external servers, minimizing the risk of unauthorized access (If you uninstall the app, your password are lost!).
 AES Encryption: NewPass encrypts all stored passwords using Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) with Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode before saving them in the local database.
 SQLite Chiper: NewPass utilizes SQLCipher, an extension for SQLite databases, to bolster security further by encrypting entirely the database, ensuring robust protection against unauthorized access. The encryption key is chosen by the user upon the first launch of the app, and it remains saved and encrypted in an EncryptedSharedPreferences. It is then requested every time the app is launched.
 User-Friendly Interface: NewPass features an intuitive and user-friendly interface, making it easy to generate, view, and manage your passwords. The app offers convenient options for copying passwords to the clipboard and securely sharing them with other applications.

fdroid:com.mremiyum.ridmapp.name: Ridm
fdroid:com.mremiyum.ridmapp.summary: Ridm is a powerful, open-source media download manager supporting 9 languages
fdroid:com.mremiyum.ridmapp.description:
Raid - inspect - download - manage 
 Ridm is a powerful, open-source media download manager supporting 9 languages. Besides being a basic download manager, it can download media from platforms like YouTube and Instagram individually or in bulk. It uses the power of the yt-dlp engine in the background.
 🌟 Features
 Multi-Language Support: Full support for English, Turkish, Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Bengali, and Russian. (The app starts in English by default for universal use; the language can be changed instantly in settings).
 Basic Usage and Integration: You can add up to 10 links simultaneously, separated by pressing the Enter key. If you tap "Share" on any video in the YouTube app (or others) and select Ridm, the link is automatically analyzed and ready for download.
 Smart Folders: When enabled, downloads are automatically sorted into subfolders based on media type (Video, Audio, etc.).
 Advanced Format Selection: Selecting "Best Quality" in format options for Playlist and Channel downloads fetches the highest resolution and quality videos from the source server. If 2160p (4K) or 1080p is selected and that resolution is unavailable, it skips that file and moves to the next.
 Audio and Subtitle Support: MP3, M4A, and Opus formats only download audio files. If you want to download an audio file with embedded subtitles, you can choose the MP3 or M4A format.
 Bulk Subtitle Preference: The 'Subtitle Preference Order' in the Settings menu saves you from the hassle of selecting subtitles for each video individually during bulk downloads. If you enable "Auto Sort", the system checks your 3 specified languages in order and automatically embeds the first one it finds.
 ⚠️ Important Warnings
 Battery Restrictions: To ensure the download process continues uninterrupted in the background, the app's battery usage must be set to "Unrestricted" in Android power options.
 Download Location: Upon first launch, you are required to select a download folder from the Settings menu.
 🍪 Cookies / Authentication
 To download content from Instagram or age-restricted YouTube videos, you need to connect your account to the app:
 Install a "cookies.txt" extension from the extension store (Chrome, Firefox, etc.) on your desktop browser or mobile device.
 Log in to YouTube or Instagram from your browser.
 Click the extension icon and use the Download option to save the cookies.txt file to any location on your mobile device.
 Go to App Settings, click the "Select cookies.txt" button, and link this file to the app.
 ☕ Support and Contact
 Ridm is completely free and open-source. You can contact us via email (mremiyum@proton.me) to report bugs, contribute to the development process, or support the project.

fdroid:com.neatcode.tabgreater.name: TabGreater
fdroid:com.neatcode.tabgreater.summary: Track spot pairs, perpetuals and events with charts and home-screen widgets
fdroid:com.neatcode.tabgreater.description:
Track spot pairs, perpetual contracts and event outcomes on Android. Build watchlists across six exchanges, open charts and put the markets you follow on your home screen. Your phone gets prices directly from each exchange. No account, ads or tracking.
 Watchlists 
* Several named lists, each with its own layout: four tile sizes, two per row (Small, Compact) or full width (Medium, Large)
* A sparkline on every tile over 1 hour, 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days
* Five sort orders — Custom, Exchange + Pair, Pair + Exchange, Price, Change; drag to reorder, long-press to colour, move or delete a tile
* Export and import every list as a JSON file, so a new phone is one file away
 Live prices 
* While the app is open, Binance, Gate.io, Hyperliquid, Kraken and KuCoin use live streams. MEXC prices refresh over REST.
* Saved watchlist prices and mini-chart history remain available when present on the device; Cached, Old and History labels distinguish unconfirmed prices, stale prices and unverified history
* Refresh failures have a Retry action; full charts need a successful data request for the selected pair and interval
* Prices in en-US formatting, with signed percentages and "shrink zeros" for sub-cent pairs (0.0₄123)
 Charts 
* Candlestick, hollow candle, OHLC bar and area styles
* Timeframes from 1 minute to 1 month, panning back through history on most exchanges (Kraken's public API only returns its newest ~720 bars)
* 11 indicators: MA, EMA, BOLL, SAR, VOL, MACD, RSI, KDJ, CCI, DMI, OBV
* Logarithmic or automatic scale, a fullscreen mode, and sharing the chart as a PNG
* 30 drawing tools: trend lines, rays, horizontal and vertical lines, channels, Fibonacci retracement / extension / fans, Gann box, shapes, brush, wave patterns, text and tags — with a magnet that snaps to candle prices; drawings are kept per market
 Home-screen widgets 
* Resizable home-screen widgets, one pair per widget
* The sparkline is a switch, on by default, and always shows the last 24 hours
* A refresh cadence of your choice, from timed updates to a live connection
* Android may show a system notification while the foreground service keeps widgets updated; TabGreater does not request notification permission or send price alerts
 Find a market 
* Search by name, symbol or event. Filter by instrument type and source, then scroll for more results.
* Find tokenized shares by their listed symbol. Their prices come from trading on the exchange.
* Follow Hyperliquid outcomes by side. For supported daily price events, a saved card rolls to the next confirmed contract when you open your watchlists.
 Exchanges 
Spot markets from Binance, Gate.io, Hyperliquid, Kraken, KuCoin and MEXC, plus Hyperliquid perpetual contracts and event outcomes. Exchange names are trademarks of their respective owners. TabGreater is independent of the exchanges.
 Privacy 
TabGreater has no backend, analytics or advertising. Prices come straight from each exchange's public API, so your IP address and requested pairs are visible to those exchanges. The add-pair screen can request CoinGecko's public ranking at most once a day for popular-pair suggestions; it falls back to saved or built-in suggestions. Lists, settings and drawings stay on your device and can be included in Android backup. Exporting or sharing sends only what you choose through the destination app.
 Disclaimer 
Prices are indicative and may be delayed, incomplete or wrong. TabGreater executes no trades, holds no API keys and is not financial advice. Use it at your own risk.
Android 8.0 or newer. Free and open source.

fdroid:com.zarathustra.mnemosyne.name: Mnemosyne
fdroid:com.zarathustra.mnemosyne.summary: A memorization app designed for lists as opposed to traditional flashcards
fdroid:com.zarathustra.mnemosyne.description:
Mnemosyne, named for the Greek goddess of memory, is an app designed to aid one in remembering lists of related information.
This particular memorization scenario is underserved by more traditional flashcard/memorization apps such as Anki.
For example, if one is learning German, one would eventually have to memorize a list of around 50 verbs that are the so called "dative verbs".
One could try to make a really big singular flashcard, or attempt something like cloze deletion, but these are very clunky methods.
With Mnemosyne, one can simply enter the list items one at a time and get feedback on which ones were missed.
One could then focus on just those items that are commonly missed or continue trying to get a perfect score on the original list.
For convenience one can import a csv file into the app to create lists, or just create them manually.
The csv must have a header row with the columns "Title" and "Items".
Separate each item in the items column by the separate delimiter "#@!".
Within a csv file, can specify multiple lists, one in each row. One can also export lists to save elsewhere.
There is a feature that allows for placing related lists together in a collapsible group.
One can nest these groups to near arbitrary depth. One creates a group by prefixing the group title to the list title, followed by "::".
For example, to create a grouping of German lists, where one wants a list of nouns and a list of verbs, one would name the two lists German::Nouns and German::Verbs.

fdroid:io.github.nikitasud.latentjam.kmp.name: LatentJam
fdroid:io.github.nikitasud.latentjam.kmp.summary: Local music player with an on-device recommender. No account, no network.
fdroid:io.github.nikitasud.latentjam.kmp.description:
LatentJam is a music player for the files on your phone that understands what your library sounds like. A small neural model runs on the device and listens to your tracks in the background, so SMART mode can queue the next song from your own collection. There is no account, no catalogue and no network permission: nothing about your listening leaves the phone.
 SMART queue : the next track picked from your library by sound, by its tags and by what a compact offline pack knows about 350,000 artists — their language, era and style. The queue avoids big jumps in energy.
 For You : rows for this time of day, the phase you are in, one wildcard, and a sonic journey across the library.
 Search that ranks like you expect : title, artist, album and genre first, then the lyrics in your files, then meaning, in any of twenty languages. A year or decade in the query ("80s", "1985") keeps results to those years.
 A map of your library : clusters are your genres as the model hears them.
 A player built for touch : the cover flips to the track's facts, holds for actions and swipes between tracks; a live seek bar with fine scrubbing and the lyric line under the handle; pause and resume fade instead of cutting.
 Lyrics : timed lyrics follow the song, and a tap on a line seeks there.
 Every tag the file carries : all genres, credited artists and the original release year, read from FLAC, Opus and mp3. Albums play in disc and track order, and a collaboration is listed under every artist it names.
 A real player underneath : playlists with M3U import and export and independent custom and recently added track orders, album, artist, genre and folder browsing behind an A–Z rail, with folders also as a tree, crossfade and volume normalization, a duplicate finder that says which copy to keep, statistics, tag editing, local backup and restore.
 On the home screen and in the car : three widgets, a Quick Settings tile and an Android Auto browse tree.
 Your pages, your order : show, hide and reorder the browsing pages, and choose the one it opens on.
 18 languages , including Russian, Romanian, Arabic, Hebrew, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
SMART gets good once a chunk of your library has been analysed in the background; leaving the phone charging overnight speeds that up.

• French first, fully translated into English.
Everything else

• Scan a card with the camera, pick a screenshot, or type the number.
• Import your cards from a Wallet pass or a PDF.
• QR, EAN, UPC, Code 128/39/93, Codabar, ITF, Aztec, Data Matrix and PDF417.

• Photos of the front and back of your cards.

• Groups, a widget and shortcuts to open a card in one tap.
• Backups in Catima's format, optionally encrypted (AES-256): move to or from Catima at any time.
• Optional lock with fingerprint, face or screen lock.
Free software (GPL-3.0-or-later). No ads, no tracking, no account.

fdroid:net.basov.lws.fdroid.name: lWS
fdroid:net.basov.lws.fdroid.description:
It is ... 
* ... a Web Server for static content.
* ... lightweight. APK size less then 100 Kb.
* ... as simple as possible. Only essential features implemented.
* ... open. Source code released under GPL-3.0.
* ... a personal solution. It is not optimized/tested for many parallel connections and large file transfer.
* ... network state responsive. Requires Wi-Fi connected or tethering enabled. Service will stop automatically if network is disconnected.
 Based on 
This application continues the development of
 Webserver for Android .
 What is configurable 
* Document root. Path may be entered as text or optionally selected using https://f-droid.org/packages/org.openintents.filemanager. If it is not installed it will offered for install.
* Port. May be between 1024 and 65535. Default is 8080
Any wrong values in parameters will automatically be set back to their defaults.
 Document root 
Document root by default is set to application private directory, example index
file automatically created. It is a safe configuration. You can place your pages
in this directory. But be careful! If you use Android 5.0 or above and uninstall
the application this directory and its content will be removed.
 Security warning 
You can change document root to any readable path on file system, but you need
to understand what are you doing. __Be careful: you could (suddenly?) create the
configuration so than anyone on the same Wi-Fi network could access the data on
your device whether you like it or not.__ All files from document root and below
are available for reading without any restrictions to anyone who's connected to
the network and knows the URL of the server.
 "Send", "QR code" and "Browser" 
After server starts you can press:
* "Browser" button for check server operation in your local browser
* "QR code" to call https://f-droid.org/packages/net.basov.lws.qr.fdroid or https://f-droid.org/packages/com.google.zxing.client.android to share URL by QR code. If no app is installed it offers to install lWS QR plugin
* "Send" to share the working server URL to another device via Bluetooth, Android Beam, E-Mail and any other way available on your device.
 On screen log 
The application has no permanent logging. This was treated this as redundant
functionality. The app tries to have the notification up to date. The on screen
log works only when the application is visible. Log screen may be cleared after
returning from background.

fedora-packages:arptables/arptables-lega.description: The arptables is a user space tool used to set up and maintain the tables of ARP rules in the Linux kernel. These rules inspect the ARP frames which they see. arptables is analogous to the iptables user space tool, but is less complicated. Note that it is considered legacy upstream since nftables provides the same functionality in a much newer code-base. fedora-packages:dispenso/dispenso-devel.name: dispenso-devel
fedora-packages:dispenso/dispenso-devel.description: Dispenso is a library for working with sets of tasks in parallel. It provides mechanisms for thread pools, task sets, parallel for loops, futures, pipelines, and more. Dispenso is a well-tested C++14 library designed to have minimal dependencies (some dependencies are required for the tests and benchmarks), and designed to be clean with compiler sanitizers (ASAN, TSAN). Dispenso is currently being used in dozens of projects and hundreds of C++ files at Meta (formerly Facebook). Dispenso also aims to avoid major disruption at every release. Releases will be made such that major versions are created when a backward incompatibility is introduced, and minor versions are created when substantial features have been added or bugs have been fixed, and the aim would be to only very rarely bump major versions. That should make the project suitable for use from main branch, or if you need a harder requirement, you can base code on a specific version. The dispenso-devel package contains libraries and header files for developing applications that use dispenso.

fedora-packages:enca/enca.description: Enca is an Extremely Naive Charset Analyser. It detects character set and encoding of text files and can also convert them to other encodings using either a built-in converter or external libraries and tools like libiconv, librecode, or cstocs. Currently, it has support for Belarussian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Czech, Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Polish, Russian, Slovak, Slovene, Ukrainian, Chinese and some multibyte encodings (mostly variants of Unicode) independent on the language. This package also contains shared Enca library other programs can make use of. Install enca if you need to cope with text files of dubious origin and unknown encoding and convert them to some reasonable encoding.

fedora-packages:flare/flare.description: Flare (Free Libre Action Roleplaying Engine) is a simple game engine built to handle a very specific kind of game: single-player 2D action RPGs. Flare is not a re-implementation of an existing game or engine. It is a tribute to and exploration of the action RPG genre. Rather than building a very abstract, robust game engine, the goal of this project is to build several real games and harvest an engine from the common, reusable code. The first game, in progress, is a fantasy dungeon crawl. Flare uses simple file formats (INI style configuration files) for most of the game data, allowing anyone to easily modify game contents. fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.name: flexmark-java-ext-gfm-strikethrough

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension that converts GitHub Flavored Markdown strikethrough syntax (~~) to HTML.

fedora-packages:libffi/libffi.name: libffi
fedora-packages:libffi/libffi.summary: A portable foreign function interface library
fedora-packages:libffi/libffi.description: Compilers for high level languages generate code that follow certain conventions. These conventions are necessary, in part, for separate compilation to work. One such convention is the "calling convention". The calling convention is a set of assumptions made by the compiler about where function arguments will be found on entry to a function. A calling convention also specifies where the return value for a function is found. Some programs may not know at the time of compilation what arguments are to be passed to a function. For instance, an interpreter may be told at run-time about the number and types of arguments used to call a given function. `Libffi' can be used in such programs to provide a bridge from the interpreter program to compiled code. The `libffi' library provides a portable, high level programming interface to various calling conventions. This allows a programmer to call any function specified by a call interface description at run time. FFI stands for Foreign Function Interface. A foreign function interface is the popular name for the interface that allows code written in one language to call code written in another language. The `libffi' library really only provides the lowest, machine dependent layer of a fully featured foreign function interface. A layer must exist above `libffi' that handles type conversions for values passed between the two languages.

firefox-addons:3117850.name: Arttron DevTools — Offline Developer Utilities
firefox-addons:3117850.summary: Offline JWT, Base64, URL, UUID, hash, color, regex and cron tools. Optional DNS, TLS, IP and HTTP checks with your own API key.
firefox-addons:3117850.description:
Arttron DevTools is a small, fast toolbox for developers. Eight utilities run entirely in your browser — the input you type never leaves your device. Four optional network diagnostics can check the site you are on, but only when you press a button, and only with your own arttron.dev API key.
WHAT IT DOES
• Opens from the toolbar popup, or as a full page in its own tab.
• All eight local tools work offline and need no account.
• Three context-menu actions work on text you select in a web page (browser-internal pages such as chrome:// cannot host extension menus).
• An optional Network group adds DNS, TLS, IP and HTTP checks for the current tab's host.
LOCAL TOOLS — NO NETWORK
• JWT decoder — splits a token into header and payload, pretty-prints the JSON and shows iat/exp. Decoding only: the signature is displayed but never verified, and the panel says so ("the signature is NOT verified").
• Base64 — encode or decode, with the standard or URL-safe alphabet.
• URL inspector — breaks an address into protocol, host, hostname, port, path and fragment, and lists every query parameter in order with duplicates preserved. A missing scheme is treated as https.
• UUID — generates v4 (random) and v7 (time-ordered) UUIDs.
• Hash — MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 digests. Digests only: HMAC and bcrypt stay on the website.
• Color — converts between HEX, RGB and HSL, shows a swatch, and reports the WCAG contrast ratio against white and black.
• Regex tester — pattern, flags and test text with live matches and capture groups, run in a background worker with a 2-second limit, so a pathological pattern reports a timeout instead of freezing the page.
• Cron explainer — explains every field of a cron expression and lists the next run times.
CONTEXT MENU
Select text on a page, then right-click:
• Decode JWT
• Decode Base64
• Hash selection (SHA-256 preselected)
The selection is handed to the tool page once and deleted after use. It is never sent anywhere and never written to disk.
NETWORK TOOLS — OPT-IN
DNS, TLS, IP location and HTTP check sit in a separate "Network" group. Each panel shows the current tab's host. Opening a panel sends nothing, and switching pages sends nothing — every check is a button press.
• DNS — A records for the tab's hostname, with AAAA as fallback.
• TLS certificate — certificate details and validity for the hostname and port.
• IP location — geolocation of the address the DNS lookup resolved; never your own IP.
• HTTP check — status, headers and redirects for the origin root ( https://host/ ), with path, query and credentials stripped, sent as a HEAD request.
To use them you need your own REST API key, created at https://arttron.dev/en/dashboard (choose Key type: API). The key is stored only in this browser profile, shown masked afterwards, and can be removed at any time. Access to arttron.dev is an optional permission requested from the panel's own button; decline it and all eight local tools keep working.
What leaves the browser: the current tab's hostname, the resolved IP address, or the origin-root URL, plus your API key in the Authorization header — sent to arttron.dev only, and only when you press a check button. No page content, form data, cookies, JWT input or hash input is transmitted. The extension contains no analytics and no tracking.
PRIVACY
Nothing is collected on install and no account is required for the local tools. Local input is processed in the browser and never saved. Selections are kept in browser session storage for about a minute and deleted after one use. The API key lives in local extension storage on your device and is sent only in the request header. The only origin the extension can reach is arttron.dev, enforced by the packaged Content Security Policy.
LINKS
Homepage: https://arttron.dev 
Support: https://github.com/Arttron/aigentron/issues 
Privacy: https://arttron.dev/en/privacy

bluejetty:00089406:ios.description:
Bucket is an app that allows you to track, organize, and share your bucket list with friends. The best checklist you could ever wish for!
Here's how it works:
• Create, share, and organize your bucket list, which can include anything you want to do.
• See what your friends and the Bucket community are adding to their bucket lists on the home feed.
• Explore new bucket list goals by searching and getting inspired on the explore page.
• Share your completed bucket list items by posting a storybook that includes photos, videos, text, and prompts.
• Find out what goals you have in common with friends or strangers.
That's what you can do on the app, but why did we make it?
• We believe that bucket lists are a shared experience, and that life is a miracle.
• We are literally floating in space on a giant rock.
• There are an infinite number of things on this rock to try, taste, experience, learn, and see.
• We celebrate trying to do it all!
So, what do you want to do?
Hit the download button and find out!

Defend Earth against Marvel's legendary threats by building teams of Marvel characters from every corner of the multiverse like Mister Fantastic, Loki, Venom, Spider-Man, Captain America, Iron Man, and more. Inject hero blood into your veins by dominating the competition in a slew of game modes ranging from Alliance team-ups to single player rumbles. ASSEMBLE YOUR SQUAD
Form a RPG squad of powerful MARVEL Super Heroes and Super Villains in a fight to save the universe. Mix and match characters from all corners of the multiverse for an experience unlike other single player games.

Outfit and upgrade your Marvel Super Heroes and Super Villains to become stronger than ever before. Strengthen characters for specific single player game modes or to dominate across every battle.

Who you bring to the fight matters in this super hero game. Pair up specific heroes and villains in squads to form synergies and take out enemies. Utilize RPG fight tactics during 5v5 battles to vanquish the greatest villains of the Marvel Universe.
EPIC COMBAT
Experience groundbreaking RPG gameplay cinematics in this super hero game as your squads unleash dynamic chain combos with a single tap.
STUNNING VISUALS
Play through a visually stunning mobile game experience leading your favorite Marvel characters in this super hero game. The world of Marvel has never looked so good in a single player game!

bluejetty:00146396:ios.description:
PlantPal is a plant care journal with watering reminders, made for houseplant lovers by one indie developer. Track every plant you own, get reminded when it’s time to water or feed, and keep a photo diary of how each one grows.
Now with Apple Intelligence on iOS 27, PlantPal can identify a plant from a photo and look it up in the Plant Library. You can also ask Siri to find a plant or check what’s due today.
◎ Watering reminders that fit real life
Set a schedule per plant and let PlantPal remind you. Running late? Snooze with one tap and jump back into rhythm. PlantPal keeps you consistent without guilt-tripping.
◎ A to-do list built for plant care
See what is due today, pull upcoming tasks into the days you have time, and fly through a multi-plant routine with a checklist designed for how plant care actually works.
◎ Plant journal and photo diary
Turn care into a growth story. Log notes and photos for each plant and look back at every new leaf, bloom, and change over time.
◎ Houseplant tracker, organized by room
Sort plants into rooms and locations so you always know what is where and which plants need attention next.
◎ Plant Library
Search a multilingual library of 500+ houseplants and herbs for the basics: light, watering, soil, and toxicity warnings. Facts, never prescriptions: you set the schedule that suits your home.
◎ Widgets, Live Activities, and Shortcuts
Check today’s tasks from your Home Screen or Lock Screen, and automate PlantPal with Shortcuts.
◎ Private iCloud sync, no account
Your data stays in your own iCloud, synced across iPhone and iPad. No sign-up, no ads, no third-party servers, and PlantPal works fully offline.
◎ Made for iPad
A true three-column layout for managing tasks and your collection at a glance, with Split View and multi-window support.
PlantPal is free with up to 20 plants and watering reminders. PlantPal Pro unlocks unlimited plants and every task type (fertilizing, misting, repotting, pruning, and more), as a subscription or a one-time purchase.
Whether you’re a seasoned plant parent or just starting out, download PlantPal and let it guide your routine.

Surviving in the Exclusion Zone means taking no chances. Every move counts and a single misstep could be your last. However, completing the Black Market merchant's missions, looting valuable resources, and constantly improving your survival skills can greatly increase your odds. Become the one who ultimately digs out the truth of the disaster!
2. Fully Customizable Weapons
With the realistic weapon structures and textures, Lost Light brings you an immersive shooting experience.
The highly customizable modification system brings you 12 components and over 100 parts, so you can create the best weapon build with ease. With the new Weapon Skin Customization System, you can find over 10,000 spray combinations, giving you the freedom to design your own unique style! Choose from over 100 presets and enjoy the convenience of our one-click loadout function, allowing you to prepare for battle quickly and efficiently!
3. Acting after Planning Is the Key to Survival
Enter the operation with a full build or go light and avoid fully prepared enemies, it's your choice. You can still make a fortune by looting and evacuating even if you don't defeat any enemies.
But remember, if you fail to evacuate, you will lose everything you've collected.
4. Prepare Your Strategies
In Lost Light, being fully prepared for battle in your Shelter is essential. This involves maintaining good physical condition, upgrading and modifying your combat equipment, and coordinating your personalized gear. As battle can start at any moment, it's crucial to select your equipment carefully. Luckily, Smart Pet is available to assist you. They can help you carry back the items you found in the Exclusion Zone or try to retrieve your items if you're defeated.
5. Diverse Social Interactions
On the real battlefield, there are no permanent enemies. You can choose to rescue other players, team up with them, and evacuate together. If you are knocked out, you can send an SOS signal and reveal your location to others. But you'll never know if the approaching player will be a friend or a foe.
6. Cross-platform Feature
Now, players can experience a truly immersive battlefield on both PC and mobile devices. Mobile and PC players can chat in real-time and team up. With the seamless cross-platform function, you can take on more challenges and achieve greater goals!

bluejetty:00043768:ios.description:
Desde a nossa fundação, nosso objetivo principal foi apresentar soluções de qualidades para os problemas da vida em condomínios.
Por isso, o jeito CONVIVIUM de administrar condomínios passa por ter soluções completas que estimulem a cooperação e participação positiva de todos para que a administração condominial seja ainda mais transparente e produtiva. 
Com rotinas automatizadas pelo aplicativo (boletos, prestação de contas, solicitações, comunicação, etc) sobra mais tempo para o corpo diretivo do condomínio atuar junto com a assessoria CONVIVIUM em questões maiores como redução de custos, melhor aproveitamento dos espaços, melhoria dos procedimentos, aumento da segurança, manutenção predial, etc. 
Tanto pelo site da CONVIVIUM quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.

bluejetty:00170377:ios.description:
Step into the heart of the Tour de France with the official Tour de France app presented by ŠKODA!
The Tour de France brings you even more content so you can experience the rhythm of the Grande Boucle all year round! It also gives you the chance to become part of the race through the Tour de France Club!
Download the app so you never miss a moment of the Tour de France throughout the year.
Get ready for the race and each stage with insights from our experts, discover the teams and routes, follow all the latest race news and every stage live with our interactive Race Center, check the official standings, immerse yourself in the race with all our videos - including extended highlights - play Fantasy by Tissot, and vote for the Century 21 Combativity Award!
What’s New in 2026
- 2026 edition update
- Performance optimizations
- Rankings: added filters by favorites and nationalities
Race Center
- Added 9 new languages: Slovenian, Slovak, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Norwegian, Italian, Portuguese, and Swedish
- Added estimated rider passing times at key points along the route
- Ability to ask questions to our experts
Get ready for all the stages
- Presentation of the stages with profiles and maps
- Video briefing of the stage by the sports direction
- Stage schedule
- Detailed team and rider profiles
- Tips for coming to each stage, following the Tour Caravan, and coming to the Fan Parks
- Cultural information on all departure and arrival cities
Follow every stage live with the Race Center by Capgemini
- Real-time rider positions and live rankings
- Stage data
- Live commentary from our experts
- Stage videos and photos: near live, last kilometer, highlights, and more
- Radio Tour featuring official information from race management via live audio
- Interactive mode to chat with our experts, take part in quizzes and polls, follow your Fantasy players, and vote for the Century 21 Combativity Award
- Personalized notifications
- Available in 13 languages: French, English, Spanish, German, Slovenian, Slovak, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Norwegian, Italian, Portuguese, and Swedish
Relive all stages
- Summary of the day and long video summary
- Last KM video
- Short videos of moments from the stage
- Interviews
- Classifications
- All the best photos from the stage
Join the cast of the Tour de France
- Join the Tour de France Club
- Play Fantasy by Tissot
- Vote for the Century 21 Combativity Award
- Guess the winner of the day
- Ask our experts your questions
- Listen to Radio Tour
- Enter the contests for a chance to win Tour de France prizes
- Discover and download the official loops of the Tour de France route
In the Preferences Center, complete your profile and configure your notifications.

bluejetty:00128894:ios.description:
Happy birthday photo frame is a great app to create your own personalized birthday images to wish a Happy Birthday by adding your own birthday pictures.
You can use a great variety of frames for happy birthday images to create original and funny designs and to use them as birthday congratulations.
How do I use the app “Happy Birthday Photo Frame”?
We have developed a simple but complete birthday photo editor, in which you can choose the birthday photo frames you like and later add the photo you like to wish an enjoyable and emotional happy birthday.
1.The first step is to choose the kind of frame you would like to use. In order to make it easier we have divided the available frames into different categories, so that you can design the best birthday postcards for every occasion. You can find birthday congratulations for family, parties, children, frames with gifts, birthday cake photo frames or even simple and elegant frames for pictures.
2.- Once you have chosen the frame you like, you can browse through the different birthday frames and choose the one you like most or the one you need.
3.- In the next step you will have to choose the happy birthday photos you would like to add to your photo collage. You can choose a photo of the image gallery of your phone or tablet or directly use your camera to take a photo, if you like, and use it in the birthday photo editor. You can move, rotate or resize the image so that it fits in perfectly into frame and so create original and funny images of happy birthday.
4.- In the next 2 steps you can add personalized texts to your birthday picture collage to give your birthday greeting a personal touch. Additionally, you can add stickers or badges to those free birthday frames if you like to give it a funny and entertaining finishing touch.
The last step of this process will be to download or share your design with your friends and family. You can send it via messaging apps, social networks, SMS, email and any other app you have on your phone or tablet.
As you can see, it's a very quick and easy process to create some happy birthday pictures with this app.
Main characteristics of the app “Happy Birthday Photo Frame”:
- Personalized birthday frames for pictures, organized by category. Find your perfect frame for every occasion.
- Complete editor for birthday frames online with which you can make photo collages with pretty happy birthday frames and your photos. Add texts, badges or stickers, filters, etc.
- Share your photo collages with your friends and family.
Premium features:
- An ad-free experience throughout the App
- Removal of watermarks from exported images
- Access to exclusive premium photo frame designs
- Ability to select and customize different font styles for text
- Access to premium stickers and decorative elements
We hope that you like this happy birthday photo frame app. If you liked it, we would appreciate if you could give this app a positive review. This will help us to keep maintaining the app and add new improvements and features.

All designs used on this app have been created by exclusive designers for Reticode, therefore the commercial use of any image included in the program is prohibited without the previous authorization of Reticode.
For some designs we have used images from public domain since they are not identified in any way that indicates the existence of exploitation rights reserved thereon.
Any natural or legal person who was the owner of any images contained herein, may accredit through reticode@gmail.com, committing to the immediate withdrawal of the image after verification, if necessary, ownership of the image or protected sentence.

bluejetty:00045856:ios.description:
ManiBack, the app that generates cashback at compounding pharmacies.
In the ManiBack app, you'll find more than just cashback and offers. Experience ManiBack: talk directly with the compounding pharmacy without leaving the app, reorder a previously requested prescription, track orders made on the pharmacy's website, and place new orders with just a few clicks.
Need to send your prescription? Send it through the app.
Need to send audio, text, or video to the pharmacy attendant? Do it through the app.
Need to ask questions and track your order status? Follow and receive notifications through the app.
You're even more connected with your favorite compounding pharmacy!
How does our cashback work?
Easy to explain and even easier to understand, here's the step-by-step:
Purchase at your preferred compounding pharmacy (within or outside ManiBack).
Download the app and create your free account – yes, the account is free.
Made your purchase and generated cashback? Click "Collect" to generate your balance.
Use your cashback balance to save on your next purchase.
Collect your cashback within 24 hours of purchase and remember to use it within 90 days (you won't let your cashback expire, right?
Want to earn even more cashback? Collect diamonds every day and play our weekly quiz. Your diamonds are worth cashback, that's right =)
See how simple it is? To make sure you don't forget, within the app, you can connect with the compounding pharmacy without relying on another conversation app.
Want to know more about ManiBack? Be the first to know about new partnerships? Then follow us :) @manibackcashback

bluejetty:00069248:ios.summary: Word Hurdle is the daily word puzzle, rebuilt from the ground up. Guess the hidden word in six tries, then keep playing: spin the Wheel, trace words through 210 Cascade levels, find words in the Bee honeycomb, race the Blitz clock and chall
bluejetty:00069248:ios.description:
Word Hurdle is the daily word puzzle, rebuilt from the ground up. Guess the hidden word in six tries, then keep playing: spin the Wheel, trace words through 210 Cascade levels, find words in the Bee honeycomb, race the Blitz clock and challenge your friends.
A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• Daily Challenge: one shared word for everyone, every day.
• Green means right letter, right spot. Yellow means right letter, wrong spot. Grey means the letter is not in the word.
• Today: every daily game on one screen, each with its own leaderboard and monthly trophies.
• Keep your streak going and climb the leaderboards.
• Missed a day? Unlock it from the calendar.
WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: guess 4, 5 or 6-letter words.
• Wheel: swipe or tap the letters on the wheel to fill every word on the board. 300 levels, plus a new daily wheel.
• Cascade: drag through touching letters in any direction to spell words and clear the board. 210 levels, three stars to earn on each, and a new Daily Board every day.
• Bee: one honeycomb of letters, all day long. Find as many words as you can and climb the ranks.
• Blitz: unscramble words from the honeycomb before the clock runs out. Every solve buys more time.
• Swipe to Find: trace hidden words in a themed letter grid.
• Hidden and Frozen: masked tiles and locked letters for a tougher guess.
• Challenge: pick a word, send it to a friend and see who does better. One attempt each.
LEVEL UP
• Earn XP as you play to level up, unlock new modes and rank on the Overall leaderboard.
• Stuck? Use hints, reveals and shuffles.
• Choose your favorite color theme.
• Game Center keeps your progress with you.
ALREADY PLAYING?
Update and your progress and subscription come with you.
WORD HURDLE PRO. All amount is in USD.
No ads, every mode unlocked, and any past day free to play.
• Word Hurdle Pro Monthly: $5.99 per month
• Word Hurdle Pro Yearly: $29.99 per year, with 800 bonus gems every year
DAILY MONTHLY PASS
Play any past day you missed, as many as you like all month, without spending gems. Does not remove ads.
• Daily Monthly Pass: $8.99 per month
GEMS
Spend gems on hints, powerups and past days.
• 300 Gems: $0.99
• 1,700 Gems: $4.99
• 3,800 Gems: $9.99
Prices are in US dollars, may vary by country, and are shown in the app before you buy.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, and each renewal is charged within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscriptions anytime in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://wordhurdle.ropolabs.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://wordhurdle.ropolabs.com/terms/
Support: https://wordhurdle.ropolabs.com/support/

bluejetty:00129663:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00129663:ios.description:
The weather briefing that fits in a pilot's pocket.
AeroMet brings METAR, TAF, NOTAM, SIGMET, SIGWX, ATIS, satellite and radar from official sources together and shows them clearly: colors that flag ceiling, visibility and weather, plain-language decoding and the validity time always in sight.
YOUR FLIGHT, END TO END
• Add an airline flight by its number (e.g. UAL1017) or plan a general aviation flight with aircraft, route, level and alternates.
• Live status: registration, aircraft type, altitude, speed and ETA (Premium).
• Running late? Edit the EOBT and every filter follows: departure, arrival and en-route METAR, TAF, NOTAM and SIGMET.
WHAT AFFECTS YOUR ROUTE
• SIGMET and SIGWX checked against your route, with entry and exit points, length and whether they affect your level at the time you pass.
• A map with animated satellite, radar and SIGMET, and airports colored by flight category (VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR).
AIRPORT WEATHER
• Color-coded METAR and TAF with recent history and decoding: category, wind, visibility, ceiling, temperature and altimeter.
• Runway wind diagram and ATIS.
• NOTAMs decoded and filtered by your flight time.
HOME SCREEN WIDGET
• Color-coded METAR for your favorite airports, with the Zulu time in blue (current) or red (outdated) over a radar map.
ALERTS (PREMIUM)
• Important NOTAMs, relevant METAR changes and weather warnings for the airports of your flights — without notification overload.
AND MORE
• Folders for home bases, frequent destinations and flights.
• Offline maps with the latest radar and satellite (Premium).
• Airports worldwide.
Data comes from the public organizations that publish it (NOAA/AWC, DECEA and others). AeroMet is a supporting tool and does not replace an official briefing.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00165934:ios.description:
MBTA Go is the official app for live, public transit information in the Greater Boston area. Check live arrival times, track your vehicle, and learn about the latest closures.
App features:
• Check live arrival times: Get the latest estimates of when your bus or train will get to you.
• Track your vehicle: Check how many stops away your bus or train is, and see live vehicle locations on the map.
• Learn about the latest closures: Find out if your there is a closure on your route with clear alerts and maps.
• Share feedback: Provide feedback to help us resolve issues, make improvements, and prioritize what we work on next.
We want to make MBTA Go accessible to all riders who have a smartphone. The app supports language translations and the following mobile accessibility features:
• VoiceOver for riders who are blind or have low-vision
• Switch and Voice Control for riders with mobility impairments
If you have questions about MBTA Go, email us at apphelp@mbta.com.

bluejetty:00077894:ios.description:
Embark on an exciting journey for kids/toddler in the undersea wonders of Princess Life Town! Explore the secrets of Bobo Mermaid Town Simulator, where you'll encounter new friends like the little mermaid princess, dolphin bobo prince, jellyfish pet girl, octopus queen, koi fish baby doll princess, and even a cat or a pony. Choose from a stunning array of outfits as you dive into this magical realm for kids/toddler.
Features:
Free Exploration: Dive into all the secrets. Like the royal palace with cute cat and horse, Youth Spring, the witch's house, the salon room, and the undersea restaurant.
Adventures with Friends: Join your favorite characters or pets in different locations. Dance in the palace with a girl, discover little creatures/pets, have a care salon or go on a thrilling treasure hunt!
Create Your Story: Craft new stories and shape your own fairytale world beneath the waves.
Interactivity:
Character Expressions: Give your character various expressions, let them move and dance, with endless possibilities limited only by your imagination.
Rich Customization: Choose from hundreds of faces, cute clothes, makeup, and little accessories to create your own unique baby. Take care of your characters!
Explore 12 scenes with over 500 interactive items in this kids/toddler simulator game, such as care salon tools, horse, cat, unicorn, pony, and doll!
Story Creation: Interact with every item, find unicorn's secrets, create character stories, and express your ideas. 
Gameplay:
No Restrictions: Play various character roles and experience different lives with unlimited interaction possibilities. You may find a magical unicorn, pony, horse and dolls.
Continuous Enjoyment: Discover hidden plots, salon, animations, new characters, and exciting events as you explore different locations.
Dive into the enchanting Baby Girl Mermaid Kingdom and the regal Bobo Princess Life Town Simulator for an immersive and cute experience!

This app offers an auto-renewing week subscription at $2.99/week to provide unlimited access and other premium features.

You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Your use of this application is governed by the Terms of Service available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Collection and use of your data are subject to the Privacy Policy available at https://www.privacypolicygenerator.info/live.php?token=6sSgtRE9QeOG9ZW73usCGwXn76XpGRt4

bluejetty:00115486:ios.summary: All Who Wander is a turn-based traditional roguelike RPG where every game is a different adventure, inspired by dungeon crawlers such as Pixel Dungeon. Choose from 15 character classes and combine abilities across 10 skill trees to create a
bluejetty:00115486:ios.description:
All Who Wander is a turn-based traditional roguelike RPG where every game is a different adventure, inspired by dungeon crawlers such as Pixel Dungeon. Choose from 15 character classes and combine abilities across 10 skill trees to create a unique build every run. Journey through 30 procedurally generated levels from blinding deserts to frozen caverns, and explore a dynamic world that burns, freezes, grows, and shatters. Master tactical combat, recruit companions, and discover enchanted items. In classic roguelike fashion, be prepared for hardcore gameplay, permadeath, and no meta-progression. Learn from each death to perfect your strategy and eventually achieve victory!
Every run is different. Every decision matters.
Full 30-level adventure included, with 3 character classes and 1 boss.
Unlock 12 additional classes and 5 more bosses with a one-time purchase.
No ads. No microtransactions. Play offline.
◆ Craft Your Character
Experiment with 15 character classes, each offering distinct playstyles. With no class restrictions, any character can learn any skill or equip any item. Discover ability synergies across 10 skill trees to create powerful builds, such as a warrior illusionist or shaman ranger. Go solo or lead a party of companions to survive the dangers ahead.
◆ Explore a Vast World
Dive into a 3D, hex-grid world filled with scorching deserts, noxious swamps, and gloomy dungeons, each with hazards and secrets to uncover. Visit guilds to learn new skills and taverns to recruit companions. Use your surroundings to your advantage. Take cover in tall grass and avoid sand dunes that slow your movement. Be prepared for hostile storms and curses, forcing you to adapt your strategy.
◆ A New Experience Every Game
 • 12 biomes
 • 15 character classes
 • 70+ monsters and 6 bosses
 • 100+ abilities to learn
 • 200+ items to discover
 • 100+ traps, treasures, and buildings to interact with
◆ A Traditional Roguelike
 • Turn-based tactical combat
 • Procedural generation
 • Permadeath (except for Casual/Adventure modes)
 • No meta-progression
 • Hardcore gameplay 
 • Single-player, offline RPG
All Who Wander is a solo indie project, with regular updates for new features and content. Join the community and share your feedback on the Discord: https://discord.gg/Yy6vKRYdDr
Rated 13+ by the Indonesia Game Rating System (IGRS).

bluejetty:00172399:ios.summary: Basketball Betting Tips & Odds gives you AI sports picks, stats, scores in a simple, clear way. The goal is to save you time on research while letting you keep full control over every wager and strategy decision. We don’t promise wins or gu
bluejetty:00172399:ios.description:
Basketball Betting Tips & Odds gives you AI sports picks, stats, scores in a simple, clear way. The goal is to save you time on research while letting you keep full control over every wager and strategy decision. We don’t promise wins or guaranteed profit. We show structured basketball prediction data so you can judge value yourself.
Basketball Betting Tips & Odds (AI sports picks, stats, scores) uses an automated model to scan team form, historical numbers and other stable factors. No human tipster edits or hype—just a consistent prediction process. You’ll see for each game: win probability (game result %), an Over/Under style total score forecast with a projected interval, and a reference odds number so you can compare model view vs book sentiment.
Easy to read game pages:
Result probability: If one side is over 50% that side is the model’s pick (not a promise).
Confidence indicator: Helps you sense relative strength among games.
Total score forecast: Shows projected points and an interval to frame pace expectations.
Reference odds: Lets you check if your own view aligns or differs from a book line. All prediction info is for analysis only. Variance will still affect every game.
Basketball Betting Tips & Odds includes AI sports picks, stats, scores for major competitions: NBA (American pro), EuroLeague tournaments and other international events. A dedicated NBA section groups American games. EuroLeague and other league slates appear in a unified list so you can move quickly.
Transparency matters. Inside the stats/results area you can review prior prediction outcomes (win / loss context). This helps you calibrate expectations before you trust any single forecast. Past performance does not guarantee future result; it is there for honest reference.
You can sort/filter games based on time, confidence, and odds. Picks are produced by the same model and Pro users get access to all predictions and tools. 
With Basketball Betting Tips & Odds you decide how to use the information. Each day the app provides a fresh game list that you can explore at your own pace. If you’re a Pro user, you can filter or sort by confidence or start time to make browsing easier. For every match you’ll see probability, intervals, and reference odds, which can then be compared with your own notes or any external lines you follow. The idea is to support your decision-making, whether you choose to pass on a game or add it to your personal strategy log. Over time, the history tab lets you revisit past picks and results so you can refine your approach in your strategy.
What many users appreciate is the consistency. The format is the same every day, giving you a clear separation between probability of results and forecasts for total points. The reference odds snapshot encourages a more disciplined comparison instead of acting on impulse, while the neutral presentation makes it clear that the app is focused on data, not promises.
Basketball Betting Tips & Odds (AI sports picks, stats, scores) keeps language plain so you can act fast: open the app, scan, evaluate, move on. If you want structured basketball prediction info for NBA, EuroLeague, and many other basketball leagues, cups and tournament around the world, you will likely love to use our tool for daily predictions.
Many users treat our app as a neutral tipster tool, providing structured data without the hype. It is designed to support your wager planning, whether you follow the model closely or simply use it as one more opinion before placing a bet. For American basketball fans, the dedicated NBA coverage makes it easy to track games every day. The clear format helps you compare model forecasts with book odds and judge where you might see value. Past win and loss records are visible so you can understand context before trusting any single prediction. Our app is not here to promise that you will beat the book—it is here to give you a consistent daily framework for your basketball betting strategy.

bluejetty:00200100:ios.description:
Listen to Live NOAA Broadcasts with Rewind & Replay.
Listen to available NOAA Weather Radio All Hazards broadcasts and review recent audio with Rewind & Replay. Station availability and audio quality depend on the stream provider and your internet connection.
Stay Safe. Stay Informed. Stay Ahead.
Receive supported weather alerts when notifications are enabled, including when the app is closed and your screen is locked. Delivery and timing depend on your notification settings, connectivity, Apple services, and upstream weather data. The app should not be your only source of emergency information.
KEY FEATURES
Live Rewind & Replay — Review recent audio when supported by the selected station and playback engine
Free Push Weather Alerts — Notifications for supported warnings, watches, and advisories in your selected areas
NOAA Broadcasts — Browse available NOAA Weather Radio streams
Animated Zoomable Radar — 5x zoom with active warning overlays and lightning detection
Current Conditions + 4-Day Forecast — By GPS, Wi-Fi, or your selected broadcast station
All 172 NWS Forecast Offices — Full statewide watches, warnings, advisories & SPC severe alerts
Marine Forecasts — Full coastal and inland waterway coverage
Complete NWS Data — Hourly & daily forecasts, Celsius/Fahrenheit toggle, beautiful Retina graphics
WHY NOAA WEATHER RADIO?
* Simple one-tap alert setup for one or multiple locations
* Background audio — keep listening while using other apps
* Responsive, real-human customer support
* Featured by Lifehacker.com
* A fraction of the cost of a dedicated weather radio device
Notification sounds depend on your device settings. Eligible critical alerts can bypass silent mode and Focus only when you grant Critical Alerts permission; ordinary alerts follow your notification settings.
Optional in-app purchases unlock Synthesized Stations, enhanced radar features, and tropical-cyclone overlays. See the in-app Store for feature details and current prices.
NOAA Weather Radio is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by NOAA or the National Weather Service.

bluejetty:00182787:ios.description:
Mahjong Vacations is the biggest, best, and most immersive mahjong solitaire game out there. With over 500 unique boards, dozens of themes and hundreds of challenges, it satisfies even the most enthusiastic mahjong player.
Take a trip around the world to dozens of different vacation destinations. From the canals of Venice to the soft white beaches of Thailand, explore the world like never before from the comfort of your own house while playing mahjong solitaire.
It's time to relax and lose yourself on a soft white beach of Thailand, explore the Yucatan, enjoy a gondola ride in Venice or take an adventure in the Amazon through Mahjong Vacations.
Choose from one of the dozens of exotic vacations with customized music, immersive visuals, unique tile sets and interesting bits of information that capture the culture and the essence of the location you are playing.
Track the places you've visited on a real map.
Utilize your Shuffle, Swap, Undo, Hint and Clarity boosts to help you throughout your mahjong journey. Upgrade your boosts to improve your scores and to help you through some of the more difficult challenges.
Think your friends will miss you while you travel? Send them a postcard that you'll collect from each beautiful place you've played.
You can even pinch and zoom in on the tiles to get a closer look!
Think you've played Mahjong? You haven’t really experienced it until you've taken a Mahjong Vacation.
You deserve a vacation. You really do!
Visit us on Facebook

Are you ready for the ultimate challenge that will put your skills, reflexes, and focus to the test? Look no further than Deflect Ball - the heart-pumping, action-packed adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat!
In Deflect Ball
bluejetty:00169842:ios.description:
Are you ready for the ultimate challenge that will put your skills, reflexes, and focus to the test? Look no further than Deflect Ball - the heart-pumping, action-packed adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat!
In Deflect Ball, you’ll face off against a relentless opponent - a ball that’s out to hunt you down. But don’t worry - you’re not defenseless! With split-second timing and precise accuracy, you can use your trusty paddle to smack the ball back where it came from. But beware - with every hit, the ball gets faster and more unpredictable. Can you keep up?
Here are some features that make Deflect Ball stand out:
Deflect Ball will test your skills like no other. You’ll need lightning-fast reflexes, sharp coordination, and perfect timing to keep the ball in check. Even a small mistake can lead to failure, so you have to be on your toes at all times.
But that’s part of what makes it so exciting! With every round, you’ll develop your own techniques and strategies, learning from your successes and failures. You’ll improve your skills and see the results every time you play.
And then there’s the pace - Deflect Ball is a non-stop adrenaline rush from start to finish. As the ball bounces around faster and faster, the tension keeps building until you’re completely absorbed in the action. You’ll be dodging, ducking, and swinging your paddle with everything you’ve got.
So are you ready to master Deflect Ball, and prove that you’re the best of the best? Give it a try and see how far you can go!

bluejetty:00126318:ios.description:
The world is complex—and changing fast. A free trial of The Economist in the app offers easy access to independent, global news analysis. With articles, The Economist Insider shows, podcasts, short-form videos, games and more, the app is a simple way for curious, globally minded people to make sense of what today’s world news means for tomorrow.
Start your free trial today for full access. Or you can register to read one free article in the app and one on the web every month.
What does The Economist cover?
The Economist reports on American and world politics, finance, economics, business, science, technology, culture and more.
Why choose The Economist app?
Access The Economist’s fact-checked reporting and analysis, wherever you are. In our app you’ll find daily updates on the most important news stories shaping our world, in the formats that suit you best.
- Read global, fact-checked reporting and analysis—daily
- Watch Insider episodes and concise videos on important news topics
- Listen to award-winning podcasts and narrated news articles
Stay ahead on news stories daily and explore big topics deeply:
- Enjoy early access to The Economist’s weekly edition, ahead of print delivery
- Watch the newsroom debates that shape our reporting on Insider, plus exclusive interviews with global guests from Elon Musk to Mark Carney
- Listen to podcasts on global affairs and news events
- Catch up quickly with The World in Brief
Play news games to test your knowledge:
- Mini crossword
- Dateline history quiz
- News quiz
- Inboxes: how fast can you fill the grid?
Enjoy additional features:
- Bookmark news articles to read later
- Go hands-free with narrated articles
- Create your own audio queue for a custom playlist 
- Give articles to friends and family
- Read easily with adjustable text size
- Toggle screen to dark mode to rest your eyes
See what The Economist subscribers say:
“This app is home to the best journalism in the world. If I could only afford to pay for one news source, The Economist would be that source.”
“Great app, excellent journalism! The Economist is wonderful. The content is interesting and relevant and the reporting is superlative. Equally impressive is the drive to stay relevant by presenting media in multiple formats, from print to podcasts and short videos.”
“Impeccable journalism with an app to match. The Economist doesn’t need my endorsement of the quality of their journalism. It speaks for itself. Rather, I’ll comment that their app is well-designed and refreshing to use…I love being able to easily download entire editions, listen to articles with real narrators and search for past articles.”
Full terms of use: https://www.economist.com/legal/terms-of-use
Our privacy policy: https://www.economist.com/privacy
Register for your free trial in The Economist app now to understand what the latest news developments mean for what’s next—from science and tech to business and finance.

bluejetty:00063198:ios.description:
Become a crafting tycoon!
- Mine and harvest resources to craft products and goods. 
- Build anything from basic materials to legendary items. 
- Automatically sell your goods and upgrade your crafting units.
- Unlock over 500 achievements and ascend 100 levels.
- Collect new blueprints to unlock them in your workshop.
Build, invest and research!
- Upgrade and evolve blueprints! Increase your revenue to get set bonuses.
- Invest in further upgrades, new products or research.
- Accomplish missions to get permanent prestige rewards.
Customize your workshop! 
- Organize your workshop however you want. Just drag around the products.
- Engage in regular event workshops with unique content and rewards.
- Build a gigantic production line with over 100 items and counting.
Crafting Idle Clicker supports multiple playstyles:
-Active: Tap your products to speed up crafting. 
-Passive: Let the game run while it automatically earns money and invests the profits. 
-Closed: Crafting continues while the app is closed. Just give new orders from time to time. 
-Offline: Most features work without internet connection. 
Generative AI tools were used during development to assist in creating marketing and promotional graphics, localized text, and visual assets for game updates and new features (such as icons, UI elements, and seasonal content). All AI-assisted assets are reviewed, edited, and integrated by human developers prior to release.
Do you like idle games, management games or incremental games, but most of them are too shallow for you? Then try Crafting Idle Clicker - one of the best crafting games out there!
Over one million players enjoyed Crafting Idle Clicker already. The game is still updated regularly with new features and content.

bluejetty:00022717:ios.name: TV Remote For TCL
bluejetty:00022717:ios.summary: Lost the remote again? It's behind the couch, under a cushion, or the kids walked off with it — and your show is paused on the wrong screen. TCL Remote turns the phone already in your hand into a full remote for every TCL TV in your home.
bluejetty:00022717:ios.description:
Lost the remote again? It's behind the couch, under a cushion, or the kids walked off with it — and your show is paused on the wrong screen. TCL Remote turns the phone already in your hand into a full remote for every TCL TV in your home.
One app for every TCL TV — whether yours runs Google TV, Fire TV, or Roku. No more juggling three different remotes or guessing which one belongs to which set. Pair once and the app remembers every TV you've ever connected, so you can switch between the bedroom and the living room with a single tap.
PAIR IN SECONDS
Connect over Wi-Fi in about thirty seconds. Tap your TV from the radar view, type the on-screen code if your TV asks for one, and you're in. Switching TVs later is just one tap on the device name at the top of the screen.
A REAL REMOTE, ON YOUR PHONE
A precise D-pad with directional haptics that you can feel, dedicated volume and channel rails, and instant access to your apps grid. Launch Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+ and more straight from your phone.
TYPE INSTEAD OF PECKING
Stop hunting letter-by-letter with the on-screen keyboard. Use your iPhone keyboard to search and log in on the big screen in seconds.
VOICE SEARCH BUILT IN
Search by voice using your TV's own assistant — Google Assistant on Google TV, Alexa on Fire TV. Find a show without typing a single character.
SMART TRACKPAD
Swipe to navigate. Trackpad mode turns simple gestures into smooth on-screen movement, so menus feel natural instead of clunky.
BUILT FOR DAILY USE
- Live Activity keeps the remote one tap from your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island while your TV is on
- Home Screen widgets put your most-used keys beside your other widgets
- Siri Shortcuts let you mute, pause, or change the channel with a phrase
- Light, Dark, and System themes that adapt to the time of day
- Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Filipino, and Arabic, with full right-to-left support
WORKS WITH TCL TVs RUNNING
TCL Roku TV, TCL Google TV, and TCL Fire TV editions — controlling power, volume, channels, inputs, playback, and apps.
FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE
TCL Remote is free with ads and one paired TV. Upgrade to Pro to:
- Remove all ads, everywhere in the app
- Pair an unlimited number of TVs
- Unlock the smart trackpad
- Enable instant iOS-keyboard input
- Add Home Screen and Lock Screen remote widgets
- Get priority support
TCL Remote Pro is available as a Monthly subscription, a Yearly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase that unlocks every Pro feature forever on every device tied to your Apple ID. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription. The Lifetime option is a one-time purchase and does not renew.
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
We never sell your data. The app works entirely on your device — pairing tokens and preferences stay there.
Privacy Policy: https://realvision.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://realvision.app/terms
Disclaimer: TCL Remote is an independent remote control tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by TCL, Roku, Google, or Amazon. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

A precise D-pad with directional haptics that you can feel, dedicated volume and channel rails, and instant access to your apps grid. Launch Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+ and more straight from your phone.

TYPE INSTEAD OF PECKING
Stop hunting letter-by-letter with the on-screen keyboard. Use your iPhone keyboard to search and log in on the big screen in seconds.

VOICE SEARCH BUILT IN
Search by voice using your TV's own assistant — Google Assistant on Google TV, Alexa on Fire TV. Find a show without typing a single character.

SMART TRACKPAD
Swipe to navigate. Trackpad mode turns simple gestures into smooth on-screen movement, so menus feel natural instead of clunky.

BUILT FOR DAILY USE
- Live Activity keeps the remote one tap from your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island while your TV is on
- Home Screen widgets put your most-used keys beside your other widgets
- Siri Shortcuts let you mute, pause, or change the channel with a phrase
- Light, Dark, and System themes that adapt to the time of day
- Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Filipino, and Arabic, with full right-to-left support

WORKS WITH TCL TVs RUNNING
TCL Roku TV, TCL Google TV, and TCL Fire TV editions — controlling power, volume, channels, inputs, playback, and apps.

FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE
TCL Remote is free with ads and one paired TV. Upgrade to Pro to:
- Remove all ads, everywhere in the app
- Pair an unlimited number of TVs
- Unlock the smart trackpad
- Enable instant iOS-keyboard input
- Add Home Screen and Lock Screen remote widgets
- Get priority support

TCL Remote Pro is available as a Monthly subscription, a Yearly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase that unlocks every Pro feature forever on every device tied to your Apple ID. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription. The Lifetime option is a one-time purchase and does not renew.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

bluejetty:00069675:ios.name: PushFit Pro
bluejetty:00069675:ios.summary:
You do push-ups. PushFit counts.
Place your iPhone on the ground beneath you and start pushing. The front camera tracks your face and counts every rep automatically. It even measures how deep each one goes. No tapping, no equipment, no exc
bluejetty:00069675:ios.description:
You do push-ups. PushFit counts.
Place your iPhone on the ground beneath you and start pushing. The front camera tracks your face and counts every rep automatically. It even measures how deep each one goes. No tapping, no equipment, no excuses. Work out at home or anywhere.
Join 475,000+ people building strength one push-up at a time.
One purchase. No subscription, no ads, ever.
APP FEATURES
▶ Automatic rep counting with the front camera: face tracking measures your distance from the phone, so only real reps count
▶ The Lockout: choose the apps that steal your time and they stay locked until you do your push-ups. PushFit never learns which apps you chose
▶ Streaks that survive rest days: training banks recovery, so a Monday, Wednesday, Friday routine keeps its streak with nothing to schedule
▶ Apple Watch app that counts reps from your wrist, no iPhone needed, with a haptic tick every rep, heart-rate zones, a voice coach and five complications
▶ Live Activity with reps, sets, rest countdown, and heart rate on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
▶ Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, including a one-tap button that logs ten push-ups without opening the app
▶ "Hey Siri, start my push-ups" to start, log, and check your count hands-free, no setup required
▶ Compete with friends and family on daily, weekly, monthly, yearly and all-time leaderboards, with friends added by a link you send
▶ Charts drawn from every single rep: your climb over time, the depth of each rep, and your heart rate through the workout
▶ A calendar of every day you trained, with the depth, consistency, stamina and rest behind each one
▶ Share a workout as a five-second video, made for Stories and Reels
▶ Records workouts in Apple Health with heart rate and calories
▶ Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly goals, drawn as rings or bars, set straight from the home screen
▶ Your music keeps playing, with the controls right on the workout screen
▶ Lifetime record of push-ups, sets and personal bests
▶ Workout reminders to keep the habit going
▶ Customizable themes with matching app icons, your own display name, plus your favorite photo for motivation
▶ Built for everyone: VoiceOver rep announcements and audio graphs for every chart
THE CAMERA NEVER RECORDS
Face tracking measures one thing: how far your face is from the screen. No photo or video is ever saved, and no face data ever leaves your iPhone.
THE PERFECT EXERCISE
The push-up is simple, functional, and scales to any fitness level. Perfect whether you're chasing your first push-up or your hundredth. PushFit Pro slots into any routine.
Push-ups target:
▶ Chest (pectorals)
▶ Shoulders (deltoids)
▶ Arms (triceps)
▶ Core (abdominals and serratus anterior)
Why push-ups?
▶ Burn calories
▶ Improve cardiovascular health
▶ Strengthen the shoulder joint
▶ A real workout with zero equipment
