bluejetty:00165725:ios.description:
Leveraging the power of AI, Vozo AI Video Creator (Formerly known as Blink Captions) enable you to generate, edit, and translate talking videos, featuring auto captions with 200+ styles, avatar video generation, AI edit, AI teleprompter, AI script writing, and AI translate! With Vozo AI (Blink Captions), you can make stunning talking videos 10x easier!
Here's the full set of features offered by Vozo AI (Blink Captions):
AI Captions: 
Use speech-to-text technology to auto-add captions with 99.97% accuracy, significantly improving the engagement of your short form or long form videos from YouTube videos, Shorts, TikTok, to Instagram Reels. Vozo AI (Blink Captions) supports 118 languages and 200+ styles that are 100% customizable at the sentence or batch level.
Avatar Video Generation:
Create personalized avatars from existing videos. Then, simply add scripts to generate impressive talking videos! Vozo AI (Blink Captions) also offers a rich avarat library for your choice. 
Talking Photos Generation:
Turn images into talking videos and create memes easily with Vozo AI! Upload a video and add a script or a recorded audio. You can let portraits, anime, or animals speak up!
AI Translate: 
Select your original and target languages, click "translate," and your video with translated subtitles is ready for export! Vozo AI (Blink Captions) support 118 languages and dialects.
Captions Presets: 
Cool captions styles make your videos or reels eye-catching! Vozo AI (Blink Captions) offers 200+ presets for your choice, including font, color, size, background, and animations. All styles can be further modified.
AI Trim: 
In one click, Vozo AI (Blink Captions) can remove filler words and silent parts from both your captions and video, making talking video or reel editing super easy, smooth, and fluent!
AI Zoom: 
Mark the area you want to stand out in your talking video and when you want it to pop in the captions. Vozo AI (Blink Captions) will automatically zoom into this area at your specified timing. 
AI Highlight: 
You can also choose to highlight any part of your captions, and Vozo AI (Blink Captions) will automatically apply the styles for you.
AI Title
Get automatic, personalized talking video titles that fit right into your content. Let Vozo AI (Blink Captions) help you create attractive titles!
AI Teleprompter
Forget memorizing scripts. Our prompter automatically scrolls at your talking speed. when recording talking videos, allowing natural delivery and eye contact.
AI Script Writing
Jot down your thoughts, and our AI turns them into a finished script, allow you to focus on delivering your message with Vozo AI (Blink Captions)!
Download Watermark-Free Videos
Download watermark free videos from Tiktok and other social media and repost for free!
AI Denoise and Isolate Vocal from Audio for talking videos
Vozo AI (Blink Captions) can identify human voices from complicated audio and isolate the vocal part from audio. You can choose to keep or remove the human voice for further video editing. 
Lyrics Mode: Accurately Add Lyrics for Music Videos
From Pop to Rap, Vozo AI (Blink Captions) accurately detects and transcribes the lyrics for your music videos.
Photo Blend
Merge faces, pets, or products into anime, portraits, or showcase visuals—then animate them into talking videos. Fast, fun, and creative storytelling starts with a blend.
AI Background
Blur your background or switch it in real-time with Vozo AI (Blink Captions)' virtual green screen. No need for physical green screens or additional editing.
Fun Emojis, GIFs & Sound Effects
Vozo AI (Blink Captions) spice up your talking videos with emojis, GIFs, and sounds—all it takes is a click.
We can't wait to see what you'll create with Vozo AI (Blink Captions)! Should you have any feedback or suggestions, contact us at blink-support@vozo.ai.
Terms of service: https://www.vozo.ai/blinkcaptions/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.vozo.ai/blinkcaptions/privacy_policy

bluejetty:00147028:ios.description:
The SMB Online app gives you an up-to-minute view so you can stay organized and make good financial decisions. It's fast, secure, and makes life easier by giving you the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here's what you can do with the SMB Online app: 
Alerts & Notifications: Set up alerts for low funds and incoming transactions, and receive convenient push notifications, emails, and/or in-app messages.
Payments: Make payments to companies and friends.
Transfer Money: Transfer funds between your accounts.
Deposit checks: Take a picture of the front and back and deposit it in a snap.
Manage your debit cards: Easily turn your card off and on if you've temporarily misplaced it. You may also activate a new card, cancel one that is lost or stolen, and set travel 
notifications right from your app. 
View statements: View and save your electronic account statements.
Add Tags, Notes, & Images: By adding custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you're looking for when searching through your transactions.
Support: Locate ATMs or branches and message SMB Customer Service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The SMB Online app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you're banking online. The app features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access. You can also secure your account with biometrics supported by your device - fingerprint or facial recognition.
GETTING STARTED
To use the SMB Online app, you must be enrolled as an Southwest Missouri Bank online banking user. If you currently use our online banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same username and password. If you don't currently use online banking, get enrolled today by selecting "Enroll now" on the login screen of the app.

Take control in Dream Prison: Jail Manager Game, where you shape the fate of a high-security prison! In this jail management game, you'll step into the shoes of a warden tasked with building, managing, and optimizing a fully operational correctional facility. Take on the role of a prison manager in this idle game and control your facility. Keep everything running smoothly while making sure the inmates are safe. Deal with challenges and make important choices to improve your prison manager life 3D.

Each decision you make in this prison game impacts the safety and efficiency of your dream prison manager life, as well as your experience in simulator games.

Experience the excitement of simulator games as you maintain order and security in your growing facility.

Make smart choices to ensure the safety of the facility and the well-being of the inmates. Your success as a warden in this prison manager life depends on how well you handle daily challenges and make important decisions. Embrace the prison manager life and show your skills in this exciting idle game.
Navigate Dream Prison Systems: Every day brings new challenges in managing an ultimate prison game system. Your strategic thinking will be key to keeping your prison secure and your operations running smoothly.
My Dream Prison Manager Game offers a comprehensive and immersive experience for fans of management and simulation games, combining the excitement of a jail game, the challenges of an idle game, and the intricacies of a prison game.

bluejetty:00073436:ios.description:
Rapchat is the all-in-one music maker studio where you can record songs, rap, tune your voice, and edit your vocals with AI-powered effects. Whether you’re just freestyling or chasing rap fame, Rapchat gives you everything you need to create music, discover beats, and collaborate with other artists.
400,000+ FREE BEATS
Pick from rap, trap, drill, Afrobeats, and more. Browse playlists or create beat playlists to fuel your freestyle, record new songs, or collaborate with other rapstars.
AI VOICE & VOCAL TUNE EFFECTS
Upgrade your vocals with custom AI vocal tune and audio tune presets. Just describe the vibe you want—“audio tune rap vocals” or “studio punch-in effects”—and instantly generate unique sounds. Choose from 100+ presets like Reverb, Vocal Tune, and Freestyle FX to edit songs your way.
CREATE, RECORD & EDIT SONGS
Bring your music to life in a simple but powerful recording studio. Import audio files, layer beats, write lyrics, and edit vocals until your track is tuned to perfection. Every tool you need to create songs, tune your voice, and add effects is built in.
COLLABORATE & FREESTYLE
Work on projects with unlimited artists. Trade song versions, freestyle back and forth, and keep every idea saved in the project history.
GET NOTICED & ACHIEVE RAP FAME
From first freestyle to rapstar status, Rapchat helps you showcase your songs, playlists, and beats. Join open verse challenges, share your music, and climb the charts to get discovered.
APP FEATURES
- 400,000+ free rap beats or import your own
- Full-featured music maker studio
- AI vocal tune and voice effects
- Record songs and edit vocals easily
- Lyric pad for writing and freestyling
- Auto-mastering for professional sound
- Collaborate with unlimited artists on projects
- Save and revisit project versions
- Import audio files into the studio
- Export WAVs or create shareable videos
- Build and share song + beat playlists
- Share your music, grow fans, achieve rap fame
-------------------------
Rapchat allows free creation and sharing of music. If you opt to purchase Rapchat Gold, the payment will be charged to your Apple Account, and your account will be billed for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal can be disabled at any time by visiting your Subscription Settings post-purchase.
Terms of Use: https://rapchat.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://rapchat.com/privacy

bluejetty:00062856:ios.description:
Learn one new word every day, and make it stick.
Vocab gives you a new word each day, explained in plain language: what it means, how to say it, where it comes from and how to use it in a sentence. Short practice then brings it back until it is yours.
TODAY'S WORD
• A new word every day, with its definition, phonetic spelling, example sentences, synonyms and word history
• The new widget puts today's word on your Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Save the words you love and look back through every past word
• Share a word as a card
PRACTICE THAT STICKS
• Learn this word: a short lesson on each word
• A daily quiz
• Smart Review brings each word back right before you would forget it
• Flashcards for the words you are learning
• Your Journey tracks your streak and progress, with a leaderboard
WORD PACKS
Themed sets of ten words, such as Everyday Upgrade, Sound More Eloquent, Beautiful & Rare, Words for Writers, Business & Negotiation, Words for Feelings, and SAT and GRE Power Words.
THE 11+ COURSE
600 words for the UK 11+ entrance tests, in 60 sets of ten, each with a short check.
ASK AND WRITE
• The Tutor answers your questions about any word
• The Writing Coach gives feedback on sentences you write with your new words
YOUR ENGLISH
Pick American, British, Australian, Canadian, Irish, Indian, New Zealand or South African English, and words are spelled your way. Audio pronunciation is recorded in American and British English.
FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: the daily word, every past word, saved words, the daily quiz, Smart Review, Flip flashcards (20 a day), one sample word pack and a few Tutor questions.
Vocab Premium adds audio on every word, every word pack, every flashcard mode, and the Tutor and Writing Coach without the free limits.
Vocab Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly at the price shown in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A free trial, where offered, becomes a paid subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
No account needed, and no ads.
Terms of Use: https://twistedsociety.github.io/wotd-tos.html
Privacy Policy: https://twistedsociety.github.io/wotd-pp.html

bluejetty:00040299:ios.name: Fight Legends: Sword Fighting
bluejetty:00040299:ios.summary:
Break Free. Fight for Glory. Become a Legend.
Fight Legends is a medieval action fighting game focused on fast-paced combat, arena duels, and direct character control. Built for fans of fighting games and action games, it delivers intense
bluejetty:00040299:ios.description:
Break Free. Fight for Glory. Become a Legend.
Fight Legends is a medieval action fighting game focused on fast-paced combat, arena duels, and direct character control. Built for fans of fighting games and action games, it delivers intense melee battles with console-quality gameplay on mobile.
Enter a medieval world of knights, assassins, and arena champions. In the city of Ravenfell, fighters test their skills in close-range combat using swords, axes, and daggers. Every battle is a test of control, timing, and execution.
Action-driven fighting gameplay:
Real-time one-on-one fights and arena combat
Direct control over attacks, blocks, dodges, and special moves
Fluid combos and chained strikes
Fast, responsive action built for mobile touch controls
The game emphasizes hands-on combat, clarity, and player input — core elements of classic fighting and action games.
Choose your fighter:
Knight — armored melee combat with heavy weapons
Assassin — fast movement and precise attacks
Champion — balanced combat style and adaptable move set
Each character feels different in combat and supports a distinct fighting approach.
Asynchronous arena battles:
Fight other players’ avatars anytime
Designed for quick, action-focused sessions
Arena progression without live matchmaking
Combat is built around duel-style encounters inspired by fighting game mechanics rather than large-scale multiplayer systems.
Weapons and combat mastery:
Swords, axes, and daggers with different attack ranges
Combat styles inspired by medieval and half sword techniques
Equipment that affects speed, reach, and attack flow
Customize your character:
Armor sets, colors, scars
Beards and hairstyles
A visual appearance shaped by arena victories
Online events and challenges:
Limited-time combat encounters
Powerful enemies and special arena modes
Exclusive equipment rewards
High-quality 3D graphics and smooth animations highlight weapon motion, character movement, and combat readability. Arenas and characters are designed to keep the focus on action and fighting gameplay.
Fight Legends is a medieval combat game created for players who enjoy fighting games, action games, knight battles, sword combat, gladiator arenas, and hands-on melee fighting.
Internet connection is required to play and access PvP, events, and progression.
Break free.
Fight for glory.
Become a legend.
Support: Have an issue, mate? Email us at info@darkcurry.com or access help in-game via Settings > Help and Support.
Privacy Policy: https://darksteel.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://darksteel.app/terms.html

bluejetty:00160570:ios.description:
Enjoy the waiting. Share it with your loved ones. Never miss a thing.
"Patience is not simply the ability to wait - it's how we behave while we're waiting" -- Joyce Meyer
We'll allow you to wait in a brand new way. This app makes creating beautiful countdowns a pleasure. You can customise them as you want, share them and have them in your widgets.
We did our best to make an app simple yet powerful that you'll enjoy using everyday. Waiting will never be the same! 
For each countdown, you can create a custom live website that you can share with anyone. It works great on every device, from smartphones to personal computers. It works with social media, messages or emails.
You can also add notes, thoughts, to-do lists and reminders for every countdown. And of course custom reminders too!
Here's a summary of what's included:
[+] Create a countdown in seconds
[+] Add notes and TO-DOs for any countdown
[+] Add powerful, custom made reminders
[+] Share your countdowns as live websites that work everywhere
[+] Change any countdown with a few taps
[+] More than 20'000 premium wallpapers to use
[+] Advanced decorations for your countdown
[+] View all your countdowns at once or focus only on the upcoming events
[+] Have your countdowns as widgets in your home and lock screen
Try the app, it's worth more than any description. 
We're always here to help and improve the app. We welcome your feedback so please, if there's something we can do for you, write a review or send us an email!
Enjoy your waiting :)

Privacy Policy: https://crazyhorseapps.com/apps-privacy-policy
Terms Of Service: https://crazyhorseapps.com/apps/countdowns/countdown-terms

"That Shopping List" helps you create and work through your shoppin
bluejetty:00179809:ios.description:
Forget your old, cluttered shopping list that is never there when you need it.
Avoid impulse buys, unnecessary walking around the store, and forgotten items while shopping.
"That Shopping List" helps you create and work through your shopping list in record time - on your own or together with others.
All features are fully free.
ADD ITEMS QUICKLY
Add items with smart search, from your personal history, or simply by voice input.
Quantities, units, and categories are recognized automatically, so your list is organized right away.
SHOP FASTER
Sort and customize categories and store sections to match the layout of your store.
"That Shopping List" guides you through the store using the shortest route.
EASY SHARING
Share shopping lists with family, partner, colleagues, or roommates - or use them on multiple devices, with no sign-up required.
Changes are synchronized automatically, and optional notifications can let you know about updates.
HELPS YOU SAVE MONEY
Add prices to items so you can keep a better eye on your spending.
RECIPES
Recipe ideas, recipe search, a recipe collection, and meal planning.
You can easily add ingredients to your grocery list.
EVEN WITHOUT A DATA CONNECTION
You can also use your shopping list offline.
YOUR PRIVACY IS RESPECTED
No registration is required to use the shopping list.
The app only asks for permissions required by the features that use them, such as voice input or notifications.
You decide which of these features you want to use.
USER-FRIENDLY
The intuitive design helps you get started quickly.
While shopping, sleep mode can be disabled for up to 10 minutes. Items checked off by mistake can be restored from the history.
The app and item collection are fully in English.
CUSTOMIZABLE
Create and manage your own lists, categories, and products to fit your needs.
PERSONALIZABLE
Configure your preferred color scheme and choose between light and dark mode.
DATA TRANSFER AND BACKUP
Back up your data or transfer it to another device, such as your new smartphone.
Looking for a simple shopping list app, a free shopping list app, or the best grocery list for faster and more relaxed shopping? Try "That Shopping List".
If you have questions or problems, simply contact info@markenapps.com - we are happy to help quickly.

bluejetty:00015686:ios.developer: 22LEARN Toddler and Baby Learning Games, LLC
bluejetty:00015686:ios.summary:
***** Developed by an award-winning education studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app, in cooperation with educational specialists. 
***** A title from our extremely successful Abby series -- all EIGHT (!) RAN
bluejetty:00015686:ios.description:
***** Developed by an award-winning education studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app, in cooperation with educational specialists. 
***** A title from our extremely successful Abby series -- all EIGHT (!) RANKED #1 APP FOR KIDS on APP Store in many countries. 
***** Full version was ranked in top 5 education in 31 countries (USA, UK, Canada, Singapore...)!
The long-awaited new puzzle game from 22learn is coming! The previous game was ranked #1 app for kids on App Store in many countries!
Do you want some fun for your child? Abby's Preschool Shape Puzzles is a must-have! Let your toddlers play with it, while developing their fine motor skills, and learning names of numerous objects! Abby's Preschool Shape Puzzles, developed by well-loved educational experts with more than two-decade old teaching experience, is a wonderful game for all toddlers.
Try it and enjoy how your children make progress while being engaged! Buy this app from our extremely successful series right now!
-------------------
Buying this app, you can expect to get:
* one for child easy-to-use game mode
* 22 colorfully illustrated themes
* the entirety of more than 250 cute individual puzzles:
- First Farm Puzzles
- Farm Animals
- Pets
- Farm Baby Animals 
- Under The Sea
- Insect 
- Dinosaurs
- Toys for Emma 
- Toys for Tom 
- Fairy Tales 
- Princess Land
- Playground 
- Vehicles I 
- Vehicles II 
- Fruits 
- Fast Food 
- Vegetables I 
- Vegetables II 
- Sweets I 
- Sweets II 
- Halloween Animals 
- Halloween Candies 
- Halloween – Kids
* New scenes coming soon!
-------------------
What's more, not only will your children love the art of an object assembly, but they will also be kept constanly motivated by the all funny, happily enthusiastic monkey, who is there always ready, waiting to articulate the praise children deserve for their patient efforts!
Children will be wondering: how will the monkey show up this time? Will it arrive in its car, or downright jump jovially down with the parachute?
And more yet -- yes... we are willing to go to a great lenghts for you -- you can rely on our updates of the various ways the monkey can appear! Your children will thus be sure to quickly fall in love with the monkey character!
-------------------
Based on our twenty-year old experience in the design of fun educational tools, we made considerable effort that this app is as appropriate and easy-to-use for this very special age category as possible. We hope that your children will enjoy it the same way as our enthusiastic beta-testers did.
If you have any suggestions on how we could further improve the design of our apps, please leave us a message at info@22learn.com. We always appreciate comments on how to make our apps even better!
22learn, your trusted educational apps developer

OurFamilyWizard makes co-parenting easier. We designed these tools to help you reduce conflict, so your kids can thrive after a separation or a divorce. With our powerful and customizable tools, you can free up time, emotional energy, and mental space. 
With all your digital co-parenting interactions rolled up in one secure app, you can keep everything organized and documented. Plus, you can shield your kids from adult conversations they don’t need to see. 
NEW: STAY CONNECTED THROUGH CALLS 
• Stay close when you’re apart 
When you miss your child or they miss you, give them an audio or video call. 
• Connect virtually 
Calls offer an easy solution for virtual visitation, midweek visits, or long-distance co-parenting. 
• Automatic documentation 
With Calls, the details are documented: all dates, times, and in-call activity. All in the same place as your other co-parenting communications. 
SIMPLIFY COMMUNICATION 
• Use just one app 
No more searching for messages or attachments across DMs, phone calls, texts, and emails. Just use one secure app. 
• Track the truth 
Once you send a message, it’s permanent. First-viewed timestamps mean no more arguing about who said what, when, or whether it was seen. 
• Communicate calmly 
ToneMeter catches language that could escalate conflict. Writing Assistant helps you rewrite messages in a clear, neutral tone. 
COORDINATE YOUR CALENDAR 
• Create a parenting time schedule (or custody schedule) 
The color-coded schedule shows what’s coming up, including events, holidays, and drop-offs/pick-ups. 
• Encourage reliability 
When everyone shares the same Calendar, mix-ups are a thing of the past. 
• Schedule Change Requests 
Need to make a one-time change to the schedule? Adjust the Calendar with an easy form. 
STREAMLINE YOUR EXPENSES 
• Simplify the math 
Keep clear, secure records of your co-parenting expenses and receipts. 
• Customize categories 
Create new categories, with your own percentage splits. 
• Centralize everything 
With OFWpay, you can reimburse your co-parent in the app—and you can even make scheduled payments for child support. (Or record payments via another method.) 
KEEP A MEANINGFUL JOURNAL 
• Log when you arrive 
Verify your presence at drop-offs and pick-ups with GPS Check-Ins. 
• Capture memories 
Record parenting observations and special, close moments with photos and text. 
SHARE INFO ABOUT YOUR KIDS 
• Store essential details 
Share and view medical records, clothing sizes, school information, and more. 
• Minimize messaging 
No need to message your co-parent for basic stuff—just check the Info Bank. 
DOCUMENTATION AND REPORTS 
If you need to go to court or mediation, quick and simple documentation will make your life easier. It only takes a couple minutes on the website to customize and download a report from any app feature. 
GRANT YOUR PROS ACCESS 
With your permission and a Practitioner Account, your family law pro can view all app activity, help you manage the practical details, and quickly download reports—which potentially reduces your legal fees. Available for: 
Lawyers 
Mediators 
Parenting coordinators 
Guardians ad litem 
Therapists 
KEEP EVERYONE ON THE SAME PAGE 
OurFamilyWizard helps you coordinate with your co-parent, but you can also add accounts for your kids and anyone involved in childcare. (These accounts can only view limited features.) 
HAVE ANY QUESTIONS? 
Our customer service and tech support are available 7 days a week—contact us via phone, chat, or email. We’d love to help. 
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00046701:ios.description:
A place of fun and excitement! Instant gameplay brings the cheers of revelers at the Oktoberfest. Aim, throw, and throw the darts on the dartboard to catch every throw.
The game refers to the 501 rule, and the first one to deduct 501 points to 0 points is the winner and wins the grand prize!
-There are five rounds in total, and each round has three scoring opportunities.
-If the score after deduction is negative, the game is over.
-Every time you participate in the dart game, you need to pay an entrance fee, so take advantage of every opportunity to throw darts and enjoy the tension of throwing darts!
It's not just darts, we also offer slots for entertainment - after all, this is a pub, so enjoy!

bluejetty:00072995:ios.description:
Playing dentist is so much fun! Welcome to your own little dentist clinic, where you can learn how to take care of teeth and help cute patients feel happy and confident again.
In this dentist game, you become a real tooth doctor and treat adorable patients who come to your clinic every day. Clean dirty teeth, remove plaque, fill cavities, and fix broken teeth step by step. Use different dentist tools and complete simple dental procedures to make every smile shine bright and healthy.
Your patients are already waiting for help! Each one has unique teeth problems that need your attention and care. Follow easy instructions, use the right tools, and enjoy the process of dental treatment in a friendly and playful way. The gameplay is simple, intuitive, and perfect for kids.
After helping your patients, you will earn coins for your good work. You can use these coins to take care of another fun part of the game — your clinic aquarium. The aquarium starts empty and needs decoration. Add beautiful shells, colorful plants, and cute little fish to make your dentist clinic cozy and cheerful. A well-decorated aquarium makes the clinic feel warm and welcoming.
Game features:
• Dentist game with simple and clear gameplay
• Teeth cleaning, cavity filling, and tooth treatment
• Cute patients and friendly characters
• Easy-to-use dentist tools
• Coins and rewards for completed treatments
• A customizable aquarium to decorate
• Bright graphics and kid-friendly design
This dentist game combines fun gameplay with light educational elements. It helps children understand the importance of dental care, tooth brushing, and visiting the dentist regularly, all without fear or stress.
Put on your dentist coat, pick up your tools, and start helping your patients today. Download the game and enjoy fun dentist games with tooth care, cleaning, and treatment!

bluejetty:00174540:ios.description:
WELCOME TO THE FUNNIEST FITNESS APP EVER!
SALE! Get all awesome workouts with great discount only this weekend!
Are you tired of boring workout apps that all look the same?
Do you want something new, positive, and different?
Do you not have time or desire to go to the gym?
We love healthy living, so we've created an app for people who:
- want to have fun exercising and not to quit after the second workout
- want to keep track of their progress and finally start working out on a regular basis
- want to and are able to set aside at least a few minutes a day to exercise without sacrificing their efficiency
- don't like ads (that's right, there are no in-app advertisements! Seriously, none at all - just exercises!)
A few fun facts about the app:
- the Lazy Monster can do 30 different exercises
- no exercise machines or equipment
- you can plan your workouts and track your progress
- 10 manually crafted workouts
- you can create your own workouts
- a great selection of fun music that will make exercising a blast!
- saves information to the Health app
Integration with Apple Health app:
Apple Health data can be synchronized with the app – burned calories can be sent to Health app.
Information about the auto-renewal of subscription:
– Subscription with a free trial period will be automatically renewed to a paid subscription
– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
– Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
Types of subscription plans:
– 1-week subscription
– 3-month subscription
– 1-year subscription
Please note that you must always consult with a doctor before committing to any kind of fitness training program. The app is being developed solely for informational purposes.
Give it a try! Download the app, select one of the bumping musical tracks, and start working out with the most positive fitness app on the App Store!
If you've got an idea about how to make the app better or a problem that requires some help from our development team, contact us at lazymonstersteam@gmail.com and we'll be happy to chat. :)
Privacy Policy: http://bit.ly/PoPLM
Terms of Use: http://bit.ly/ToULM

bluejetty:00167265:ios.name: 97.5 WOKQ Radio
bluejetty:00167265:ios.summary: Get the latest news and information, weather coverage and traffic updates in the Portsmouth area with the 97.5 WOKQ app! Listen to the station live and interact with the hosts – you can direct message and call the show directly from the app
bluejetty:00167265:ios.description:
Get the latest news and information, weather coverage and traffic updates in the Portsmouth area with the 97.5 WOKQ app! Listen to the station live and interact with the hosts – you can direct message and call the show directly from the app. Receive alerts about breaking news, contests, and more before anyone else. Save articles and viral stories for reading later, and share on Facebook and Twitter.
Key Features:
• Listen to our shows, plus receive weather and traffic updates live from 97.5 WOKQ Radio
• Read the latest news, watch videos, view photo galleries & listen to audio content
• Submit Photos/Videos directly from the app
• Participate in contests and giveaways, plus get exclusive access to station scavenger hunts
• Apple CarPlay lets you to stay focused on the road while listening
• Get the latest weather for your area plus a 5-day forecast
• Do not disturb modes for alerts (weekend and after hours)
• Save articles for reading later (supports offline viewing)
• Instant Alerts for breaking news, weather, contests, shows and more
• Featured full multi-tasking with background audio and controls
• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the 97.5 WOKQ app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the 97.5 WOKQ app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00172109:ios.description:
Serve. Share. Inspire. Repeat.
That's the simple philosophy behind MobileServe. 
What is MobileServe?
MobileServe is a mobile app that helps organizations and individuals measure and communicate their social impact. By tracking an individual’s service, our app is able to produce compelling infographics for marketing and communication purposes. Our product is geared towards companies, non-profit entities, universities, and Greek organizations, all of who could benefit by demonstrating their social impact.
How does it work?
The idea is simple. While users are doing good, MobileServe lets them use their phones to report and measure their service. Simple integration with social media lets you leverage users' personal networks to promote organizations and causes. User data is aggregated and translated into catchy infographics and pictures that can be used for organizational communication.

Car Auto Play: Connect & Sync is the premier wireless solution for drivers who want a smarter, safer, and more connected
bluejetty:00037077:ios.description:
Are you looking to simplify your driving experience? Do you want a smarter, safer way to stay connected with your car?
Car Auto Play: Connect & Sync is the premier wireless solution for drivers who want a smarter, safer, and more connected driving experience. If your car does not have a built-in display, our app transforms your iPhone into a high-end smart dashboard or HUD (Heads-up Display).
Trusted by 10,000,000+ drivers worldwide, we redefine road convenience by bringing all your essential driving tools into one elegant, distraction-free dash interface.
KEY FEATURES:
- Smart Wireless Dashboard: Get the iconic smart interface directly on your mobile screen. Access your maps, music, and navigation with large, tap-friendly icons designed for use while driving.
- CarPlay & Custom Car Widgets: Personalize your CarPlay and mobile screen with custom car widgets! Choose from a wide gallery of photos or upload your own to create a unique CarPlay dashboard. 
- Precision GPS Speedometer: Track your real-time speed with a professional-grade speedometer. Includes customizable dash themes and speed limit alerts to keep you safe.
- Music with Live Lyrics: Connect your favorite music services and view real-time lyrics directly on your dashboard for a better in-car entertainment experience.
- Advanced VIN Scanner: Instantly decode any VIN to access detailed vehicle history and specifications. Perfect for owners and buyers needing a quick car check.
- Seamless Car Management: Manage your entire garage in one link. Track maintenance for major brands like Ford, Chevy, Ram, Jeep, Dodge, and GMC.
- Safe Driving Mode: One-tap activation to minimize distractions. Stay connected to your auto tools while keeping your eyes firmly on the road.
Compatible with most popular vehicle brands, including Ford, Chevrolet, Ram, Jeep, Dodge, GMC, Toyota, Honda, Nissan, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Volkswagen, Volvo, and more. Just mount your phone, open the app, and start your smart sync.
Download Car Auto Play: Connect & Sync and upgrade your car technology today!
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase.
- Subscriptions will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal cost will be charged to your account 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
DISCLAIMER
We are not affiliated with the mentioned companies in any way. We have only developed and tested our App with these devices.
Policy Privacy: https://5skay.blogspot.com/2020/10/privacy-policy_29.html
Terms of service: https://5skay.blogspot.com/2020/10/terms-conditions_29.html

bluejetty:00159415:ios.summary:

Step into the world of Robot Run, where young players can embark on an epic journey through 6 captivating adventure scenes, ranging from bustling factory docks to icy deserts. Each scene i
bluejetty:00159415:ios.description:
Explore Thrilling Adventures Across 6 Unique Scenes
Step into the world of Robot Run, where young players can embark on an epic journey through 6 captivating adventure scenes, ranging from bustling factory docks to icy deserts. Each scene is brimming with excitement and fun, providing a perfect backdrop for an exhilarating running game experience. With 36 meticulously designed running and combat levels, children will face a progressive challenge, starting from simple running obstacles and advancing to intense BOSS battles. Every level in Robot Run is a new adventure, showcasing diverse landscapes and thrilling obstacles that will keep kids engaged.
Unlock 20 Unique Mechs with Distinctive Styles
In Robot Run, players can unlock and collect 20 uniquely styled mechs. Whether your child prefers the sleek appearance of futuristic technology or the playful charm of cartoon robots, there's a mech to match every preference. These customizable robots not only enhance the running game experience but also allow children to express their individuality as they journey through each level.
Gripping Storyline that Adds Depth to the Adventure
Robot Run offers more than just a typical running game for kids; it features an exciting storyline that will captivate young players. Each themed scene introduces a formidable BOSS character piloting a flying mech, who wreaks havoc on machinery before escaping. Players must chase these BOSSes through a series of challenging levels, ultimately confronting them in epic battles. This unfolding narrative adds tension and excitement, making every adventure in Robot Run an unforgettable experience.
Exciting and Stimulating Running Game Experience
Robot Run delivers an exhilarating running experience. Control your mech as it jumps, dodges obstacles, leaps over chasms, and smashes through objects, providing endless thrills. As the levels progress, the difficulty increases, ensuring that players remain fully engaged in this family-friendly robot adventure.
Simple and Intuitive Controls for All Ages
Robot Run features easy-to-learn controls, making it accessible to kids of all ages. A simple tap on the screen allows the mech to jump, making it an ideal choice for younger players, including toddlers. Despite its straightforward controls, Robot Run offers rich content and challenging gameplay, ensuring hours of fun for children.
Key Features
• 6 Unique Adventure Scenes and 36 Running Combat Levels: Each level offers a new challenge, blending running and combat for a truly engaging experience.
• 20 Distinctive Mechs: Collect and customize 20 different mechs, each with its own unique style, perfect for kids who love robot games.
• Engaging Storyline: A captivating narrative that keeps kids excited and eager to progress through the game.
• Thrilling Running Experience: Fast-paced and challenging gameplay that tests reflexes and keeps kids entertained.
• Offline Play Available: Enjoy Robot Run anywhere, anytime, without the need for an internet connection.
• Third-Party-Ad-Free Experience: No third-party ads, ensuring a safe and uninterrupted play experience for children.
Whether your child is a fan of running games, robot games, or adventure stories, Robot Run offers something for everyone. Download Robot Run now and start your child's journey in the ultimate family-friendly robot adventure!
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00095686:ios.description:
Tired of boring clickers? Cut through stacks of cash with powerful money-cutting stamps, merge them into stronger machines, and watch your fortune grow even while you’re AFK or offline.
 It’s the perfect blend of satisfying slicing, idle gameplay, and merge tycoon fun.
 Game Features
• Idle Rewards – Your factory keeps printing cash even when you’re AFK.
• Merge Machines – Combine stamps to unlock stronger money-makers.
• Tap to Earn – Speed up your income and boost profits with every tap.
• Ball Frenzy Challenge – Drop money balls for extra multipliers and rewards.
• Tycoon Progression – Upgrade, merge, and expand your idle empire.
• Task System – Complete daily and progressive goals like Add, Merge, Earn, Spend, Reach, and Boost to earn extra rewards!
• Character Evolution – Watch your worker transform from poor to rich as you level up! Experience stunning visual progression with every milestone.
• Addictive Gameplay – The perfect mix of idle, merge, clicker, and tycoon mechanics.
• Bonus Trend Modes – Try Plinko and Money Drop for surprise bonuses!
Whether you love idle games, merge games, or clicker tycoon simulators,
Idle Cash – Merge Tycoon gives you everything in one satisfying package.
Grow your empire, collect rewards, and see how rich you can become!
Download now and start your idle money adventure today!

bluejetty:00041311:ios.description:
Explore African culture - and develop language skills! Learn Akan Twi, Yoruba, Igbo, Swahili, Ga & more.
Dialogue Africa provides a black-owned ed-tech platform to help you connect to your roots and navigate African spaces.
We currently cover many cultures - in places like Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, Zimbabwe, etc. - and prepare you for real-world interactions in Africa & African communities near you!
Join the community now to access free, fun lessons and learn Akan Twi, Yoruba, Swahili, Ga, Igbo, Somali, Shona, and more.
====== FEATURES & EXPANSION ======
Dialogue Africa allows users to:
- Learn at their own pace
- Track and build on saved progress
- Access multiple cultures & languages
- Access a growing list of courses
- Improve cultural IQ
- Learn useful phrases, vocab & grammar
- Practice language skills in a safe space
- Learn proverbs & their meanings
- Freely access a wide range of topics & categories
- Have fun with gamified learning, skill trees & point systems
We are expanding to include the major cultures and languages across the African continent - such as Moore, Ewe, Amharic, Wolof, Hausa, Xhosa, Kinyarwanda, and more. Sign up & tell us which culture of interest/language you want to see.
Our crowdsourced approach means users can support our experts and contribute in several ways e.g. suggesting corrections, adding vocabulary, signing up to help build lessons, and sharing stories!
======= CULTURE & DIALOGUE =======
We believe a deeper cultural understanding sets the stage for meaningful dialogue and stronger connections.
Rekindle your African spirit, join this African journey & grow with us!
"I am not African because I was born in Africa, but because Africa was born in me" - Osagyefo Dr. Kwame Nkrumah
========= TERMS & PRIVACY =========
Privacy policy: https://www.dialogue-africa.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of use: https://www.dialogue-africa.com/terms-and-conditions.html

bluejetty:00144552:ios.description:
VetGuide is your essential partner in everyday veterinary practice, supporting your clinical decisions for small animals, livestock and exotic animals. More than 3000 referenced texts covering clinical pathology, infectious diseases, surgery, vaccines, calculators, nutrition and emergency medicine, right in the palm of your hand.
*** NEW: AI ASSISTANT ***
Chat with an assistant that knows the VetGuide library:
• Ask about a clinical case and get an organized answer, with VetGuide sources you can check.
• Send a photo or PDF of lab results and lesions along with your question.
• Dictate your question by voice, no typing needed.
• Pick up previous conversations from your history.
The AI Assistant supports clinical decision-making and does not replace the veterinarian's judgment.
MORE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
• Quick consult: describe the case and get suggestions for differential diagnoses, diagnostic tests and initial management, saving time on every case.
• Patient and visit management: record patient files and consultations and check the complete history right from your phone. No more lost paperwork!
• Automatic clinical summary: AI creates a summary of each patient from the recorded visits, for a quick, organized view of the history.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE PLACE
• High-quality content: materials developed by specialists in each field, based on the best bibliographic references. Our mission is to contribute to high-level veterinary medicine.
• Favorites in your account: save the content you use most and find it whenever you need it.
• Constant updates: our team continuously reviews and adds new content, and you get it all through the app's content update.
ALWAYS AT HAND
• Easy to use: find what you need quickly.
• Offline access: all content works without an internet connection. The AI Assistant and quick consult require a connection.
• Straight to the point: concise texts with images and videos for easier understanding.
• More speed: open the app, search the topic and get the answer you need.
CONTACT US
If you have questions or suggestions, use the contact option inside the app.
SUBSCRIPTION PLAN
Monthly auto-renewable plan.
You can cancel at any time.
Ready to transform your veterinary practice with VetGuide and artificial intelligence? Download now and get the knowledge and management tools you need in the palm of your hand!

bluejetty:00126688:ios.description:
Jazz 91.9 WCLK Public Radio App:
The Jazz 91.9 WCLK Public Radio App allows you to listen to Jazz 91.9 WCLK, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for Jazz 91.9 WCLK all at once! You can explore and listen to On Demand content whenever you want, share stories with your friends and wake up to Jazz 91.9 WCLK with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from Jazz 91.9 WCLK 3 HD channels even while traveling! HD1 for Contemporary Jazz, HD2 for Mainstream/Classic Jazz or HD3 to listen to Clark Atlanta University Students in Training.
Start the app and your favorite station starts playing.
• Integrated program schedules for the Jazz 91.9 WCLK streams!
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to Jazz 91.9 WCLK in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access Jazz 91.9 WCLK’s past programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease.
• When listening to programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• The Jazz 91.9 WCLK Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The Jazz 91.9 WCLK Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at Jazz 91.9 WCLK, Clark Atlanta University and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, on whatever device you have!
Jazz 91.9 WCLK is a non-profit NPR Public Radio Station licensed to Clark Atlanta University. Please support Jazz 91.9 WCLK Public Radio by becoming a member with your donation today!

bluejetty:00013947:ios.description:
With the Citizens Bank of Ada Mobile Banking App, you can bring the bank to you by safely and securely accessing your accounts anytime, anywhere! The Citizens Bank of Ada Mobile App is available to all Citizens Bank of Ada customers. Accessing the Citizens Bank of Ada Mobile Banking app is easy--simply use the same Internet Banking login information established for your current Internet Banking account or, if you're a new user, register a new login by selecting the button "New Users Tap Here."
MAKE A DEPOSIT
Securely deposit checks anytime, anywhere with your device's camera! Deposits are subject to verification and are not available for immediate withdrawal.
PICTURE PAY
Pay your bills securely anytime with Citizens Bank of Ada Picture Pay. Take a picture of your bill with your device's camera, set the pay date, confirm payment information, and submit your payment. No more going to the Post Office!
DEBIT CARD ACTIVIATION
Misplaced your card? Stolen card? No problem! The Citizens Bank of Ada Mobile App gives you the ability to deactivate/activate your debit card with the touch of your finger.
OTHER FEATURES INCLUDE:
• View your balance
• View account history
• View check images
• View account statements
• Transfer funds
• Pay a friend
• Pay bills
• Security alerts
• Create account nicknames
• Locate a Branch or ATM
We are committed to protecting the privacy of your financial information. See our Privacy Policy on our website at www.citizensada.bank.
There is no fee for this app from Citizens Bank of Ada. Connectivity and data usage rates may apply. Contact your wireless service provider for more information.
Member FDIC

bluejetty:00174747:ios.description:
Are you struggling to stay on top of tasks and appointments? Is it difficult to meet deadlines, even when you know they're important? Does a lack of organization leave you feeling overwhelmed and unaccomplished?
Conquer the chaos and embrace a more focused and organized life with Clarify, the ultimate time management app designed for individuals who struggle with focus, time blindness, and executive functioning, or anyone who wants to improve their executive functioning skills.
In a world buzzing with distractions, where time slips away like sand through your fingers, you're about to embark on the quest of a lifetime. You're setting out to conquer what many deem impossible, mastering the realms of focus and time management.
Do you find you have problems with:
- Focus?
- Procrastination?
- Starting tasks?
- Follow through?
- Relationships?
- Organization?
- Impulse control?
Many adults face challenges with these and more every day. Yet you hold within you a secret energy source, a strength that comes from your unique mind. In Clarify, you will transform your life, not by working against how your brain works, but through its very power.
YOUR FOCUS KEEPER
Through personalized goal-setting, tailored strategies, and expert guidance, we empower you to take charge of your time and routines to create more productive days.
Here's what you can expect:
- Find Focus: Work with your unique mind to develop strategies for greater productivity
- Tune In: Learn how to identify and reduce distractions
- Overcome Procrastination: Explore ways to gamify your To-Do list to effortlessly complete tasks
- Skills and Routines: Sculpt your daily routine to sustain long-term growth
- Big Picture: Unleash your true self, embrace your individuality, and let yourself flourish
DESIGN YOUR DAY FOR SUCCESS
POWERFUL TOOLS: Boost your productivity and enhance your time management skills with customizable To-Do lists, immersive focus mode, and progress trackers. Clarify equips you to stay on top of your busy schedule.
EXPERT GUIDANCE: Access evidence-based techniques specifically curated for individuals who struggle with focus and executive functioning. Our team, including psychologists and coaches, is dedicated to providing you with the most effective strategies for managing distraction, procrastination, and organizational challenges, and maximizing your potential.
PERSONALIZED APPROACH: We understand that everyone's experience with focus and organization is unique. Clarify tailors its features and recommendations to your preferences. By adapting to your needs, our app ensures a personalized experience.
WHO WE ARE
Clarify is brought to you by the creators of Fabulous, an award-winning app featured on Lifehacker, the New York Times, Self, Forbes, and more. Through our apps, we've empowered millions of people worldwide to change their lives for the better. Dare to unleash your superpower. Unlock your full potential. It's time to Clarify.
MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
User acknowledges that the information in the app is provided "as is" and for general information only. It is not intended as medical advice and should not be relied upon as a substitute for professional consultation with a qualified healthcare provider familiar with your individual medical needs.
App includes a subscription. Pricing in different countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. You can always see the exact price in the app. The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your App Store Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. When you feel the Premium plan is not what you need, you can cancel your subscription at any time.

bluejetty:00065952:ios.description:
Doug is a Dwarf. Doug loves digging. Well, actually he doesn't: what he likes is to find buried treasure. Anyway, one day Doug decided to gather as much treasure from as deep under the earth as he could go. So Doug dug. And he dug. And he fought monsters and avoided massive avalanches of falling rock. And then he dug some more. And he picked up lots of bling.
Now it's your turn. Help Doug dig deep down under the earth in the quest for shimmering jewels and precious gold. Go farther and deeper than any of your friends. Find more gold than anyone in the world. Oh but watch out for colossal cave-ins. No they're really colossal—you won't believe it. And creepy monsters. And bottomless pits. Ah, don't worry it's just a game.
Do you like Spelunky? Dig Dug? Well c'mon you like Minecraft don't you? Well then you'll like this. Plus it's cheaper. And better. Plus your friends are playing it and you don't want to be left out, do you? Or maybe no one is playing it, in which case you'll be the one who introduces all your friends to "Doug dug." Then everyone will say, "Hey look there goes *your name here* who introduced us to 'Doug dug' and who is therefore cooler than the rest of us because he/she discovered it first." One of those two great options is bound to happen.
So what are you waiting for?
Doug dug. Will you?
Visit http://youtu.be/GZazFfw_O7A to see how it plays.

bluejetty:00129443:ios.summary: Advanced 21 Blackjack is the most realistic, free way to play twenty-one without setting foot in a casino. With customizable table rules, graphics, and play styles, this blackjack game provides thousands of hours of playtime, strategy build
bluejetty:00129443:ios.description:
Advanced 21 Blackjack is the most realistic, free way to play twenty-one without setting foot in a casino. With customizable table rules, graphics, and play styles, this blackjack game provides thousands of hours of playtime, strategy building, and fun!
Advanced 21 Blackjack puts you in complete control of your play experience, including:
- Deck shoe size (1 to 8 decks)
- Blackjack payout ratio
- Surrender options
- Rules for splitting after doubling down
- Dealer behavior on soft 17
- Pay on push
- Automatic-winner Charlie rules
Make the game your own while practicing new betting strategies, table positioning, and basic blackjack strategy:
- Play at up to 6 seat positions simultaneously 
- Have computer players randomly come and go, simulating a real casino experience
- Specify computer player positions if you wish, or turn them off completely
- Set the gameplay rules for auto-rebet, auto-stand, basic blackjack strategy suggestions, auto-decline for insurance, animation displays, and much more!
Continue to hone your skills with Advanced 21 Blackjack through table advancement, starting as “The Rookie” and earning your way to the “The Whale” table. Earn club points by completing achievements to unlock new graphics, including:
- Poker chip sets
- Card faces
- Card backs
- Table prints and bet-box designs
- Table pad colors and font textures
Want to make suggestions on Advanced 21 Blackjack or report an issue? Contact us at advanced21@basement.software. Thanks!
Please Note: Advanced 21 Blackjack is free to download and play, however, some options are available through in-app purchases. If you do not want to use this feature, please set up password protection or disable in-app purchases within the app store.
A network connection is required to play Advanced 21 Blackjack.
This free blackjack app is intended for adult audiences and does not offer any real money gambling or any opportunities to win real money or prices. Any success within Advanced 21 Blackjack does not imply any future success in real money casinos or gambling.
Gambling addiction is real. If you or someone you know may be addicted to gambling, call or visit your local gambling helpline.

bluejetty:00141479:ios.description:
Professional Document Generation in Seconds
Legal Draft is a professional-grade legal document generation platform designed to streamline the creation of high-quality, jurisdiction-specific contracts and agreements. Generate fully customized legal documents in under 30 seconds—saving both time and resources without compromising on precision.
User Feedback
“No More Headache!” – 5 STARS
“This application is intuitive, efficient, and significantly reduces the effort traditionally required for legal drafting. Its privacy policy outperforms the majority of competing apps. Highly recommended.”
— Jamboreeze
“First Draft Was GREAT” – 5 STARS
“As a newcomer to the legal industry, I was impressed by the comprehensive output produced from a minimal input. Highly capable tool for rapid prototyping of legal drafts.”
— DisruptingTheMatrix
Key Features
 • Rapid Document Creation: Generate enforceable legal documents in under 30 seconds.
 • Multi-Format Export: Export documents in DOCX, PDF, HTML, or plain text for compatibility across platforms.
 • Custom Clause Editor: Insert or modify clauses to meet specific legal or organizational requirements.
 • Jurisdiction-Optimized: Tailor documents to meet the legal standards of your selected jurisdiction.
 • Dynamic Legal Updates: Automatically reflects the latest changes in legal regulations to ensure ongoing compliance.
 • Import Existing Contracts: Seamlessly upload and incorporate existing contracts for editing, review, or versioning.
 • Contextual Drafting: Add existing documents as contextual inputs when generating new documents to ensure continuity and relevance.
 • Language Style Adjustment: Select preferred drafting tone—from plain language to formal and technical—based on your use case.
 • Cost-Effective Alternative: Eliminate the need for costly legal consultations for standard documentation.
Why Choose Legal Draft?
 • Professional Interface: A clean, intuitive UI designed for legal professionals and non-lawyers alike.
 • Extensive Document Library: Access legally vetted templates for contracts, NDAs, leases, wills, and more.
 • Advanced Security: Industry-grade encryption and data handling protocols to ensure confidentiality and data protection.
 • Continuous Enhancements: Regular feature rollouts and improvements based on user feedback and legal best practices.
Supported Document Types
 • Last Will and Testament
 • Power of Attorney
 • Lease/Rental Agreements
 • Employment Contracts
 • Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)
 • Letters of Demand
 • And many more frequently used legal templates
Disclaimer
Legal Draft provides a powerful tool for creating high-quality legal documents. However, it is recommended to have documents reviewed by a qualified legal professional to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and specific circumstances.

bluejetty:00169485:ios.name: Innerworld: mental health help
bluejetty:00169485:ios.summary: Innerworld is an award-winning mental health program that has helped more than 100,000 people. You'll get life-changing tools to help with your toughest challenges, alongside a supportive community of people who understand what you're going
bluejetty:00169485:ios.description:
Innerworld is an award-winning mental health program that has helped more than 100,000 people. You'll get life-changing tools to help with your toughest challenges, alongside a supportive community of people who understand what you're going through. Attend any of the more than 100 support groups led by trained Guides on stress, anxiety, depression, ADHD, and more.
You’ll learn proven, science-based skills in an immersive environment — we call this Cognitive Behavioral Immersion™ (CBI). These tools will help you manage daily anxiety, relieve stress, combat depression, address loneliness, improve your overall mental health, and more. Innerworld delivers results similar to therapy — at a fraction of the cost. 
About Innerworld:
BE WITH PEOPLE WHO GET YOU
At the heart of Innerworld is community. People from all over the globe connecting, healing and growing. Together.
REMAIN ANONYMOUS
Create an avatar and share your story without having to share your face.
ATTEND UNLIMITED MENTAL HEALTH EVENTS
Join any of 100+ live anonymous group events each week, all led by trained Guides. Event topics include stress, worry, general anxiety, health anxiety, depression, relationships, parenting, grief, loss, ADHD, trauma, addiction, mindfulness, and more. You can also attend meditations, social events, or get creative in the art gallery. There’s no limit to the number of events you can attend.
ACCESS TRAINED MENTAL HEALTH GUIDES
Innerworld Guides have gone through extensive training to teach you the skills of Cognitive Behavioral Immersion™ (CBI) — science based tools delivered in immersive environments. They have weekly supervisions and professional development to support people in a variety of situations.
LEARN TOOLS
Learn evidence-based tools you can use in the real world. Get introduced to CBI and start your journey to healing and growing.
EXPERIENCE BEAUTIFUL VIRTUAL WORLDS
Explore our immersive worlds: a sandy beach, a dreamy maze, a restful retreat, a connecting campfire and more.
FEATURES
- Accessible anywhere, anytime
- Attend unlimited daily mental health group events - over 100 per week, each with personalized instruction from a trained Guide
- Take a quiz to get matched with events that are right for you
- Get personalized, intimate support
- Event Series - Attend courses on managing depression, anxiety, ADHD, and more.
- Learn proven science-based tools of cognitive-behavior therapy: Emotions Wheel, Clear Mind, Lifestyle Balance, Grief Cycle, Assertiveness Curve, Chain Analysis, Thought Record, Pro Con Chart, Wise Mind, Values Goals, Cognitive Behavior Model, STOP, Stages of Change, Yerkes-Dodson, CBA, Hierarchy of Values, DEARMAN, Hula Hoop, and more.
- Journaling - Keep a daily mood journal and capture tools, strategies, and ideas that you can always return to
- 24/7 live support
- Connect with emojis - Easily express your emotions with emoji bursts
- Social Games - Play Connect 4, Dots, 3D Tic-Tac-Toe, Pictionary, and more
- Drawing / Art - Relax and get creative
- Personalized username - Create an anonymous name or have us generate one for you
- Customizable avatars - Over 10,000 unique combinations
- Innerworld’s 5-point safety system: Community guidelines, Guardians, therapist supervision, proactive AI safety net, adults only
Join a warm, welcoming community of people from all walks of life dedicated to improving their mental health. Troll-free, stigma-free, and accessible 24/7.
https://inner.world/privacy

bluejetty:00073226:ios.name: Cozy Emoji: Onet Mahjong Tiles
bluejetty:00073226:ios.summary: Cozy Emoji: Pair Match brings a fresh, relaxing experience to classic Onet line-connecting and tile-matching puzzles. Clear beautifully designed board layouts, unlock vibrant natural scenery backgrounds, and enjoy satisfying daily mental ex
bluejetty:00073226:ios.description:
Cozy Emoji: Pair Match brings a fresh, relaxing experience to classic Onet line-connecting and tile-matching puzzles. Clear beautifully designed board layouts, unlock vibrant natural scenery backgrounds, and enjoy satisfying daily mental exercise at your own peaceful pace.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE COZY EMOJI
• 1,500+ Unique Levels: Endless pair-matching puzzles with daily challenges and special seasonal event updates.
• Beautiful Artwork Collections: Match well-crafted tile sets featuring nature, animals, flowers, delicious food, and fun emojis.
• Unlock Wallpaper Backgrounds: Earn stars to collect serene landscape backgrounds that you can save and use as your device wallpaper.
• Relaxing Brain Training: Just 5 minutes of daily play helps improve memory, focus, and concentration while providing anxiety relief.
• Play Anywhere, Anytime: Lightweight design that saves storage and battery life with full offline support—no Wi-Fi connection required.
EXCITING GAMEPLAY & BOOSTERS
• Classic Onet Mechanics: Connect matching tile pairs with 3 or fewer straight lines before time runs out.
• Multiple Boards: Clear consecutive tile layers to earn 3-star level completions.
• Special Hazard Tiles: Defuse ticking Bomb Tiles before they explode, and race against the clock in Timer Levels.
• Power-Up Items: Match Firecracker Tiles to automatically clear extra pairs, or match Dandelions to expand your board.
• Essential Boosters: Use Shuffle, Hint, and special movements to solve tricky grid arrangements.
FAIR FREE-TO-PLAY EXPERIENCE
• No Gameplay Interruptions: Zero mid-roll ad popups during active puzzle play—watching rewarded ads is always 100% voluntary.
• One-Time Ad Removal: Support independent development and enjoy a permanently ad-free experience for the price of a single cup of coffee.
• Apple Ecosystem Ready: Full support for iPhone, iPad, and Game Center leaderboards to connect with friends.
Download Cozy Emoji today to reset your mind, sharpen your memory, and enjoy the ultimate cozy tile connect puzzle!

• تحديثات مستمرة: ابقوا على اطلاع بآخر أخبار فرق النادي المختلفة؛ الرجال، الشباب والأكاديمية.
• المحتوى المرئي: استمتعوا بمشاهدة لقطات حصرية من المباريات، واطلعوا على الكواليس وجلسات التدريب، بالإضافة إلى المقابلات الحصرية مع اللاعبين والإداريين.
• حصريات : أهداف، أبرز الأحداث، فيديوهات خلف الكواليس، مقاطع كلاسيكية، لقطات فريدة للاعبينا... تجربة الأهلي بشكل لم تعهده من قبل في مقاطع فيديو قصيرة عمودية!
• استطلاع الرائ : من كان رجل المباراة؟ من تعتقد أنه يجب أن يبدأ اللعب في المباراة القادمة؟ عبر عن رأيك وشارك في استطلاعات النادي الرسمية لترى ما يعتقد الآخرون.
• التقييم : فرصة تقييم اللاعبين والمدرب بعد نهاية كل مباراة. هذه الميزة تمكن المشجعين من التعبير عن آرائهم حول أداء كل لاعب واستراتيجيات المدرب، مما يوفر تفاعلًا مباشرًا وديناميكيًا بين النادي وجمهوره. 
• المباريات الحية: تابعوا كل لحظة مع مركز المباريات المتطور الذي يشمل التشكيلات، التحديثات النصية اللحظية، والإحصاءات.
• المسابقات:اختبر معرفتك بالأهلي وتحدى أصدقائك , هل تعتقد أنك تعرف كل شيء عن الأهلي؟ شارك في مسابقاتنا اليومية وأثبت أنك المشجع الأكبر!
• جدول المباريات: تابعوا جميع أنشطة النادي وفئاته المختلفة.
• الإشعارات: كونوا على اطلاع دائم بأحدث الأخبار ولا تفوتوا أي جديد في أيام المباريات.
• الأنشطة الثقافية: ينظم النادي فعاليات ثقافية متنوعة تشمل معارض فنية، ورش عمل، ومحاضرات تساهم في تثقيف وإلهام الجماهير والمجتمع المحلي.
• الأنشطة الاجتماعية: يلتزم النادي بتعزيز الروابط الاجتماعية من خلال تنظيم فعاليات تجمع بين الأعضاء والمشجعين في أجواء تشجع على التواصل والتآزر.
قريبًا: منتدى ومتجر النادي
• منتدى النادي: قريبًا، سيتمكن المشجعون من المشاركة في منتدى النادي، مما يوفر مساحة للنقاشات وتبادل الأفكار حول كل ما يتعلق بالأهلي.
• متجر النادي: استعدوا لتجربة تسوق فريدة من نوعها في متجر النادي القادم، حيث ستجدون كل ما يخص الأهلي من ملابس رياضية، تذكارات، والمزيد.
حمّلوا التطبيق الآن وانغمسوا في كل ما يتعلق بنادي الأهلي، حيث التاريخ والإنجاز يلتقيان لتقديم تجربة فريدة من نوعها لمشجعي النادي، معززة بالتزام عميق بالقيم الثقافية والاجتماعية التي تشكل جوهر المجتمع الليبي

bluejetty:00044446:ios.description:
Disney+ subscribers can experience the short film Remembering in a whole new way! Remembering: The AR Experience is a first-of-its-kind companion augmented reality app that lets Disney+ subscribers extend The World of Imagination into their living room.
Now streaming on Disney+, Remembering is an original short film directed by
Elijah Allan-Blitz and starring Brie Larson. It’s the story of a writer who loses touch with her creative essence and the captivating journey one idea takes to reunite with her. Guided by a mysterious child, the idea travels through a
magical world where anything imagined, dreamed or wished is
brought to life. It‘s easy to lose touch with this world, but each of us
can be inspired by it—if we just remember.
With this immersive augmented reality app, Disney+ subscribers can become a part of the story like never before. Use an iPhone or iPad to step into this magical world and rediscover the creative spirit that lives within each of us.
Remember—with a little imagination, anything is possible!
NOTE: For the best experience, we recommend using this app on an iPhone 12 Pro or Pro Max (and above), an iPad Pro 12.9” 4th Gen (and above) or an iPad Pro 11” 2nd Gen (and above). As the app relies on cutting-edge technology, the experience is optimized for lidar-enabled devices, which excel at sensing the depth and contours of a physical space. It will still work on a range of other devices, but results may vary.

bluejetty:00171078:ios.description:
Praktika is your AI language tutor for real speaking practice. Have natural conversations with lifelike AI tutors who listen, respond, and correct you in real time, so you stop memorizing and start speaking.
Learn English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (European & Brazilian), Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Russian, Polish, and Dutch at any level, from your first word to fluent conversation.
WHY PRAKTIKA WORKS
Most language apps teach words in isolation. Praktika trains the skill that matters most: speaking. You practice out loud, get instant feedback, and build the confidence to use the language in real life.
WHAT YOU GET
- AI tutors that feel human: Each tutor has a distinct personality and accent (American, British, Latin American, and more) and adapts to your level, pace, and goals.
- Start in your native language: Your tutor explains things in the language you already speak, so beginners never feel lost.
- Pronunciation and fluency feedback: Know exactly what to improve after every conversation.
- Lessons for every goal: 1,000+ lessons for travel, careers, job interviews, business, everyday conversation, slang, and IELTS and TOEFL prep.
- Role-play real situations: Be a tourist, a startup founder, or a sports commentator, and practice the language you'll actually use.
- Learn from your own content: Upload photos, PDFs, videos, or voice notes and turn them into a lesson. Snap your surroundings to learn new words, or upload your resume to rehearse interview answers.
- Track your progress: Speaking metrics, streaks, and challenges show how far you've come.
- Practice anytime, judgment-free: Quick 5-minute chats or deep sessions, 24/7, with a tutor who is always patient.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a language and your goal.
2. Choose a tutor and a topic.
3. Start talking and get feedback as you go.
TOPICS YOU'LL EXPLORE
Travel, food, business, technology, startups, science, health, history, art, cinema, music, football, pop culture, relationships, the environment, and new topics every month.
LEARNING FOR YOUR TEAM?
Praktika also offers plans for companies. Learn more at praktika.ai/b2b
Free to download. Start your first conversation in minutes.
Support: support@praktika.ai
Terms: https://praktika.ai/terms

--- Radar Map ----

Customize animation speed, delay, radar opacity, and map type.
*Note: Precipitation Type imagery is currently experimental and may not accurately reflect the exact type of precipitation falling in your area. 
--- Radar Images ---
Select from a list of 31 stations nationwide and animate up to 100 images calibrated for either rain or snow. Visit the Environment Canada website for a detailed map of radar coverage in your area. 
*Note: Fort McMurray is not included since the overlay images were never produced by Environment Canada. Radar coverage in the Fort McMurray area is included in the Radar Map product.
--- Satellite ---
View satellite imagery from the GOES-19 weather satellite in visible light, infrared, and combined. Choose between the Meteorological Society of Canada (MSC) or the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) and animate up to 6 hours of imagery. Coverage includes all of Canada and most of the USA.
--- Charts ---
View Surface Analysis and Graphical Area Forecast (GFA) charts for all of Canada. The Surface Analysis is a snapshot of the current pressure and frontal systems across Canada. GFAs give you a 12-hour forecast of the expected pressure and frontal systems at a regional level, along with information such as expected precipitation, cloud height & coverage, turbulence, icing, and freezing level. While these charts are typically used by pilots, they offer an excellent look at the current weather systems in a given region.
Quickly switch between 0/+6/+12 GFA images and between "Clouds & Weather" and "Icing, Turbulence, & Freezing Level" images. You can also view GFA pairs side-by-side instead of having to switch between them.

bluejetty:00062810:ios.description:
Ultimate Intimacy is the ULTIMATE Marriage and Intimacy App for couples. The Ultimate Intimacy App is clean, non-graphic and so much fun, and because it is Christian-friendly, you wont find any nudity, or vulgar material.
**All content is respectful and in the context of a healthy marriage! **
The Ultimate Intimacy app is designed to help couples take their relationship and sexual intimacy to a whole new level! The Ultimate Intimacy App has several sections and resources including a customizable bedroom game where couples take turns asking questions and doing actions to each other, starting out with romance, then progressing to foreplay, heavy foreplay and hot and heavy.
The Ultimate Intimacy App is the ULTIMATE marriage app for married couples who:
* Are looking for a wholesome, clean and fulfilling way to spice to their marriage.
* Want to have an amazing intimate and sexual relationship.
* Want to have a better connection and draw closer to each other.
App Features:
* Incredibly fun Intimacy Game to help couples connect and enjoy each other in a very fun and exciting way! The game has 4 levels, which include Romance, Foreplay, Heavy Foreplay and Hot and Heavy. Couples take turns doing specific actions to each other. The game is completely customizable and personalized to fit your comfort level and preferences.
* Truth or Dare Bedroom Game
* Conversations Starters with topics such as marriage and intimacy, romance, finance, family, spiritual, and others to help couples open up fun conversations and get to know each other better.
* Safe and secure (encrypted) in app private chat messaging where you and your spouse can communicate intimately together and send pictures and messages.
* Hundreds of resources with articles and ideas to deepen sexual and emotional intimacy, understand anatomy and the human sexual response cycle, techniques, podcasts and videos with marriage and intimacy experts, and many other ideas to help spice up your marriage and deepen emotional intimacy.
* Over 140+ clean, non-graphic amazing intimate positions with instructions.
* Language of Love Quiz where you can find out how your spouse best feels loved.
* Intimate Extras where you can create your own bucket list, escape to a secluded beach, or make love in a rainstorm. There are also sexy texts and invites for you to give to your spouse.
* Products section with various products and services to enhance your relationship.
*Intimacy Calendar to schedule your important events such as date nights, vacations, intimacy and other events together. Also see any upcoming Ultimate Intimacy events such as scheduled podcasts, marriage retreats and other important things.
* Couples mode where you and your spouse can sync your phones for more interactive functions.
The Ultimate Intimacy App is password protected and privacy built-in so you never have to worry about someone else seeing it.
In App Purchases:
Ultimate Intimacy offers in-app purchases to unlock levels, features, and personalize gameplay. There is a one-time purchase option, and annual subscriptions that renew every year. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. You can go to your App Store account settings to manage your subscription and turn off the auto-renew. See our terms, conditions and instructions on how to cancel a subscription at https://ultimateintimacy.com/privacy-policy/
