bluejetty:00074602:ios.description:
Crewline — Built by Crew, for Crew
Crewline is the all-in-one scheduling, trip management, and crew connectivity app designed specifically for Flight Attendants and Pilots. Download your FLICA schedule in seconds, manage open time and trades, track flights, monitor reserve availability, and stay connected with fellow crew members—all from one powerful, easy-to-use app.
Supported Airlines
• JetBlue
• Frontier Airlines
• WestJet
• WestJet Encore
• Hawaiian Airlines
• Endeavor Air
• Republic Airways
Open Time & Trade Board
Manage your schedule with ease.
• View Open Time and Trade Board trips directly on your calendar
• Browse available trips organized by day
• Submit pick-up, drop, and trade requests with a swipe
• Quickly drop trips from pairing details
Reserve Grid & Smart Alerts
Crewline displays your airline’s Reserve Grid directly in the app, making it easy to monitor reserve availability. Enable Smart Alerts and receive notifications the moment a day turns green, helping you spot opportunities before they’re gone.
Schedule History & Pairing Changes
Never lose track of your schedule.
• Store up to 12 months of schedule history
• Review past pairings and schedule changes
• Compare current trips with original downloaded versions
• Track historical flying activity
Real-Time Flight Information
Start every pairing informed and prepared.
• Live flight status updates
• Gate assignments
• Delays and cancellations
• Aircraft information
• Departure and arrival details
A simple status indicator lets you know at a glance whether your flight is on time, delayed, or canceled.
Advanced Flight Tracking
Available with First Class membership.
• Aircraft type
• Tail number
• Flight distance
• Route information
• Additional operational insights
Crew Profiles & Messaging
Stay connected with the people you fly with.
• Create your crew profile
• Share as much or as little information as you choose
• View profiles of fellow crew members
• Start conversations directly through in-app messaging
Flight Statistics & Insights
Track your flying activity with detailed statistics.
• Flight hours
• Pairings flown
• Duty trends
• Flying patterns
• Historical activity
Fast & Reliable Downloads
• Download schedules in seconds
• Refresh updates quickly
• Access the latest trip information without delays
Designed for Aviation Professionals
Crewline combines powerful functionality with a clean, modern design.
• Dark Mode support
• Easy-to-read calendar views
• Fast navigation
• Aviation-focused experience
Subscription Options
Economy Class ($0.99/month or $10.99/year)
• Schedule downloads
• Basic schedule management
• 3 months of schedule history
Business Class ($1.99/month or $21.99/year)
Everything in Economy, plus:
• Open Time and Trade Board requests
• Trip pick-up, drop, and swap requests
• Up to 12 months of schedule history
• Reserve Grid access and alerts
First Class ($2.99/month or $29.99/year)
Everything in Business, plus:
• Advanced flight tracking
• Tail numbers
• Aircraft information
• Flight distance
• Enhanced operational data
Subscription & Billing
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple Account Settings.

Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: support@crewlineapp.com

bluejetty:00167297:android.description:
Unleash your creativity with Landscape Design! Makeover your outdoor spaces and bring your landscaping dreams to life by decorating gardens, planting and collecting flowers, discovering stylish furniture, and creating stunning garden layouts for your dream home. 
Landscape Design offers realistic design & gardening experience with endless possibilities for makeovers. Design and makeover charming gardens for front yards, back yards, terraces, exotic villas, beach houses, family homes, and more.
Features:
● Become a master landscaper: Dive into the world of landscaping and turn home gardens into idyllic retreats with Landscape Design – the ultimate virtual gardening experience. Transition from interior design to embrace the beauty of the outdoors! Makeover house yards into the gardens of your dreams with your strategic design choices.
● Expand your collection: Cultivate a variety of plants, trees, flowers, and bushes. Gather stylish outdoor furniture like sofas, benches, parasols, and coffee tables. Use your creativity to design, decorate, and makeover the garden of a house or manor, making each one uniquely beautiful.
● Redesign multiple house gardens: As a landscape and home design enthusiast, your mission is to beautify the gardens of various homes, from beach houses to exotic cottages, Spanish villas to mountain chalets. Use your design skills to enhance outdoor spaces with daily challenges!
● Discover your creative side: Find joy in every detail as the master planner in Landscape Design! Dive into the world of decor, crafting beautiful outdoor spaces that radiate joy. Let your skills as a planner transform blank canvases into vibrant gardens, each filled with carefully chosen decor pieces. Experience the joy of seeing your plans come to life, creating stunning environments that bring happiness to every corner. As a dedicated planner, you'll revel in the endless possibilities of garden decor, making each design a joyful masterpiece in Landscape Design.
● Help clients restore their gardens: Bring joy to your clients as the ultimate garden planner in Landscape Design! Dive into outdoor gardening and transform every yard with beautiful decor and vibrant botany. Whether it's a charming manor or a luxurious villa, use your expertise in botany to restore and enhance their outdoor spaces. Create stunning flower arrangements and yard designs that reflect the unique character of each manor and villa. With your help, clients can rediscover the joy of gardening and the beauty of their outdoor spaces.
● Express yourself: Find joy in becoming the ultimate garden planner with Landscape Design! Dive into the world of decor and transform your yard into a paradise of botany. Whether you're designing a quaint manor or a luxurious villa, our game lets you explore endless outdoor gardening possibilities. Plant a variety of flowers and create stunning garden layouts that reflect your unique style. With Landscape Design, you can bring your passion for botany and outdoor decor to life, crafting the perfect garden space for any manor or villa. Express yourself and let your creativity flourish in every flower and yard design!
● It's a complete transformation: Use your creativity and your collection of plants, botany and furniture to craft the landscaping designs of your life! Find the perfect combinations to design the gardens of your dreams.
If you enjoy cozy games, interior design games, word games, puzzle games, and mini-games, Landscape Design will be a refreshing experience and you will find joy in this game!
Download Landscape Design on Google Play now and start crafting your dream home garden today!

bluejetty:00148561:ios.description:
الآيات الفاضلة
سور وآيات وردت في شأنها أحاديث مروية عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في بيان فضلها وما خصها به ربنا عز وجل من حكمة ونور.
هذه السور والآيات المباركة منها ما يطلب من المؤمن والمؤمنة قراءته يوميا أكثر من مرة كما هو الشأن في الفاتحة الواجب قراءتها في الصلاة، والأحاديث مشهورة في بيان فضلها، وكذلك الحال في سورة الإخلاص والمعوذتين اللاتي قال في شأنها نبينا صلى الله عليه وسلم "قل قل هو الله أحد والمعوذتين حين تمسي، وحين تصبح، ثلاث مرات تكفيك من كل شيء". ويجدر التنبيه هنا إلى ضرورة التقيد بالعدد المنصوص عليه سنة. ومنها ما ورد الترغيب في قراءته في وقت خاص من اليوم والليلة كما هو شأن أواخر سورة البقرة التي قال عنها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم "من قرأ بالآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه". ومنها ما ارتبط بيوم من الأسبوع، ويتعلق الأمر بسورة الكهف حيث قال عنها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم "من قرأ سورة الكهف يوم الجمعة أضاء له من النور ما بين الجمعتين".
ولا يفهم من تخصيص بعضها بالقراءة في وقت محدد أنها لا تقرأ في غيره، فتلاوة القرآن عبادة من أشرف القربات التي يشتغل بها الصالحون والصالحات من عباد الله آناء الليل وأطراف النهار.

listings.name: سور وآيات فاضلة
listings.description:
الآيات الفاضلة
سور وآيات وردت في شأنها أحاديث مروية عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في بيان فضلها وما خصها به ربنا عز وجل من حكمة ونور.
هذه السور والآيات المباركة منها ما يطلب من المؤمن والمؤمنة قراءته يوميا أكثر من مرة كما هو الشأن في الفاتحة الواجب قراءتها في الصلاة، والأحاديث مشهورة في بيان فضلها، وكذلك الحال في سورة الإخلاص والمعوذتين اللاتي قال في شأنها نبينا صلى الله عليه وسلم "قل قل هو الله أحد والمعوذتين حين تمسي، وحين تصبح، ثلاث مرات تكفيك من كل شيء". ويجدر التنبيه هنا إلى ضرورة التقيد بالعدد المنصوص عليه سنة. ومنها ما ورد الترغيب في قراءته في وقت خاص من اليوم والليلة كما هو شأن أواخر سورة البقرة التي قال عنها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم "من قرأ بالآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه". ومنها ما ارتبط بيوم من الأسبوع، ويتعلق الأمر بسورة الكهف حيث قال عنها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم "من قرأ سورة الكهف يوم الجمعة أضاء له من النور ما بين الجمعتين".

ولا يفهم من تخصيص بعضها بالقراءة في وقت محدد أنها لا تقرأ في غيره، فتلاوة القرآن عبادة من أشرف القربات التي يشتغل بها الصالحون والصالحات من عباد الله آناء الليل وأطراف النهار.

bluejetty:00120707:ios.name: Useeum
bluejetty:00120707:ios.summary:
Useeum provides a variety of engaging stories, games and other exciting experiences at museums, science centres, nature parks and similar places.
Whether you are a tourist or avid visitor of museums, Useeum offers unique museum experiences
bluejetty:00120707:ios.description:
Useeum provides a variety of engaging stories, games and other exciting experiences at museums, science centres, nature parks and similar places.
Whether you are a tourist or avid visitor of museums, Useeum offers unique museum experiences. Our app offers many different guides and games that will make your museum visit a great experience for both young and old.
With the Useeum app you can find outdoor as well as indoor audio guides and games which are both fun and educational for the whole family.
MUSEUMS AND EXPERIENCES IN THE APP:
Whether you are interested in art, history, science or nature you can find narratives, audio guides or games that are perfect for you. In the Useeum app you will find art museums, historical museum and natural history museums, science centres as well as outdoor experiences in forests and parks. It will be exciting to explore our different games and guides! 
SOME PLACES YOU CAN VISIT WITH THE APP:
The Labour Museum in Oslo
The Bornholm Art Museum
The Museum of Oslo
Christiansborg Palace
Danmarks Borgcenter
Egeskov
Parkmuseerne
Fiskeri og Søfartsmuseet
Frøslevlejrens Museum
H. C. Andersen’s house
Hammershus
The Karen Blixen Museum
Kierkegaard by Nature
Stevnsfort Cold War Museum
Magasin du Nord Museum
Museet for Religiøs Kunst
The Narvik War Museum
Roskilde Museum
Royal College of Nursing
Sønderborg Castle
The Greenhouses and Botanical Garden Aarhus
ARoS
Kongernes Jelling
The Viking Ship Museum
Kronborg
Ramsgate
EDUCATIONAL GAMES:
In the Useeum app you will find games for kids of all ages. The games are designed to be both educational and entertaining. The games can be played with the family during a museum visit but are also ideal for schools or as a supplement for curriculums.
These are of some the games you can find in the Useeum app: Nature Quest, The Astral Journey, The Mystery at Hammershus, The Museum Mystery, Mytedetektiverne, Mysteriet om Dannebrog, Mysteriet på Hammershus, Parforcejagt og OppermannMysteriet.
In the Museum Mystery you will be helping professor Blom stop Heidenreich from stealing a unique item. The Museum Mystery can be played at Christiansborg Palace in Copenhagen, at Roskilde Museum, in the city of Roskilde, at Egeskov on Funen and at Hammershus on Bornholm.
The Museum Mystery has been created in cooperation with OK Monkey.
OK Monkey are experts at engaging children. They formerly worked at DR (Danish Broadcasting Corporation) Ramasjang where they created entertaining TV for children and entire universes for kids like the Ramasjang app, Ramasjang Mysteriet and Ring til Ramasjang. They also write children's books and have written the script for Cirkus Summarum.
ENGAGING STORIES:
In the app you can experience entertaining and educational stories. Our audio guides are stories that will take you on a journey to the past or portray great personalities like Karen Blixen, H C Andersen and Søren Kierkegaard. Exiting narratives such as Kings in the Tapestries at Christiansborg Palace, The Rise and Fall of Roskilde in Roskilde, The seventies at the Museum of Oslo in Oslo, Danmarks Vildeste Fiskereventyr at Fiskeri- og Søfartsmuseet in Esbjerg, Danmarks sidste vikingekonge from Historiens Hus in Odense, Danskernes dagligdag i det 20. århundrede at Tidens Samling in Odense, Rundt om Magasin - Købmænd, mode og æggesalat from Magasin Museum in Copenhagen, Slavenes København in Copenhagen, Mysteriet om Elvira Madigan on Tåsinge, Eva’s War in Ramsgate.
In the Greenhouses and Botanical Garden’s plant guide you will find comprehensive information about their plants.
LOCATIONS:
Whether you are in Denmark, England or Norway great experiences are waiting for you. We cover museums in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Odense, Roskilde, Esbjerg, Billund, Narvik, Oslo, London, Nordsjælland, Sønderjylland, Syddanmark, Bornholm, Fyn, Jylland, Midtjylland or one of the other places featuring great guides and experiences – download our app for free – Useeum.
Check out our guides and games – have fun!

bluejetty:00173122:ios.description:
Do you wish to create wild and stunning looks as your favorite artists from social media? It’s time to get started with Face Chart!
What’s a face chart, you may ask? A simple way to plan your next jaw-dropping look. Use a piece of paper as your model: try out new colors you were always afraid to wear. Mix and match a variety of designs to create a unique glow up.
Are you ready to transform a flat sketch into cute summer make-up? Get your brushes and relax: letting your creativity bloom with a Face Chart is as easy as a coloring book – don’t forget to turn the volume up! Listen to soft and calming ASMR sounds.
Turn your art into likes, and likes into colorful designs for your future salon! Add a splash of vibrant color to our lobby, decorate the kitchen and get ready for new interiors.
Eager to start your fashion journey? Let’s get the hype going:
– Waste no time: the controls are easy and intuitive 
– Explore variety of options: inclusive skin tones and lots of flattering colors 
– Never ending fun: the possibilities are endless 
– Share your work: with friends or with your favorite make-up artists 
– Get a break: take a minute to paint on the go, or sit and let inspiration take over the world. 
– Change of pace: have fun decorating your salon 
Treat yourself to a girl’s bravest dream – let your inner diva out, be yourself.
What are you waiting for? Download and see how many likes your creativity brings!

bluejetty:00162437:ios.description:
zBiletem is the simplest and most convenient app for buying public transport tickets.
Buy tickets without standing in line, searching for an open kiosk or store, or counting exact change. With the zBiletem app, just 3 clicks are enough to buy the ticket you need.
Whether you use ZTM Warsaw, MPK Łódź, ZTM Lublin, MPK Włocławek, or MPK Częstochowa, zBiletem makes it easy to pay for your ticket. You can pay using your Wallet, Blik, Google Pay, payment card, or PayU transfer.
Remember that tickets remain visible in the app even when you're offline. This way, you'll never be caught off guard during a ticket inspection on a bus or tram.
zBiletem also offers the ability to purchase periodic tickets, which are the most convenient and affordable way to pay for public transport if you travel regularly. Purchase the ticket on zBiletem.pl and then store it in the app. It's really simple.
With zBiletem, you can buy tickets from the following transport operators and organizers:
ZDMiKP Bydgoszcz, PKM Czechowice-Dziedzice, MPK in Częstochowa, ZKM Elbląg, ZTM Gdańsk, ZKM Gdynia MZKZG, MPK Gniezno, MZK Grudziądz, MZK Gorzów Wielkopolski, MPK Inowrocław, MZK Jastrzębie-Zdrój, Kaliskie Linie Autobusowe KLA, MPK Kraków (KMK), MZK Kutno, MPK Legnica, ZTM Lublin, MPK Lublin, MPK Łódź, Metropolia GZM (e.g., Katowice, Gliwice, Bytom, Chorzów, Sosnowiec, Tychy), ZDZiT Olsztyn, MZK Opole, MZK Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, MZK Pabianice, ZTM Poznań, MZK Przemyśl, MZDiK Radom, ZTZ Rybnik, ZTM Rzeszów, MPK Rzeszów, MPK Sieradz, MZK Skierniewice, ZIM Słupsk, MPK Stargard, ZDiTM Szczecin, MPK Świdnica, ZDiK Tarnów, MPK Tarnów, MZK Tomaszów Mazowiecki, MZKZG, MZK Toruń, ZDKiUM Wałbrzych, ZTM Warszawa, MZA Warszawa, Tramwaje Warszawskie, Metro Warszawskie, SKM, MZK Wejherowo, MPK Włocławek, ZKM Zawiercie, MPK Zduńska Wola, MUK Zgierz, MZK Zielona Góra.

Buy tickets without standing in line, searching for an open kiosk or store, or counting exact change. With the zBiletem app, just 3 clicks are enough to buy the ticket you need.
Whether you use ZTM Warsaw, MPK Łódź, ZTM Lublin, MPK Włocławek, or MPK Częstochowa, zBiletem makes it easy to pay for your ticket. You can pay using your Wallet, Blik, Google Pay, payment card, or PayU transfer.

Remember that tickets remain visible in the app even when you're offline. This way, you'll never be caught off guard during a ticket inspection on a bus or tram.
zBiletem also offers the ability to purchase periodic tickets, which are the most convenient and affordable way to pay for public transport if you travel regularly. Purchase the ticket on zBiletem.pl and then store it in the app. It's really simple.

With zBiletem, you can buy tickets from the following transport operators and organizers:
ZDMiKP Bydgoszcz, PKM Czechowice-Dziedzice, MPK in Częstochowa, ZKM Elbląg, ZTM Gdańsk, ZKM Gdynia MZKZG, MPK Gniezno, MZK Grudziądz, MZK Gorzów Wielkopolski, MPK Inowrocław, MZK Jastrzębie-Zdrój, Kaliskie Linie Autobusowe KLA, MPK Kraków (KMK), MZK Kutno, MPK Legnica, ZTM Lublin, MPK Lublin, MPK Łódź, Metropolia GZM (e.g., Katowice, Gliwice, Bytom, Chorzów, Sosnowiec, Tychy), ZDZiT Olsztyn, MZK Opole, MZK Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, MZK Pabianice, ZTM Poznań, MZK Przemyśl, MZDiK Radom, ZTZ Rybnik, ZTM Rzeszów, MPK Rzeszów, MPK Sieradz, MZK Skierniewice, ZIM Słupsk, MPK Stargard, ZDiTM Szczecin, MPK Świdnica, ZDiK Tarnów, MPK Tarnów, MZK Tomaszów Mazowiecki, MZKZG, MZK Toruń, ZDKiUM Wałbrzych, ZTM Warszawa, MZA Warszawa, Tramwaje Warszawskie, Metro Warszawskie, SKM, MZK Wejherowo, MPK Włocławek, ZKM Zawiercie, MPK Zduńska Wola, MUK Zgierz, MZK Zielona Góra.

bluejetty:00152398:ios.description:
A fun kids car game for little drivers.
Fun Kiddo Cars offers a safe and exciting experience that stands out among educational kids games specially designed for children aged 2–6.
With its ad-free and offline car game structure, it provides peace of mind for parents and endless fun for children.
In this colorful world, kids both play and learn through activities like driving cars, painting cars, washing cars and repairing cars. Fun Kiddo Cars gives a clear answer to the question: What should a kids car game be like?
Why Fun Kiddo Cars?
In preschool education, “learning through play” is the most effective method. While playing this game, cute vehicles, bright colors and engaging sound effects turn the learning process into a huge adventure of fun.
Educational content by age
Fun Kiddo Cars appeals to different age groups and fits perfectly into preschool games and baby games categories.
• For age 3: colors, sounds and simple controls within a playful experience.
• For age 4: focus, attention and learning activities.
• For age 5: problem solving and navigation challenges.
• For age 6: driving tracks that improve hand-eye coordination.
Educational benefits
• Recognizing numbers and letters.
• Hand-eye coordination through on-screen guidance.
• Simple logical thinking while washing and repairing cars.
• Choosing colors and designs for cars in the customization screen.
Letter and number adventure
Your child collects letters and numbers on the road while driving! The collected letters and numbers are pronounced aloud, helping children improve reading and writing awareness while learning the alphabet and numbers. With this feature, Fun Kiddo Cars stands out among educational kids games.
Rich vehicle world and cute animals
This is not an ordinary car racing game! Cute animals such as rabbit, panda, giraffe, dog, cat and lion take the driver’s seat. Children’s favorite vehicles come together:
• Fast cars and monster trucks
• Construction vehicles such as excavators and trucks
• Police cars, fire trucks and ambulances
• Airplanes and helicopters
It offers a wide variety of vehicles especially for families looking for car games for boys.
Paint, wash and repair
Fun Kiddo Cars stands out among offline car games. Children do not only drive vehicles – they connect with them.
• Car painting games: choose colors and decorate with stickers
• Car repair games: change tires and perform maintenance
• Car wash games: clean dirty vehicles until they shine
Dynamic weather and child-friendly design
Driving becomes even more exciting with sunny, rainy, snowy weather and day-night modes. Children celebrate their success by bursting a piñata after completing the track. Large buttons, a simple interface and iPad compatibility make the game easy even for toddlers.
Safe game for families
• No ads
• Offline play
• Safe for children
• Offline kids game: enjoy uninterrupted fun while traveling, on planes or anywhere without internet.
• No personal data collected: your child’s safety is our priority.
• Simple interface: easy buttons and menus designed for little hands.
• Parental control: everything stays under your control.
Safe and ad-free experience
We understand parents’ biggest concerns. Our game contains no ads that may distract or mislead children. It is a completely safe digital play area. Fun Kiddo Cars is an ideal starting point for families looking for free kids games.
Summary
Fun Kiddo Cars combines car driving, car racing, car painting, car washing and car repair into one educational car game.
Download now and let your child grow while playing car games and have fun while learning!

bluejetty:00022856:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00022856:ios.description:
Fix messy text in one tap.
Text Workflow cleans, converts and formats text with more than 50 actions, and saves the steps as workflows you run again with one tap. Clean up an answer from ChatGPT, text from a PDF, a list from a spreadsheet or a page from the web, then sort it, number it, change its case, or turn it into JSON, CSV, Markdown or rich text. Exact every time, private, and on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
HOW IT HELPS
• Paste AI answers anywhere: remove [1] citation tags, 【source】 marks, stray ** and ## and hidden characters, or turn Markdown into rich text for Pages, Word and Mail
• Sound like yourself: AI Writing Check highlights the words and marks that make text read as AI-written
• Fix text from PDFs and scans: rejoin broken lines and hyphenated words, remove page numbers and double spaces
• Tidy lists: trim, sort by any word, number, and remove duplicates and empty lines
• Make the same edit everywhere at once: find and replace with regular expressions, add prefixes and suffixes, change case
• Convert data and code: JSON, CSV, YAML, XML and Markdown tables, with code in color
DO IT ONCE. THEN IT'S ONE TAP.
Chain actions into a workflow and each step feeds the next. The text job you repeat every week becomes a single tap.
• Every action and workflow is a Shortcuts action: clean your clipboard with one tap, or build automations that run on their own
• Send text from any app with the Share sheet
• If… Else steps, nested workflows, and regular expressions that run a workflow only on the parts that match
• Your workflows sync to your Mac and iPad with iCloud
• Made for iPhone Duo and landscape: your text gets the whole screen
NEW IN 3.5: TEXTS
Keep the texts you use again and again, like replies, prompts, signatures and templates. Load one with a tap, search by name or content, pin your favorites, and save text from any app with the Share sheet. With Sync with iCloud on, they're on your Mac and iPad too. Otherwise they stay on this device.
Also new: Markdown Table to CSV, and Replace Text understands character codes like \u00A0.
WHY TEXT WORKFLOW
• Exact every time. The same input always gives the same output. No "regenerate".
• Private. Built-in actions run on your device, with no account.
• Compare Input with Result to see exactly what changed, by character, word or line.
50+ TEXT ACTIONS, INCLUDING
• Editing and lines: find and replace (plain or RegEx), prefix and suffix, sort, number, break and trim lines, remove empty lines, duplicates and extra spaces
• Cleanup: Clean AI Text, AI Writing Check, Remove Citations, Fix PDF Text, remove Markdown or HTML, quotes, accents, invisible characters
• Case and style: UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase, spell out and format numbers, Style Text
• Data formats: Markdown to Rich Text and HTML, JSON and YAML, JSON and CSV, XML to JSON, CSV and Markdown tables
• Utilities: Base64, URL encoding, encryption, QR codes, UUIDs, text statistics, dates, math, Run Script
AI, ON YOUR TERMS
Add an optional AI step to any workflow with your own OpenAI, Claude or Gemini key, any OpenAI-compatible service, or Apple's on-device model. You pay the provider directly, and nothing routes through us.
TEXT WORKFLOW PRO
Free: every action, with results shown in full, and up to 10 texts. Pro lets you copy and share results of any length, create unlimited workflows, save unlimited texts and compare Input with Result.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://www.gtrigonakis.com/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

The companion app for the "Into the Cryptoverse" community. 

The app displays asset prices updated every minute. Tracking the most relevant crypto, precious metals and stocks assets for our community.

Checkout "Into the Cryptoverse" website for more information and subscription options.

bluejetty:00045793:ios.name: Indigo Touch
bluejetty:00045793:ios.summary: Indigo Touch is an iPhone and iPad optimized App for remotely controlling lighting, appliances, HVAC, ceiling fans, sprinklers, etc., from anywhere in the world. It will automatically connect to the required Indigo Smart Home Hub software (
bluejetty:00045793:ios.description:
Indigo Touch is an iPhone and iPad optimized App for remotely controlling lighting, appliances, HVAC, ceiling fans, sprinklers, etc., from anywhere in the world. It will automatically connect to the required Indigo Smart Home Hub software (v7 or newer), installed in your home on a Mac, to communicate with Z-Wave, INSTEON and/or X10 compatible hardware. Additionally, many more devices and protocols are supported via 3rd Party Plugins. Now you can adjust your home's thermostat, run the sprinkler, open the garage door, unlock the front door, and turn off the lights from anywhere you have an internet/data connection!
IMPORTANT
Controlling your home requires that you have installed the Indigo Smart Home Hub software on your Mac. Indigo is NOT FREE, although there is a 30 day free trial available. See MAC REQUIREMENTS below for more details.
For support, please contact us directly using the contact form on our website rather than requesting help via a review.
FEATURES
- Instant control and access to all your smart home devices
- One touch UI controls for lighting, appliances, sprinklers, ceiling fans, and HVAC
- Execute any Indigo defined Action Groups
- View any Indigo defined Variables (house mode, etc.)
- Real time updates of all hardware (brightness, temperature, active zone, sensor values, etc.)
- Real time updates of all variable values
- View all custom 3rd Party Plugin device information
- Control Page viewer for custom user defined UI pages
- Bonjour enabled to get you connected with a single touch (no IP addresses needed!)
- Easy remote access from anywhere via an optional Indigo Reflector subscription (eliminates router and dynamic IP configuration and provides secure communications)
MAC REQUIREMENTS
- Indigo Smart Home Hub software v7.5+
- Mac running Mac OS High Sierra (10.13) or newer
- Supported computer interface required to use built-in protocols (Z-Stick, PowerLinc, etc.)
- Smart home devices (lighting, sprinkler, HVAC, fans, sensors, etc.)
FOR MORE INFO VISIT
indigodomo.com/touch.html

bluejetty:00114229:android.description:
PlayTV: Live Sports TV & Shows is a simple and flexible app that lets you watch live TV channels, live sports, and TV shows directly on your mobile device. With support for IPTV playlists, PlayTV helps you bring all your favorite live content into one easy-to-use player.
From live football matches to daily TV shows and entertainment channels, PlayTV makes live TV streaming easier than ever. Add your playlist, choose your favorite channels, and start watching instantly.
🔥 Key feature of this Live Sports TV & Shows App:
- Watch live sports TV including football and other matches
- Stream live TV channels, movies, and shows in real time
- Support IPTV playlists via M3U URL and files
- Create and manage custom channel categories
- Add channels to Favorites for quick access
- Smart search to find channels instantly
- View watch history and resume recently played channels
- Screen lock mode to prevent accidental touches
⚽ Watch live sports TV including football, matches, and sports events with smooth playback and minimal buffering for a better viewing experience.
📺 Stream live TV channels from multiple categories such as sports, movies, news, and entertainment using IPTV playlist support.
📂 Add IPTV playlists easily via M3U URL and files, manage channels by category, and create your own personalized live TV lists.
❤️ Save favorite TV channels to access them faster and never miss live sports or your favorite TV shows.
🔍 Use fast channel search to find live TV streams quickly, even when your playlist contains hundreds of channels.
🔒 Enable screen lock mode while watching live TV to prevent accidental touches and interruptions.
🕒 View watch history to quickly reopen recently played live TV channels and continue watching without searching again.
PlayTV: Live Sports TV & Shows is a reliable solution for watching live sports and TV channels in one lightweight and user-friendly app. With playlist support, favorites, and smart navigation, it offers everything you need for a comfortable live TV experience.
Download PlayTV today and enjoy live sports, TV shows, and entertainment on your phone. If you like the app, please leave a rating and review to help us improve and bring you better updates in the future.

- Advanced Car Customization: Customize your vehicle with in-depth tuning options, including suspension, body, wheels, and engine upgrades.
- Winch & Towing: Outfit your car with essential equipment for navigating tough terrains and assisting other stuck vehicles.
- Offroad Mastery: Fully immerse yourself in offroading with detailed map designs and realistic vehicle dynamics.
Prepare for an unparalleled offroad adventure, crafted for true enthusiasts. Rev up your engines and become part of the vibrant Mudness community today!

Experience the next level in offroad gaming with Mudness, a AAA multiplayer simulator that immerses you in diverse terrains and thrilling adventures. From stock vehicles to awe-inspiring MONSTER TRUCKS, traverse a detailed map featuring three distinct biomes - a muddy forest, sandy quarry, and snowy mountains - across 6 bases. Embark on vital delivery missions, transporting cargos and workers safely and on time, or enjoy exhilarating drives with up to 20 players per server.
Free to play - High quality and Realistic Simulator in your pocket

Main Features:

- Drive Real Offroad Machines.

- Dirt, Mud, Sand, Snow, Rivers, Swamps, Mountains all the Terrains.

- Trails Mode: Tackle the Daily Trail, a dynamic challenge that tests your skills with new adventures every 24 hours. Compete for significant prizes based on your leaderboard standings.

- Daily Challenges: Engage in unique, daily tasks that offer exciting rewards and keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.

- Cargo Trailers & Monster Trucks: Select from a diverse range of vehicles for your delivery missions.

- Challenging Delivery Tasks: Test your driving prowess in a variety of demanding missions.

- Rewarding Side Missions: Discover and complete lucrative and entertaining side tasks.

- Enhanced Multiplayer: Participate in exciting races and cooperative gameplay with friends and other players.

- Advanced Car Customization: Customize your vehicle with in-depth tuning options, including suspension, body, wheels, and engine upgrades.

- Winch & Towing: Outfit your car with essential equipment for navigating tough terrains and assisting other stuck vehicles.

- Offroad Mastery: Fully immerse yourself in offroading with detailed map designs and realistic vehicle dynamics.


Prepare for an unparalleled offroad adventure, crafted for true enthusiasts. Rev up your engines and become part of the vibrant Mudness community today!

Terms of use: https://midnight.games/terms
Privacy Policy: https://midnight.games/privacy

bluejetty:00047387:ios.description:
SPECIAL FEATURES
- AUGMENTED REALITY - AR
- STOP CARRYING BOOK GUIDES!!!
- 100% OFFLINE TRAVEL GUIDE
- OFFLINE METRO MAP
- ZOOMABLE 100% REGIONAL OFFLINE MAPS
- PICS GALLERY
- GPS CAPABLE
- INTERACTIVE POINTS OF INTEREST on the maps showing public bus stops, restaurants, pubs, hotels, hospitals, museums, theatres, and many others.
- DAILY BASED ITINERARIES
- BUDGET BASED HOTELS & RESTAURANTS
- WHERE, WHAT & HOW TO SHOP
- NIGHTLIFE ACTIVITIES
- CITY TIPS, MOVING AROUND, COMMUTING
- SAFETY TIPS
------------------------------------------
PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
Stop carrying heavy city tours guide in your pocket. TRAVEL LIGHT!!!
With this Travel Guide you have a full city guide in your iPhone & iPod Touch.
This tourist guide is built to be used offline. No connection to Internet required, meaning no extra charges in your phone bill!!
AUGMENTED REALITY, unlike other tourist guides you will be able to discover the city with the best iPhone tool - AR - Just click on the AR button, turn yourself 360° and view on the screen where the best spots are and how to find them. You can also scroll up and down to view the closest and furthest attraction. Slide through the tutorial for more tips. 
After many requests, we bring to you your own steps with a GPS feature. Do not get lost, just take a look where you are standed.
It is a very practical city guide since it is designed to be used by itineraries. There are 4 different itineraries for the city depending on the duration of your journey. We also provide tips and advices to travelers, how to get into the city, how to move around, where to shop, where to go at night, most popular places, safety tips, etc...
Unlike other guides, this Travel Guide provides you with interactive zoomable OFFLINE MAPS (x6 zoom + GPS capable) of the region showing the attractions, public bus stops, restaurants, pubs, hotels, hospitals and many other useful points of interest. You cannot get lost!. With this guide, you will not only visit the city but also move around its region.
Tourist info for must see attractions such as Hong Kong Island, Victoria Harbour, Victoria Peak, Hollywood Road, Upper Lascar Row, Man Mo Temple, Lan Kwai Fong, Soho, Golden Bauhinia Square, Happy Valley Racecourse, Jumbo Kingdom, Repulse Bay, Stanley, Stanley Market, Aberdeen, Kowloon, among others. 
The travel guide is made based on travelers advices. Unlike other city guides, we can guarantee we have already visited these places and would like to give you a fancy and practical tool to make your visit a more enjoyable one.
This app contains IAPs for you to enjoy and discover the best out of your visit.

See the best fishing times - for where YOU are fishing right now - on a large clear, simple, easy to read display. See a countdown to the next full or new moon - the best times to fish. • Calendar - see the best fishing days for the whole month at a glance

The easiest and best fishing time app available.
• Moon imagery is provided by NASA.
• Thank you for your great ratings, reviews and feedback. If you do have feedback, please do let me know at the support site so I can get back to you. I read it all. Thank you again.

Rick will have to discover what force is driving Lillian and stop her in order to save Chris.

bluejetty:00098231:ios.name: Foodventure Inc: Idle Tycoon
bluejetty:00098231:ios.summary:
► ORDER UP!
Every restaurateur dreams of opening not just one, but a whole chain of eateries, and you’re about to live that life as you grow your cooking business empire and become the greatest food tycoon ever seen! Start your Foodventure
bluejetty:00098231:ios.description:
► ORDER UP!
Every restaurateur dreams of opening not just one, but a whole chain of eateries, and you’re about to live that life as you grow your cooking business empire and become the greatest food tycoon ever seen! Start your Foodventure story as a humble chef, and work your way up to managing multiple different restaurants that serve everything from pizza to sushi. Not only will you enjoy the restaurant simulator experience as you manage all parts of the business, but you’ll also get in on that sweet idle tycoon action, meaning tons of growth even when you’re not in the game. The perfect game for foodies and business lovers alike, give opening your own restaurant a go today!
► HOW IT WORKS
● Step 1: Open your first restaurant. It may be a small pizzeria, but that doesn’t mean it’s not mighty. Serve up great pizza, lemonade, and other delicious meals, and have your customers raving and coming back for more. As business booms, hire more wait staff, and consider adding new items like hot dogs or burgers to the menu. Keep cooking!
● Step 2: Branch out. Once your first location is successful, why stop there? The world needs more than just one pizzeria or sushi bar, so do a little market research and see what the people want to eat the most. At one location customers may prefer fresh strawberry lemonade, at another it’s good coffee – figure it out to keep your business empire running and your dreams growing.
● Step 3: Improve your business skills. If you want to be the ultimate food tycoon, you’ll need to be business savvy. Raise prices carefully, hire skilled staff, expand your food and drink offerings, and more as part of this idle tycoon cooking simulator game where you’ll need to balance sourcing resources with hiring the best chefs. Customers may love your good coffee or burgers, but if the staff are slow that’s a big turn off, and your tycoon dreams may suffer.
● Step 4: Move up the chain. Cooking may be your passion, but if you want to make the big bucks you’ll move from the kitchen to the office, and start managing your different restaurants from above. Hopefully you’ve done your due diligence and hired the best staff, because that means you won’t need to worry if the pizza’s ready or the coffee’s good – you’ll know they are!
● Step 5: Profit. It’s all about the idle tycoon goodness in this simulator, where if you’ve played your cards right your restaurants will keep bringing in the big bucks even when you’re not in the game thanks to the idle mechanics. Enjoy playing and managing, then step away to let your staff do all the heavy lifting and rake in the dough (both literally and figuratively: those burger buns and pizza pies aren’t made from air you know!)
● Step 6: You’re on top, baby! That’s right, you made it and are the world’s ultimate food tycoon. Just about every type of food imaginable is cooked and served at your restaurants, and with tiptop staff and facilities customers just can’t seem to get enough. The world’s your oyster – hey, speaking of, what a great new menu item!
► WHAT’S COOKING, CHEF?
Pizza, burgers, sushi, coffee… the choices of food and drink are endless in your restaurants! From a simple pizzeria food truck that served fresh hot slices, to sit-down restaurants with gourmet burgers, to cafes full of hot coffee and tasty strawberry pastries, you offer it all. But none of this would work without your expert business management skills that you’ve gained while playing, from hiring staff to managing customer expectations.
If you’re ready to become the ultimate food tycoon, download Foodventure today and show the world you’ve got what it takes!

bluejetty:00021260:ios.description:
Are you a volunteer or professional emergency services worker? 
Stay connected with your team and find the information you need quickly and easily with BART. Don’t let limited budgets and resources stop you from doing the work that keeps your community safe!
Bringing together a range of information critical to the event at hand, BART facilitates stronger communication between teams, safer working environments and quicker response times.
BART helps teams communicate better:
- Pager message feed (for approved members)
- Message centre
- Parallel SMS, email and push notifications
- Member qualifications
- Rostering, availability and attendance
BART makes it easy to find the right information:
- Mapping and geolocation
- Incident routing
- Resource locations (using map layers)
- Estimated arrival time to headquarters
Please note you must be registered for BART to use this Application.
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00047813:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
Flipping Eck
Simply leap your way across the gaps in this tricky, challenging little platform game.
But can you find the secret trick to getting a huge score?
Collect and earn coins to unlock the whole family of characters, in the World’s daftest, most Northern game.
------
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.

Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.

TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.

READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.

EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.

EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.

SAFE & AD-FREE

Have fun!!!

bluejetty:00126577:ios.description:
ACTIVE Network’s Meet Mobile transforms the swim meet experience for fans, swimmers, coaches and meet hosts alike. From the largest national qualifying trials in the country to the smallest swim meets, get access to meet programs from all over the world, including heat sheets, psych sheets and real-time results. Download Meet Mobile now to follow your favorite swimmers and swim meets.
Fans
• View results, anytime, anywhere*
• Quickly find swim meets with robust search functions
• Track swimmers and teams in real-time, even if you’re not at the meet 
• Flag your “Favorite” swimmers and teams to find them easily
• View real-time heat results along with cumulative and subtracted splits*
• View overall swimmer and relay rankings for each round of each event*
• Check real-time team scores*
• View records and time standards
• Share your event via email, messaging, Facebook or Twitter
Swimmers
• View psych sheets prior to the meet or during an event
• View heat sheets**
• View estimated event start times 
• View swimmer’s list of entries, completed results and points scored
Coaches
• View psych sheets prior to the meet or during an event
• View each swimmer's results along with cumulative and subtracted splits*
• View relay results with swimmer names and splits by leg*
• View heat sheets by heat and by individual**
• View estimated timelines by event and individual
• Check real-time team scores*
• View custom heat sheets and results filtered to show only your team members**
Meet Hosts
• Offer mobile results for all your meets
• Push out the event schedule and psych sheet information prior to the meet
• Share estimated timelines for the start of each event
• Get exposure within the app when people search for criteria that match your meet
• Make fans, swimmers and coaches happy by offering meet access from anywhere in the world, in real time
• Let fans send your meet viral as they share their favorite swimmers’ results instantly via Facebook, Twitter, email or text
*Meet Results
Meet results are available as an in-app subscription. Your subscription includes access to swimmer times, splits, scores, and more at meets where meet hosts and officials support the publication of results to mobile with HY-TEK Meet Manager - the most widely-used swimming management software in the world. 
Can’t find your meet? Waiting for meet results? 
Ask the meet host to update to version 4.0 or higher of HY-TEK’s Meet Manager and post the meet program and meet results to Meet Mobile. HY-TEK does not control and cannot guarantee the availability or accuracy of meet programs or meet results.
Meet Result Pricing
Subscribe and gain full access to meet results, including cumulative and subtractive splits. Monthly subscriptions are offered as $6.49 USD. Annual subscriptions are offered $19.99 USD. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless your subscription is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and switch off auto-renewal by accessing your iTunes & App Store Account Settings after purchase. 
**Heat Sheet Pricing
Heat sheets are often distributed freely, but meet hosts may charge for access to heat sheets in Meet Mobile. HY-TEK does not control heat sheet pricing, and any price indicated for heat sheets is not included in the meet results subscription.
All personal data is handled under the terms and conditions of ACTIVE’s privacy policy. More details can be found here:  http://www.activenetwork.com/information/privacy-policy https://www.activenetwork.com/information/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00159770:ios.summary:
Challenge your brain with Number Match Game Numberama 2! This ultimate number puzzle game offers endless fun and challenges. A game with simple rules, enriched with many new features.
Many of you know this Number Match logic riddle from sc
bluejetty:00159770:ios.description:
Challenge your brain with Number Match Game Numberama 2! This ultimate number puzzle game offers endless fun and challenges. A game with simple rules, enriched with many new features.
Many of you know this Number Match logic riddle from school or university when you have played it with paper and pen. Now "Number Match Game Numberama 2" is also available for your smartphone. Matching brain games & logic puzzles for everyone.
HOW TO PLAY
In this numbers game you have to match and cross out numbers or digits on the playing field. Two numbers can be merged, if the numbers are the same, or add up to ten. For example you can combine numbers like 7 and 3, 9 and 1, or 6 and 6.
The two digits have to be side by side or on top of each other. The right side of the number board wraps around to the left side, so numbers on the right side are next to the numbers on the left, but one row down. The two numbers can have crossed-out number blocks between them.
If you cannot or do not want to merge numbers, and you do not want to use Boosts, you then press "Check". All the numbers remaining on the board are then copied after the existing numbers and the numbers game continues.
Number Match Game Numberama 2
There are three different modes:
- Level: Solve level after level with increasing difficulty
- Quick: The classic version of the numbers game with some features that speed up the number games
- Mode Builder: Create your own numbers game (1-18, 1-19, or choose from ten digits randomly)
Use all of this in any of your number match games:
- "Undo": Undo the last move
- "Help": Have a possible combination shown or get the info that there are no more number blocks that match
- "Cross": Strike through any single number
- "Statistics": Playing time and statistics for the current playing field are displayed
- AutoClean: Empty lines are removed automatically
- Automatic save/load
- Customizable number board
- Playable, without having to make in-app purchases
- No ads
- Minimum required permissions
- Game Center
Pair Matching Numbers Puzzle
Use your number games skills to find the matching pair combinations and solve the free logic puzzle. When the levels get difficult, you can also use special boosts to make the matching games even more interesting:
- Shuffle all the numbers on the numbers board
- Clear 30% of all crossed out numbers
- Clear all crossed out numbers on the number board
Are you looking for a number game that will save you from boredom? How about playing a logic block puzzle that will help you sharpen your number and matching games skills? With this pair matching number games app, you can experience a relaxing and addictive number puzzle with simple rules. Find and merge matching numbers that are the same or add up to ten on the number board. Switch between different puzzle modes and use new special features. Use your number match and block puzzle skills to merge and strike through all number blocks and clear the board. It is simple and addictive and therefore a great alternative to the well-known word or number games like math Sudoku, Solitaire, Nonogram, 2048, or other puzzle games. It is a real time killer and good brain game.
Solve number matching games, win rewards, and become a master in the free number match puzzle. Scan the board as carefully as you can and customize the number blocks according to your preferences. You can change colors and numbers as you want. This numbers game is also known as Take Ten, Match 10 Seeds, 1-19 game, Numberzilla, 1010, Number match or Merge Numbers. Play matching games as long as you like and change the mode whenever you want.
Support
For help with translations, please send me an email.

bluejetty:00037236:ios.name: Lila - Peri Weight Loss Coach
bluejetty:00037236:ios.summary: Lose the weight that came with perimenopause. Lila is the #1 perimenopause app: a personal weight loss coach that reads your symptoms, builds meals for your hormones, and adapts as your body changes. 72% of women lose weight within 2 weeks.
bluejetty:00037236:ios.description:
Lose the weight that came with perimenopause. Lila is the #1 perimenopause app: a personal weight loss coach that reads your symptoms, builds meals for your hormones, and adapts as your body changes. 72% of women lose weight within 2 weeks.* Built with Rebecca Rumsey, MSc, RD.
YOUR BODY CHANGED. YOUR DIET SHOULD TOO.
The weight crept on around the middle. The diets that always worked stopped working. You're tired, foggy, and not sleeping.
You're not broken. Your hormones changed. Over 100,000 women in perimenopause have found what works next.
HOW IT WORKS:
1. Tell Lila about your body and your goals. She builds your peri plan in minutes.
2. Snap a photo of your meal. Lila logs it and tells you what to adjust.
3. Chat with Lila anytime. The more you share, the smarter she gets.
WHAT YOU GET:
1. Weight loss that finally works. Protein and calorie targets built for a body over 40, not a formula built for everyone.
2. A coach who gets it. Ask anything: "what should I eat for dinner?", "why am I so tired?" She knows your body and your stage. 2am, no judgment, completely private.
3. Patterns you've been missing. Track 20+ symptoms like fatigue, brain fog, sleep, and bloating. Finally see why some weeks feel better than others.
4. Meals for your hormones. Recipes built around protein, fiber, and healthy fats. Supplement guidance based on gaps in your actual diet.
WHY LILA IS DIFFERENT:
Most diet apps ignore the hormonal shift that makes weight loss harder after 40. They tell you to eat less and move more. That's not your problem.
Lila was built for perimenopause. She connects what you eat to how you feel, adapts as your body changes, and understands that this isn't about willpower. It's about hormones. The more you use her, the more she learns you — and the better your plan gets.
COMMON QUESTIONS:
Q: Does perimenopause cause weight gain? 
A: Yes. Declining estrogen changes how your body stores fat, especially around the midsection. Lila adjusts your nutrition daily to work with your changing hormones, not against them.
Q: How fast will I see results?

bluejetty:00157695:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into a golf launch monitor. Set it on a tripod, swing, and see your pro-level data on every shot, at the range or into a net at home.
GolfTrak is now ChipIn Shot Tracker. Same tracking, same account, same shot history. New name.
EVERY SWING, MEASURED
• Carry and total distance
• Ball speed and club speed
• Launch angle and launch direction
• Spin rate and smash factor
No sensors and no extra hardware. Just your iPhone's camera.
KNOW EVERY CLUB IN YOUR BAG
Every shot is saved club by club. See your average, long and short for each club, where your misses go, and how your numbers change over time. Is your 7-iron really your 7-iron? Now you'll know.
PRACTICE WHERE YOU PRACTICE
Driving range, hitting net, enclosure, indoors or outdoors. Choose your setup and the app guides you through it.
SET UP IN MINUTES
Follow our easy guide and you're hitting in under 3 minutes on average. For the best results, use a small tripod that goes as low as 6 inches. A stack of books works in a pinch.
YOUR NUMBERS ON YOUR WRIST
With Apple Watch, each shot's numbers appear on your wrist in real time, so you can stay in your rhythm.
PLAY CHIPIN GAMES Make practice fun. Hit real shots with your own club and ball, and watch them play out in ChipIn games on a second screen: your iPad, laptop or monitor, or stream to your TV. Your iPhone tracks every shot from behind you while the game plays at chipin.golf. • Red Rock Challenge: Perfect your chip game in a desert canyon • Paradise Pin: Get closest to the pin on an island green • Bullseye Blast: Six shots. FREE TO START
Download free and try PRO features free for 7 days.

Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

bluejetty:00088675:ios.name: Invoice Maker・Estimate App
bluejetty:00088675:ios.summary: Invoice Maker is a simple invoice and estimate app for contractors, tradespeople, freelancers, and small businesses. Create a professional invoice or estimate on your iPhone or iPad in minutes, send it as a PDF, and keep track of who has pa
bluejetty:00088675:ios.description:
Invoice Maker is a simple invoice and estimate app for contractors, tradespeople, freelancers, and small businesses. Create a professional invoice or estimate on your iPhone or iPad in minutes, send it as a PDF, and keep track of who has paid.
It is built for people who need fast, clean billing, not full accounting software. If you need bookkeeping, payroll, or crew scheduling, a larger tool will suit you better. If you want to quote a job, bill it, and get back to work, this is made for that.
WHO IT'S FOR
Plumbers, electricians, HVAC technicians, roofers, painters, carpenters, landscapers, cleaners, handymen, mechanics, consultants, and freelancers.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Create invoices with your business details, logo, customer information, labor, materials, quantities, rates, taxes, discounts, payment terms, and notes
- Create estimates and quotes before work begins, then convert an approved estimate into an invoice without retyping anything
- Create receipts
- Preview every document, export it as a PDF, and share it by email, text message, WhatsApp, or any other app on your device
- Mark invoices as paid or unpaid and see what still needs attention
- Save customers, products, and services to reuse on future jobs
- Choose from a variety of templates
- Work on iPhone or iPad, with a sidebar and roomier layout on iPad
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add your business details and logo.
2. Add a customer and your line items: labor, materials, services.
3. Preview the document, export a PDF, and send it.
4. Mark it paid when the money arrives.
FROM QUOTE TO FINAL INVOICE
Send an estimate before the job. When the customer approves, convert it to an invoice in one tap. Customer details and line items carry over, so you only enter them once.
COMMON USES
- Invoice a customer right after a completed job
- Send a quote or estimate before work starts
- Create PDF invoices and receipts
- Track paid and unpaid invoices
- Reuse saved customers and services for repeat work
- Handle billing for contractor or freelance work
FREE TO TRY, PREMIUM TO UNLOCK MORE
Invoice Maker is free to download. Share, save and print every client-ready document. Unlimited invoices.
FAQ
What is Invoice Maker used for?
Creating invoices, estimates, quotes, receipts, and PDF billing documents for small businesses, contractors, and freelancers.
Is it good for contractors?
Yes. Add labor, materials, services, taxes, discounts, and payment terms to invoices and estimates, and turn approved estimates into invoices.
Is it a full accounting app?
No. It focuses on invoicing and estimates, and on tracking paid and unpaid work.
Can I send invoices as PDFs?
Yes. Preview, export, and share them by email, text, WhatsApp, or other apps.
Does it work on iPad?
Yes. Invoice Maker is optimized for iPhone and iPad.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Premium is available as a weekly, monthly, or annual auto-renewing subscription. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID account settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://the-invoice-machine.web.app/legal/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Less paperwork. More time for your business.

bluejetty:00187671:ios.description:
Is It Love? Colin is an interactive story in English.
Like in a TV series, new episodes (chapters) are regularly released.
You can download this love game for free. Will you find Love? Will you make it in the musical world?
Story:
You come from a small town, you have a well-ordered life: Basic studies, a very respectful boyfriend and parents who decided on your future. You've always dreamed of becoming a pianist, But your father didn't look on it with a favourable eye, so you did what was expected of you. And then, one day, you felt trapped in your monotonous life. So you decided to leave it all behind and move to New York. But, after so many years, having put your dreams aside, your piano gathered dust and your mojo disappeared. At the Carter Corporation, you found a stable office job and good friends. And one night, Matt invites you along to a rock concert. A concert that changes everything. Your encounter with Colin, the leader of the group, turns your world upside down. This black-hearted character as stirring as he is inaccessible will awaken that old fire that burned in your heart: your love of music...
Main points:
- Experience a true love story
- Your choices influence the course of the episode
- 100% in English.
- Become a rock star
An Otome is a visual novel type game in which you are the heroine about to live true romance (love story) with possible twists (Love, seduction, betrayal, marriage...).
Download this seduction game with the rock theme, if you:
- Love animated love stories
- Watch romantic movies, shows and even musicals.
- Want to live a love story with a singer
- Play a new interactive story in English
Follow us:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/isitlovegames/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/isitlovegames
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/weareisitlovegames/
Got any problems or questions?
Contact our in-game support team by clicking on Menu and then Support.
Our story:
1492 Studio is based in Montpellier, France. It was co-founded in 2014 by Claire and Thibaud Zamora, two entrepreneurs with over twenty years’ experience in the freemium game industry. Acquired by Ubisoft in 2018, the studio has forged ahead in creating interactive stories in the form of visual novels, further enriching the content of their "Is It Love?" series. With a total of fourteen mobile applications with more than 60 million downloads to date, 1492 Studio designs games that take players on a journey through worlds that are rich in intrigue, suspense and, of course, romance. The studio continues to provide live games by creating additional content and keeping in touch with a strong and active fan base while working on upcoming projects.

bluejetty:00119412:ios.description:
Inspired by Getting Things Done®, Nirvana is your trusted space to capture all your to-dos, organize with intention, and focus on what matters right now.
Ever feel like you're juggling too much? Nirvana offers a gentle, flexible way to get things done—no pressure, no clutter, no guilt.
Here's how it works
• Capture to-dos as they pop up
• Clarify what needs doing and what can wait
• Organize using Projects, Areas, and Tags
• Review regularly to stay on track
• Engage with what's most important right now
Smart views that help you focus
• Next — things you can do anytime
• Scheduled — to do in the future
• Someday — ideas on the back burner
Everything stays in sync across your devices, so you can check in whenever, wherever.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
"Your mind is for having ideas, not holding them." — David Allen
Whether you're balancing work, creative projects, family life, or all of the above, Nirvana frees your mind with the confidence that everything is captured and nothing gets missed.
"It's by far the best GTD app I have used (and I've tried them all!)." — Damian Surr
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Questions, suggestions, or want to learn more?  Visit https://www.nirvanahq.com or email us at support@nirvanahq.com

bluejetty:00155115:ios.description:
Jonesburg State Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Jonesburg State Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Jonesburg State Bank app, you must be enrolled as a (F.I. NAME) digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00170045:ios.description:
Animal Guide is a fans made guidebook for 「Animal crossing: new horizons」.
This program provides everything you need in ACNH. 
You can mark your collected items, view current active animals, explore new furniture, meet some friends, and more...
Come and join us. Let's enjoy the fun with Animal Crossing!
Special Features:
「Realtime active animal list」- check out current active animals, or you can set a specific date and time.
「Daily checklist」- mark your daily activities like hitting rocks, fossils, talking with villagers.
「Mark collected items」- mark your collected items, you can also mark as favourite items and add to your custom wishlist.
「Event room」- hold your custom event like a high selling price of turnip, touch item event etc.
「Exchange market」- exchange items with other players with tickets/bells/other items.
「Wishlist」- custom your wishlist, and share to your friends.
「Turnip price prediction」- track and predict your island turnip pricing.
「Dream and make friend」- share your dream address and your character to meet more friends.
「Light/Dark mode」- support dark mode.
「Share information function」- you can share your character, collected items, favourite items, collected progress and wishlists to your friends.
Game information. you can check out all the information and mark as collected, favourited, or add to your wishlist, and share them to your friends:
「Full animal list」- list all fish, insects, sea creatures information including active time, active weather, pricing, position...
「DIY recipes」- full list of DIY recipes, and you view their source from and the DIY format.
「Furniture list」- list all tools, housewares, miscellaneous, wall-mounted, wallpaper, rugs, floor, fencing, equipment, Photo, Poster and Others items. And you view their source from and the DIY format.
「Clothing list」- list all Headwear, Dress-up, top, bottom, sock, shoe, Accessory, bag and Umbrella items. And you view their source, styles and themes.
「Villager List」- knows more about your villagers or explore other new villagers by their hobby, personality, gender, birthday... 
「Works of art List」- compare the real and fake artwork, and their detailed information.
「K.K. Song List」- mark your collected song list.
「Fossil list」- mark your collected fossil list.
「Reaction List」- list all reaction information including source and related villagers.
「Flower list」- show planting formats of flowers
*DISCLAIMER*
This is an unofficial app for Animal crossing: new horizons.. This app is not affiliated with the Animal crossing brand, Niantic, Animal Crossing: New Horizons, or Nintendo.

bluejetty:00180503:ios.summary:

Favorite Features:

• Stay Prepared: The numbers that decide your day come first: te
bluejetty:00180503:ios.description:
Weather for people with places to be. Forecasts, air quality, and pollen. Everything you need before you walk out the door.
Favorite Features:
Accurate, Actionable Forecasts
• Stay Prepared: The numbers that decide your day come first: temperature, wind, and the chance of rain.
• Minute-by-Minute Precipitation: MinuteCast® tells you the minute rain starts or stops at your exact location. Plan your day with precision.
• Severe Weather Safety: Opt-in alerts for dangerous weather, major storms, and heat waves. You decide what’s worth an alert.
• Detailed Daily Planning: Hourly, 5-day, and 10-day forecasts, so you can plan the week and adjust when it changes.
• RealFeel®: The thermometer doesn't tell the whole story. RealFeel® factors in wind and humidity. Know what to wear for the weather before you're in it.
• Widgets: The forecast before you open the app.
• Light & Dark Mode: Choose the look that works for you, or let it match your phone.
Interactive Radar & Maps
• Live Weather Radar: What's falling right now, on your street or anywhere on the globe.
• Track Storms: See where a storm is headed and when it will reach you.
Air Quality, Pollen & Health
• Air Quality: Real-time AQI, so you can check the air before walking the dog, your commute, or a day outside.
• Pollen Count: Daily pollen counts for tree, grass, and weed, so allergy season has fewer surprises.
• UV Index: Sunburn risk for the day, even when it's cool or cloudy, so you know when to cover up.
• Humidity & Dew Point: A better read on how the air will feel than temperature alone.
Travel & Multi-City Tracking
• Know Before You Go: Add up to 20 cities to your dashboard. Pack for the weather that's where you’ll actually be.
• Multi-City Swipe: One swipe between your hometown, your next trip, and your favorite destinations.
• Airport Weather: The forecast at major airports, so you know the weather at both ends of your flight.
Photography & Design
• Beautiful Photography: Real photos matched to your location, the time of day, and what the sky is doing right now.
• Clean Interface: Open the app, get your answer, go. Nothing between you and the forecast.
• Moon Phase: Tonight's phase, moonrise and moonset, and days until the next full moon.
Accessibility
• Works with your device's built-in screen reader. Optimized for color contrast. Follows the text size you set on your device. 
Helpful Tips
• Scroll Down: For detailed weather information, simply scroll down on the main screen.
• Manage Locations: Tap the search button and add your favorite cities to see their forecasts. Perfect for following the weather where your people live.
Download Yahoo Weather. Accurate forecasts, real photography, and a quick answer to what today looks like.

bluejetty:00097987:ios.description:
Welcome to Sizzle TV - Your Go-To for Bite-Sized Drama!
Picture this: You're stuck in a long line or killing time on your commute. Instead of scrolling endlessly through social media, why not dive into a world of drama, romance, and excitement? Sizzle TV is here to bring short dramas & movies to your fingertips.
Here, we give you big entertainment in bite-sized chunks. Our vertical TV mini-series are designed to be watched on the go, which fit right into your busy life. Whether you're on your commute, waiting in line, or just need a quick escape, we've got thrilling stories for you.
Here’s why you’ll love Sizzle TV:
-Exclusive Content: Don't miss out on fantastic content you can’t find anywhere else. Stay ahead of the curve with the latest in streaming drama.
-Daily Updates: Bored? Never again! New shorts hit the app constantly, so there's always something fresh to watch.
-Endless variety: Dive into genres upon genres from steamy billionaire romances to tear-jerking dramas, from epic comebacks to thrilling adventures.
-HD Quality: Enjoy every scene in crisp, high-definition quality that brings stories to life.
-Vertical Viewing: Designed for your phone, our vertical format makes watching on-the-go a breeze.
Who's Sizzle TV for?
- Busy bees who love a good story but don't have hours to spare
- Drama addicts who can't get enough of juicy plots and plot twists
- Commuters looking to spice up their journey
- Anyone who's ever said "I wish I had more time to watch TV"
Start your journey into the captivating world of short drama and movies. It's like having a pocket theater in your hand, anytime, anywhere.
Note:
- If you subscribe through Apple, the payment will be deducted from your App Store account upon confirmation.
- After completing the purchase, you can manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal in Account Settings in the iTunes store.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period, and no fees will be deducted after cancellation.
Privacy Policy: https://sizzle.tv/sizzle-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://sizzle.tv/sizzle-terms-of-service.html

bluejetty:00138327:ios.summary: Ready to transform your life one positive thought at a time? Say goodbye to self-doubt, low self-esteem, anxiety, stress, and depression, and hello to confidence, positivity, high self-esteem, and self-love with our Affirmation App “Affirm”
bluejetty:00138327:ios.description:
Ready to transform your life one positive thought at a time? Say goodbye to self-doubt, low self-esteem, anxiety, stress, and depression, and hello to confidence, positivity, high self-esteem, and self-love with our Affirmation App “Affirm”.
An affirmation is a positive statement or declaration that is consciously chosen and repeated to encourage a positive mindset and self-empowerment. Affirmations are often used as a tool to shift one's thoughts and beliefs, promoting a more optimistic and confident outlook on life.
The idea behind “Affirm” is to focus on positive aspects, goals, or attributes, reinforcing them in the mind to counteract negative or self-limiting thoughts. By regularly repeating affirmations, individuals aim to cultivate a more positive and resilient mindset, stopping overthinking, and worry and ultimately influencing their actions and overall well-being. 
Why Choose Affirm?
1. In addition to reading, you can also listen to great affirmations while walking, driving, or even while sleeping.
2. The best and most carefully selected affirmations for you to reprogram your subconscious mind.
3. Daily Reminders: Get daily affirmations at optimal times, keeping you in a positive mindset throughout your day.
4. Powerful Visualizations: Immerse yourself in your ideal future through personalized visualizations accompanied by calming background music.
5. Widgets: Enjoy the convenience of accessing empowering affirmations anytime, anywhere, without even needing to click a button.
6. Write your own affirmations: Write down and own your unique affirmations.
7. Share Image affirmations on social media.
8. Make your collection of favorite affirmations.
What we feel, How we feel, think, and believe determines our outcome. 
As Theodore Roosevelt wisely said: Believe you can and you’re halfway there.
Benefits of using Affirm
* Positive Mindset Cultivation: Daily affirmations help cultivate and maintain a positive mindset, fostering a more optimistic and constructive outlook on life.
* Stress Reduction: Regular exposure to affirmations can aid in stress reduction, promoting a sense of calm and resilience in the face of challenges.
* Increased Self-Confidence: Affirmations can boost self-confidence by reinforcing positive beliefs and encouraging a healthier self-image.
* Goal Alignment and Focus: Reading or listening to affirmations that align with personal goals helps individuals stay focused on their aspirations, enhancing motivation and determination.
* Improved Mental Well-being: Affirmations contribute to improved mental well-being by promoting self-awareness, self-love, and acceptance, leading to a more balanced emotional state.
* Enhanced Productivity: A positive mindset cultivated through daily affirmations can contribute to increased productivity as individuals approach tasks with a can-do attitude and enthusiasm.
* Better Sleep Quality: Listening to calming affirmations before bedtime can aid in relaxation, contributing to improved sleep quality and overall well-being.
Download it now and embark on a journey to your best life!
  To have access to the “Affirm Premium" content and functionality, you can purchase a monthly and an annual auto-renewable subscription. This is a recurring transaction that will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of your subscription. Renewals will be charged the same cost within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Read our terms and conditions here:
https://sites.google.com/view/daily-affirm/terms-and-conditions
Read our privacy policy here:
https://sites.google.com/view/daily-affirm/privacy-policy
