bluejetty:00017481:ios.description:
Youtubers Life is the ultimate life simulation/tycoon videogame. Become the world’s greatest gaming video blogger in history by editing videos, expanding the number of fans /subscribers, and turning yourself into a billionaire. Create your character —customize it as you wish, there are thousands of hilarious combinations— and start making your first broadcasts in the cozy room at your parents’ where you grew up since you were little. Record gameplay sessions, buy new and classic consoles, keep an eye on daily tasks, and socialize to increase your popularity while you deal with fans, friends, family and time management!
Make the best gaming videos
Editing your own videos has never been so immersive! Follow the whole process from A to Z and publish your broadcasts on the Internet! Purchase your favorite titles online, get them delivered at home, and start recording your gameplay sessions. Improve your videos as you become the greatest video blogger ever! 
Experience the real Youtuber's Life!
Being a vlogger is not only about recording videos and getting as many views as possible —you also need to cool down and have some fun in your daily life! Go to the cinema to watch the latest movie releases, attend presentations of new games, chill out in the club or party in a luxurious yacht! Meet new friends and discover your other half while you keep thinking about the next broadcast you want to make when you get back home.
Become a famous Celebrity
The more viewers you reach the more popular you’ll be! As you become more populara celebrity on social media, more VIP’s will be interested in meeting you in person. Important high-tech and gaming brands will contact you and you will eventually meet other famous youtubers. Your fans will battle with all their might to get your autograph!
Become a famous gamer on the Gaming Channel!

bluejetty:00141254:ios.summary:

Pitched Tuner and Pitch Pipe has been designed by musicians to help you quickly and easily tune your instrument using the microphone on your device.
It works well for a wid
bluejetty:00141254:ios.description:
A chromatic tuner and pitch pipe used by over a million musicians.
Pitched Tuner and Pitch Pipe has been designed by musicians to help you quickly and easily tune your instrument using the microphone on your device.
It works well for a wide range of instruments: Ukulele, violin, mandolin, flute, guitars, voice, and more. Even very low bass strings can be tuned. Simple controls and clear visuals make it great for beginners. Responsive and precise algorithms provide professional level accuracy for more advanced players.
Hands free tuning means you can tune all of your strings without ever having to touch the screen - you don't want to have to reach for your ukulele tuner in between tuning each string, and now you don't have to.
This tuner app has two modes: 
 - Instrument tuner
 - Chromatic tuner 
The instrument tuner shows you the target notes for the instrument and tuning that you have selected - this is particularly useful for stringed instruments. For example a guitar tuner would show the notes EADGBE if you chose standard guitar tuning, or DADGBE if you chose drop D tuning. Or a violin tuner would show GDAE. You can then just play each string and the tuner will identify whether you are in tune. Pitched Tuner has built in tunings for many common instruments including banjo, bass 4, 5 and 6 string, cello, double bass, guitar including 7 string, ukulele, viola and violin. If your instrument or your preferred tuning aren't included then you can easily create your own in the app. Please email us if you want your tuning added to the built in ones.
The chromatic tuner displays the note that is closest to what is currently being played. If you play an A, it shows an A. This is useful for instruments with lots of notes (piano tuning for example). Some stringed players might also prefer this mode - particularly if you play instruments with several common tunings such as the guitar (it's personal preference!). It means you can quickly tune your guitar from standard to drop D without having to touch the app (assuming it's already visible on your screen).
Pitched Tuner displays a traditional tuner needle and dial. It clearly shows the frequency being played as well as the nearest note and error in cents (one cent is one hundredth of a semitone). The dial then allows you to easily track small changes in pitch. A separate volume indicator tells you how clearly the microphone is picking up your instrument sound.
Other features include:
- Vary the reference tuning pitch away from the common 440Hz. 
- Able to adjust for non-concert pitch instruments, for example the B-flat trumpet. 
- Choice of light or dark themes 
- Adjust the volume sensitivity of the app for quieter instruments and noisy environments.
This tuning app also works as a pitch pipe and can sound a reference note to tune your instrument by ear (which is always a good skill to practice), or use as a target note when you are re-stringing your guitar/violin/etc. You can choose from a pure sine sound, which is precise but quiet, or a simulated piano, guitar or clarinet.
We hope you find Pitched Tuner useful. You can always contact us at support@stonekick.com

bluejetty:00041315:ios.description:
Relax and have fun playing high quality jigsaw puzzles! We have puzzles for every taste and interest!
SELECT DIFFICULTY
• 20 difficulty levels: 9 to 625 pieces.
• 7 distinct puzzle piece shapes to choose from.
• Rotation of puzzle pieces can be turned on or off.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR PUZZLING EXPERIENCE
• 25 backgrounds to choose from.
• Play with tray on or off.
• Scatter puzzle pieces in an organized or random manner.
• Shadow Preview option allows you to see a transparent image of the puzzle in the solving area.
• Show all puzzle pieces or edge pieces only.
• Preview the puzzle image while you're playing. You may move the Preview window and change its size.
• Large canvas playing area. You may zoom out, or zoom in and move the canvas around on your screen.
• Lock the screen in place to avoid accidental movement of the canvas as you're dragging puzzle pieces.
• Turn music and sounds on or off.
FREE DAILY PUZZLE
Every day a different puzzle will appear under My Gallery in the Today's Free Puzzle frame.
PUZZLES IN PROGRESS
Unfinished puzzles will be automatically saved under In Progress. You can continue playing these puzzles anytime or you can delete the ones you don't want.
BATTERY SAVER MODE
Our game has Battery Saver Mode turned on by default. It conserves the battery life while you are playing, providing hours of additional gameplay without a need to recharge.
CONTACT US
We'd love to hear from you! For questions or comments, please email us at support@relaxinggamesllc.com
NOTE
If you purchase a puzzle pack, advertisements will be removed for all of the puzzles in that pack. The "No Ads" in-app purchase will remove all advertisements from the free daily puzzle and the free puzzle packs. You may find the "No Ads" in-app purchase in the Settings, along with Restore Purchases.
Privacy Policy: http://www.relaxinggamesllc.com/privacy.html

• 20 difficulty levels: 9 to 625 pieces.
• 7 distinct puzzle piece shapes to choose from.
• Rotation of puzzle pieces can be turned on or off.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR PUZZLING EXPERIENCE
• 25 backgrounds to choose from.
• Play with tray on or off.
• Scatter puzzle pieces in an organized or random manner.
• Shadow Preview option allows you to see a transparent image of the puzzle in the solving area.
• Show all puzzle pieces or edge pieces only.
• Preview the puzzle image while you're playing. You may move the Preview window and change its size.
• Large canvas playing area. You may zoom out, or zoom in and move the canvas around on your screen.
• Lock the screen in place to avoid accidental movement of the canvas as you're dragging puzzle pieces.
• Turn music and sounds on or off.

FREE DAILY PUZZLE
Every day a different puzzle will appear under My Gallery in the Today's Free Puzzle frame.

PUZZLES IN PROGRESS
Unfinished puzzles will be automatically saved under In Progress. You can continue playing these puzzles anytime or you can delete the ones you don't want.

BATTERY SAVER MODE

bluejetty:00083794:ios.name: One in a Trillion
bluejetty:00083794:ios.summary:
One in a Trillion: The Ultimate Collection Game!
An odds based tapper game where you compete with friends and the community to hunt rare eggs that range in rarity of 1 in 250 taps, all the way up to the insane 1 in 1,000,000,000,000!
Dive
bluejetty:00083794:ios.description:
One in a Trillion: The Ultimate Collection Game!
An odds based tapper game where you compete with friends and the community to hunt rare eggs that range in rarity of 1 in 250 taps, all the way up to the insane 1 in 1,000,000,000,000!
Dive into possibly the world’s biggest mobile collection game! Collect eggs with insane rarities, yolk them & build completely unique cards for your collection!
Can You Beat the Odds?
Ready… Eggy… Go!
- No ads, not a single one!
- Solo dev passion project with constant updates—your feedback is always welcome!
- Simple core gameplay: drag your finger to collect eggs, gems, boosts, and more.
- The biggest long-term collection game imaginable.
- Over 235+ creatively designed eggs to collect in multiple ways, with more being added regularly.
- Complete each egg by collecting it in 5 different ways, including creating Glyphcards.
- Glyphcards are a hard earned process to create a totally unique card for an egg, share it with the community & strive for the best collection possible.
- Egg rarity ranges from 1 in 250 to 1 in a trillion—pray to the RNG gods or focus on progression!
- Progress and enhance your ability to find the rarest eggs through egg incubators & increasing luck sauce base and costs.
- Collect special yolks to rest those hands and Instant Play.
- Daily rewards, egg boost slots, leagues & prizes every 4 hours.
- Optional competitive gameplay includes team battles, daily leagues, player rankings, prizes, and more.
- Use Tripply’s & Dubbly Jubbly’s to accumulate insane multiplayer scores
- Scavenger Hunt eggs: use clues and chat with the community to discover how to unlock them.
- Join our friendly Discord community!
- Enjoy semi-offline play.
One in a Trillion is a casual collection game you can play for years. Even if the insanely rare eggs seem hard to collect, you can work on creating Glyphcards and compete against friends in daily leagues for prizes.
Experience our unique dragging mechanism in the core gameplay, which is more satisfying than traditional clicking or tapping.
Multiplayer seamlessly blends effort and luck for a casual take on competitive play.
While this game is not idle, fans of incremental or idle games may find enjoyment here too.
SUPPORT: 
Are you experiencing issues? Email the dev at help@hamlab.dev for further help. Alternatively, join our Discord.

bluejetty:00024797:ios.name: Knight Hero Adventure idle RPG
bluejetty:00024797:ios.summary:
Your knight runs and fights through monsters automatically. You decide how the rewards from each run become more power for the next battle.
Knight Hero is an auto-run RPG built around repeated combat runs, gear decisions, and steady long-t
bluejetty:00024797:ios.description:
Your knight runs and fights through monsters automatically. You decide how the rewards from each run become more power for the next battle.
Knight Hero is an auto-run RPG built around repeated combat runs, gear decisions, and steady long-term growth. Collect rewards, improve your setup, and return to the bosses that stopped you.
TURN EACH RUN INTO MORE POWER
Collect swords, shields, armor, and bows as you fight. Compare their stats, equip stronger pieces, and keep the gear that fits your build.
MAKE UNWANTED GEAR MATTER
Not every drop belongs in your equipment. Spoil unwanted gear to advance magic progress and choose potion rewards for your next attempt.
ROLL NEW GEAR AT THE FORGE
Need a different upgrade? Use the Forge to roll combat gear and keep shaping your setup before another run.
BREAK THROUGH TOUGH BOSSES
A failed attempt is a reason to rebuild. Improve your stats, unlock skills, use boosters, and return with a better plan and more power.
PRESTIGE AND BEGIN STRONGER
When progress slows, use Prestige to start a new cycle with lasting bonuses. Earlier runs become the foundation for reaching harder stages.
BUILD POWER THAT STAYS
Expand the Style Pavilion with collectible styles that grant permanent bonuses alongside your regular combat gear.
TAKE ON THE DUNGEON
Enter a separate, coin-focused challenge when you want another way to test your progress and fund more upgrades.
The knight handles the running and fighting. You choose what to equip, what to spoil, what to improve, and when to begin again.

bluejetty:00118959:ios.description:
DocOCR – Smart PDF Scanner & OCR Tool for Education
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a powerful document scanner and text recognizer with DocOCR.
Whether you’re a student, teacher, or school administrator, DocOCR helps you scan, recognize, organize, and share documents easily and securely — all on your device. No internet required for OCR or image processing, ensuring complete privacy and data protection.
- OCR & Document Scanning Made Simple
Scan and recognize text from:
 • Printed documents
 • Books & whiteboards
 • Receipts & business cards
 • Posters, coupons, and more
Save scans as searchable PDFs and annotate or sign them directly within the app.
Photo Collage Mode
Combine multiple pages (e.g., front and back of ID cards) onto a single A4/Letter page — perfect for printing or sharing.
- Smart Image Processing
DocOCR automatically:
 • Detects document edges
 • Corrects perspective and curved surfaces
 • Removes shadows and enhances clarity
Ideal for low-light conditions or quick classroom captures.
- Powerful Document Management
Organize your scans with ease:
 • Create, rename, merge, split, or move files and folders
 • Drag and drop to group documents
 • Full-text search on OCR results (Bronze Plan)
 • iCloud Drive sync for access across devices (Bronze Plan)
Import, Export & Share
 • Support PDF encryption and decryption
 • Email as PDF or JPEG
 • Export OCR text as TXT or DOCX
 • Fax to 100+ countries (via in-app purchase)
 • Print via AirPrint
 • Upload/download with: iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Box, SMB, WebDAV (Bronze Plan)
 • “Open In” support for apps like iBooks and Adobe Reader
File Import
 • Import PDFs or images via “Open In” from other apps
 • Import files from your favorite cloud services
Fax Anywhere
 • Send/receive faxes directly from the app
 • Get notified when fax is sent or received
 • Subscribe to a personal fax number for inbound faxes
 • Block incoming faxes when not needed
- Bronze Plan Subscription
Unlock advanced features like cloud sync, full-text search, and cloud storage support.
 • Billed monthly or annually
 • Auto-renews unless canceled 24 hours before the end of the current period
 • Manage subscriptions in your App Store account
 • Unused trial periods are forfeited upon subscription
Terms of Service: https://ifunplay.com/legal.html

bluejetty:00182636:ios.summary:

Seeker's Notes
bluejetty:00182636:ios.description:
Welcome to Darkwood—a haunted Victorian city no one can escape.
Chosen by a magical map, only you can break the ancient curse. Explore misty streets shrouded in mystery, find hidden objects, and uncover secrets lost to time.
Seeker's Notes offers more than just classic hidden object gameplay—it's a rich, immersive adventure for those who love the thrill of discovery. Each beautifully crafted scene invites you to solve intricate puzzles and dive deeper into a world where elegance and intrigue intertwine.
As you progress, you'll collect powerful artifacts, mysterious chests, and exclusive avatars—each reward marking your growth as a true Seeker. You won't be alone on this journey. Join a global community of over 40 million players—share tips, take part in events, and explore this captivating world together.
Awaiting you in Seekers Notes:
● Each LOCATION is a work of art! As you search for hidden objects, discover gorgeous locations honed to the finest detail and inspired by the eternal beauty of the classics!
● Incredible PUZZLES! Match 3 levels, logic and memory games, plus a beautiful mosaic jigsaw game. Choose what you prefer.
● SPOT THE DIFFERENCE! Test your sharpness of vision and speed of mind to spot the differences between two beautiful pictures.
● Gripping STORY! Family secrets, intrigues, forbidden love, and mysterious crimes—following the clues in thrilling twist-filled plots to find out what mysteries hide behind Darkwood's beautiful facades will inspire a whirlwind of emotions!
● CHAT with other Seekers! There are more than 40 million fans already in the game. Need a hint on how to solve a puzzle? Want to share your excitement about in-game events? You'll never be alone here!
● Charming CHARACTERS! Make friends with Darkwood residents and use your detective skills to help them cope with an ancient curse as you solve crime together and get closer to the mystery behind the Mist.
● Gorgeous COLLECTIONS! Seek out hidden objects and solve puzzles to complete game quests, find the missing items in collections, and get unique artifacts!
● MONSTERS and magical creatures! Find weapons to banish dangerous creatures and placate the good ones!

bluejetty:00179520:ios.description:
The White Noise Market native app is the best way to download FREE sounds to White Noise, White Noise Pro, White Noise Lite, and White Noise Baby. Upload your existing White Noise recordings and mixes to share your audio experiences with the entire White Noise community. Join us in helping others relax during the day and sleep great at night!
Discover thousands of White Noise Market sounds and download them into White Noise for free. Browse by featured sounds, recent sounds, or by sound category. Check out the latest chatter to see what sound everyone is talking about. Upload your own audio recordings from your unique part of the world. Navigate the world map to find unique sounds or search by keyword to find the perfect sound. Leave comments and start a conversation about the sounds you enjoy the most. Sounds will be quickly downloaded in the background and made available to all of our White Noise apps including White Noise, White Noise Lite, White Noise Pro, and White Noise Baby. New sounds are posted daily so check back often and enable notifications to be the first to download our weekly featured sounds.
Features
- Quickly download new sounds directly to the White Noise, White Noise Lite, White Noise Pro, and White Noise Baby
- Upload recordings and mixes to share your audio experience with the entire community.
- Discover thousands of sounds users are talking about with the Chatter view.
- Push notifications when weekly featured sounds are available for download or users respond to your comments.
- Today widget can be enabled to show you the 3 most recent featured sounds.
- Explore specific sound categories such as ASMR, Binaural Beats, Nature, Music, Meditation, and more!
- Discover unique sounds from around the world by navigating the world map of recordings.
- Make friends by starting a conversation with other White Noise users. Heart and post comments about your favorite sounds and mixes.
- Preview sounds before you download and share your favorites.
- Stream or purchase sounds at popular digital stores including iTunes and Apple Music.
- Supports Portrait/Landscape orientations and Retina resolutions for all versions of iPhone and iPad.
Popular sounds available from the market include:
Box Fan, Rain Storm, Tent Rain, Waterfall, Windy Pines, River Rapids, Marina Dock, Rock Beach, Ocean Waves, Bamboo Wind Chimes, Blizzard, Passenger Train, Summer Cicadas, Rain on Tin Roof, Lawn Mower, and many more added every week.
Login with your email or favorite social network to download unlimited sounds, upload your recordings, send hearts, and post comments. Guest login is also supported but limited to only a few downloads per day.
Sound downloads, uploads, and server bandwidth are supported by advertising.
Market Premium Features:
* Subscriber Badge - Show others you are supporting development of the Market with a trendy gold badge.
* Double Zen - Earn Zen at twice the rate!
* Unlimited Uploads - Record & Upload without limits.
* Priority Review - Your uploads will be reviewed before anyone else.
* No Ads - Save your network. Listen to more sounds.
Market Premium is an optional subscription available monthly or yearly from date of purchase. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew at the chosen monthly or yearly rate unless canceled 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple ID account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period unless canceled. You can manage your subscription, cancel anytime, or turn off automatic renewal from your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://tmsoft.com/about/privacy
Terms & Conditions: https://tmsoft.com/about/terms
Thanks for being a part of the White Noise community!

bluejetty:00084697:ios.name: Alpha Progression Gym Tracker
bluejetty:00084697:ios.summary:
Stop guessing. Pro builds your plan and recommends weight and reps for every set, adapting to how strong you are today. Free logging, no account. 14-day free trial.
Alpha Progression tells you exactly what to lift. Every set, every workout
bluejetty:00084697:ios.description:
Stop guessing. Pro builds your plan and recommends weight and reps for every set, adapting to how strong you are today. Free logging, no account. 14-day free trial.
Alpha Progression tells you exactly what to lift. Every set, every workout. Build your plan in a minute, then follow weight and rep recommendations that adapt to how strong you are today.
Most gym apps only record what you did. Alpha Progression plans what you should do next: a science-based training plan built for your goal, your experience and your equipment, and a progression recommendation for every single set.
App of the Day on the App Store, twice. 4.9 stars from 40,000+ lifters. 25 million workouts logged.
YOUR PLAN, GENERATED
Pick your goal, the days you can train, how long you have and which muscles to prioritize. The plan generator builds a complete plan around the equipment in your gym: split, exercises, sets and rep ranges. Beginners and advanced lifters get fundamentally different plans, because they need different things. Every detail stays editable, or build your own plan from scratch. Need just one session? The workout generator creates a one-off workout whenever you want.
A RECOMMENDATION FOR EVERY SET
Before each set, the app shows the weight and reps to go for, based on your previous workouts and what you have already done today. Recommendations shift from set to set because fatigue is real: set 3 is not set 1. Keep hitting them and they keep climbing. Progressive overload without spreadsheets or guesswork.
LOG FAST, STAY IN THE ZONE
Weight, reps and RIR in two taps, with your notes and your last sets in view. Rest timer as a Live Activity, so the countdown and your next set sit on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island. Supersets, dropsets, bodyweight, assisted and timed exercises. Works fully offline.
795 EXERCISES, REAL VIDEOS
Every exercise filmed in a real gym with certified trainers. No stock footage, no animations. Setup, execution and cues for each one, plus an exercise evaluation of how well it builds muscle. Filter by muscle, equipment and compound vs isolation. Missing an exercise? Add your own, with a photo from your library or the camera, or copy an existing one as a starting point.
SEE WHAT IMPROVED
After every workout you see every record you beat: weight, reps, volume, estimated 1RM and 10RM, best per muscle group. Charts for strength, volume, sets per muscle, workouts per week, bodyweight and measurements. Streaks and achievements keep you showing up.
AND MORE
Warm-up calculator: warm-up sets are added automatically, scaled to the exercise, your first working set and the weights you have. Plate calculator: exactly which plates to load, or the closest weight below if your plates don't add up. Multiple gyms, each with its own equipment and weights; switch with one tap and your recommendations adjust. Periodization and deloads: ramp sets and effort (RIR) week by week and schedule deloads. Share plans with friends or coaching clients. Export everything as CSV. kg and lb, even mixed. An optional account syncs all your devices. Syncs with Apple Health.
FREE VS PRO
Free: unlimited workout logging, all 795 exercise videos, your own plans, measurements, rest timer, records, achievements, plan sharing and CSV export. No ads. No account required.
Pro: plan generator and workout generator, progression recommendations, charts, multiple gyms, periodization and deloads, plate calculator, warm-up calculator, exercise evaluations and images for custom exercises. 14-day free trial on the yearly plan.
Built by lifters: certified trainers with bodybuilding experience who train with the app every week. Questions? info@alphaprogression.com
Terms of service: https://alphaprogression.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://alphaprogression.com/privacy

bluejetty:00121080:ios.summary:
Color Block Match is three relaxing puzzle games in one — match colors, clear blocks, and solve jigsaw shapes. No pop-up ads, just blocks.
One app, three completely different ways to unwind. Sharpen your mind in an endless color-matching c
bluejetty:00121080:ios.description:
Color Block Match is three relaxing puzzle games in one — match colors, clear blocks, and solve jigsaw shapes. No pop-up ads, just blocks.
One app, three completely different ways to unwind. Sharpen your mind in an endless color-matching challenge, chase limited-time block adventures, or piece together a jigsaw — whether you have two spare minutes or a whole cozy evening, there's a mode for your mood.
BLOCK MATCH — The Endless Color Puzzle
Place pieces on the grid and connect three or more blocks of the same color to blast them away. Start with three colors and unlock all nine as your score climbs — the longer you play, the richer it gets. Every block you clear also paints in a hidden pixel-art picture: finish one, hang it in your Gallery, and start revealing the next.
ADVENTURE — Limited-Time Block Events
The classic clear-the-lines block puzzle, reborn as a recurring event. Each adventure brings a fresh set of shaped levels: drop blocks, fill complete rows and columns to clear them, and finish the whole journey before the countdown runs out. Complete it and the fireworks are yours — then keep an eye out for the next adventure.
JIGSAW — Piece It Together
Dozens of hand-crafted shape puzzles — animals, objects, and little scenes built entirely from block pieces. Drag pieces from the tray and fit them into exactly the right spots to bring each picture to life. Easy to grasp, wonderfully satisfying to finish, and new puzzles arrive with every update.
MORE TO PLAY FOR
- Reveal pixel-art pictures and collect them in your Gallery
- Level up your profile and unlock dozens of avatars
- Climb the Game Center leaderboard
- Come back every day to claim your daily reward
WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Three games in one — match, clear, and solve in a single app
- No pop-up ads interrupting your play
- Simple to learn, genuinely hard to put down
- Calming, colorful design that's easy on the eyes
- Hints, undo, and power-ups for when you get stuck
- Perfect for quick breaks and long, cozy sessions
Whether you're a block puzzle veteran or just looking for a colorful way to relax, Color Block Match has a mode for every mood. Start matching, clearing, and solving today.

Start with three colors and unlock all nine as your score climbs — the longer you play, the richer it gets. Every block you clear also paints in a hidden pixel-art picture: finish one, hang it in your Gallery, and start revealing the next.

ADVENTURE — Limited-Time Block Events
The classic clear-the-lines block puzzle, reborn as a recurring event. Each adventure brings a fresh set of shaped levels: drop blocks, fill complete rows and columns to clear them, and finish the whole journey before the countdown runs out. Complete it and the fireworks are yours — then keep an eye out for the next adventure.

JIGSAW — Piece It Together
Dozens of hand-crafted shape puzzles — animals, objects, and little scenes built entirely from block pieces. Drag pieces from the tray and fit them into exactly the right spots to bring each picture to life. Easy to grasp, wonderfully satisfying to finish, and new puzzles arrive with every update.

MORE TO PLAY FOR
- Reveal pixel-art pictures and collect them in your Gallery
- Level up your profile and unlock dozens of avatars
- Climb the Game Center leaderboard
- Come back every day to claim your daily reward

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Three games in one — match, clear, and solve in a single app
- No pop-up ads interrupting your play
- Simple to learn, genuinely hard to put down
- Calming, colorful design that's easy on the eyes
- Hints, undo, and power-ups for when you get stuck
- Perfect for quick breaks and long, cozy sessions

Whether you're a block puzzle veteran or just looking for a colorful way to relax, Color Block Match has a mode for every mood. Start matching, clearing, and solving today.

bluejetty:00087243:ios.description:
◆ What makes HiddenVault different ◆
Unlike other iPhone vault apps and password managers, HiddenVault does not store, save, or access any of your personal data.
When using HiddenVault, your photos and videos are stored safely on your personal phone in your phones built in Apple ‘Folders’.
Meaning.. your private data never changes hands.. eliminating your risk from hackers or bad actors.
We give you that power without ever knowing your personal info ourselves—our system is built with Zero-Knowledge security architecture which means that all of your data is only ever available to you and you alone.
—————————————————————————————————
◆ How to use HiddenVault’s Private Photo Vault ◆
Save unlimited photos & videos in HiddenVault and organize them into custom albums, protected behind a PIN passcode and Face ID.
—————————————————————————————————
◆ How to use HiddenVault’s Password Manager Features ◆ 
Save unlimited passwords in HiddenVault and sign-in to apps and websites with just a single tap.
—————————————————————————————————
◆ How to use HiddenVault’s private web browser ◆
Anonymously surf the web on HiddenVault’s built-in private browser and save bookmarks in the app for easy access.
—————————————————————————————————
HiddenVault subscription policy
Once you sign up to HiddenVault Premium, you will have full access to all of HiddenVault’s features for free for 1 month.
You can cancel your subscription any time and you will be sent a reminder before your HiddenVault subscription begins after your trial.
HiddenVault Premium Subscription:
- With a HiddenVault Premium subscription you have access to store unlimited photos, videos, and passwords.
- HiddenVault Premium annual subscription is billed annually for $34.99, and payment will be charged to iTunes Account after a 30 day free trial.
- HiddenVault Premium monthly subscription is billed monthly for $7.99, and payment will be charged to iTunes Account after a 30 day free trial.
- HiddenVault Premium weekly subscription is billed weekly for $2.99, and payment will be charged to iTunes Account after a 30 day free trial.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user's iPhone Settings -> Apple ID -> Subscriptions.
—————————————————————————————————
Have a suggestion or feature you'd like to see added?
Send me an email at Kyle@KyleMitchellAllen and let me know - help us become the best vault app for iPhone!
Privacy Policy: https://hiddenvaultapp.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://hiddenvaultapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00168001:ios.description:
If you wish to relax after a long day at work or a long commute, playing with water and liquid is the most relaxing thing you can do! It’s proven that it helps with your well-being, it reduces your stress level and it calms you down. It’s almost like a therapeutic, ASMR experience but accessible directly on your mobile and completely free of charge. Are you ready to experience a brand new relaxing gaming experience with a Sort Liquid : Water Challenge ?
How to play:
- Tap on a bottle to pour its contents into another one, but remember, you can only pour water of the same color, and each bottle should contain only one color.
- A bottle can only contain a certain amount of water. When it’s full you cannot pour more water.
- No timer, no stress, take your time. 
Game Benefits:
- Exercise your brain and stimulate your cognitive abilities with this challenging and addictive free puzzle game.
- Immerse yourself into beautiful graphics and a world full of colors 
- Unwind after a long day by relieving stress & relax with an intuitive rewarding puzzle game
- Experience a sense of satisfaction and accomplishment as you successfully sort each level and witness the harmony of colors.
So why wait? Download our Sort Liquid : Water Challenge today and start playing! Whether you're looking to pass the time on your morning commute, unwind after a long day at work, or simply enjoy some relaxing gameplay, our game has everything you need to have a great time at home or on the go!.

- Exclusive limited-time events with rewards you won't find anywhere else

With Cozytouch, you can control your thermal comfort whenever and wherever you want !
With Cozytouch connected solutions, you can master your comfort at the touch of a button! Just one Cozytouch gateway per household is needed to control your heating, water heating and ventilation systems*. 
When linked to the Cozytouch gateway, the app lets you control your connected appliances: radiators, bathroom radiators, heat pumps, VMC, air conditioning, water heaters, zone control and interfaces.

Whether away at work or at home on the sofa, you can check the room temperature in your home, the amount of available hot water remaining and the indoor air quality. Use the information to adjust your settings for optimum comfort.

Save on energy costs by looking at each individual room to determine the amount of electricity used by your products per week, month and year.

Set your mind at ease when you leave home; Cozytouch lets you turn off your appliances from wherever you spend your weekends or holidays, as well as set the date and time of your return home. 
Thanks to the Cozytouch app, you can manage your comfort from anywhere and save money by optimising your energy use.
Simple and intuitive, Cozytouch is indispensable for saving money and adapting the comfort in your home to suit your needs and desires, also providing other useful information such as the weather and the air quality in your area.

bluejetty:00121878:ios.name: Precision Trolling
bluejetty:00121878:ios.summary: The fishing information contained in the popular publication Precision Trolling is a troller’s dream come true. Dubbed “the Troller’s Bible” by the tens of thousands of anglers who use this information to target fish at specific depths, Pre
bluejetty:00121878:ios.description:
The fishing information contained in the popular publication Precision Trolling is a troller’s dream come true. Dubbed “the Troller’s Bible” by the tens of thousands of anglers who use this information to target fish at specific depths, Precision Trolling is just what the name implies. Precision Trolling is a method of fishing that allows anglers to accurately predict the running depths of their favorite lures and diving devices!
By manipulating lead length anglers can easily “aim” their favorite fishing lures at specific depths, accurately target fish they are seeing on their sonar while avoiding costly snagged lures. Even better, once a productive lead length is determined, it’s easy to duplicate that lure and lead length combination with other lines, putting more lures in the strike zone!
The Precision Trolling Data App goes a step further. Once an angler has determined that a particular lure and lead length are effective at catching fish, it’s easy to search for other lures in the list of Precision Trolling App that achieve similar depths. Once a productive depth is determined where fish are biting, it’s a logical step to try different lures at the same depth to determine which lure or lures fish react best to.
The new Precision Trolling Data App allows anglers to access a wealth of trolling data. The familiar “Dive Curves” made popular in the Precision Trolling book are now incorporated into easy to use “pickers” or “wheels”. The Data Wheels let you adjust the “feet down” to determine the “feet back”. This is particularly useful if you want to target fish at a certain depth that you are seeing on your sonar unit. The Data Wheel also allows anglers to adjust the “feet back” to determine the “feet down” that the lure will dive. This a fast and effective way of zeroing in on a target depth with any of the lures or diving devices included in the Precision Trolling app. 
For more information on Precision Trolling and how to become a better troller click here: www.precisiontrollingdata.com
Precision Trolling Data LLC owns a patent U.S. Patent No. 7,113,449 entitled “Marine Electronics With Lure Depth Analyzer” issued September 26, 2006 which prevents other companies/individuals from providing lure data on an electronic device.
All of the data provided in or by this app is also copyrighted by Precision Trolling Data LLC.
Privacy Policy: https://www.precisiontrollingdata.com/privacy-notice
Terms Of service: https://www.precisiontrollingdata.com/end-user-license

bluejetty:00137332:ios.summary: Keep your family safe and connected with Smart Family Locator, the reliable and respectful GPS tracker designed for modern peace of mind. Our app provides a private, consent-based way to know your loved ones are safe, without the invasive f
bluejetty:00137332:ios.description:
Keep your family safe and connected with Smart Family Locator, the reliable and respectful GPS tracker designed for modern peace of mind. Our app provides a private, consent-based way to know your loved ones are safe, without the invasive feel of a "spy app."
From real-time GPS tracking on a private map to instant SOS alerts, we give you the tools you need to worry less and connect more.
KNOW THEY'RE SAFE WITH "PLACES" Stop wondering if they made it. Create custom "Safe Zones" or geofences for "Home," "School," or "Work". You'll get automatic alerts when your family members arrive or leave, so you'll always be in the know.
ESSENTIAL SAFETY FEATURES
SOS Alerts: In an emergency, a single tap on the SOS button sends an immediate alert to your family circle with a live location.
Battery Monitoring: See your family's battery level in a clear, simple list. No more panic when a phone suddenly goes offline—you'll know they just need to charge.
Location History: Gently check on their day. Review a detailed location history to see the routes they've taken.

bluejetty:00175000:ios.description:
WindAlert gives you the weather in your neighborhood, from observations onsite or right next door, get the most accurate wind speed and wind direction. With over 90,000 proprietary Tempest Weather Systems deployed, receive real-time local weather right where you are. Advanced forecasts provide the most accurate Nearcast predictions to our customers. Beyond our unmatched proprietary weather, we supplement with weather sources from government agencies including NOAA and NWS, and bring in reports from AWOS, ASOS, METAR, and even CWOP. Radar, forecast, and live wind map, along with customized point alerting are included to provide a broad view of the weather. 
Download WindAlert for:
- Neighborhood weather observations from proprietary Tempest Weather Systems along with all public domain reports (NOAA, NWS, METAR, ASOS, CWOP) including all major airports creating over 125,000 unique stations in one focused wind app.
- Our exclusive Tempest Weather Systems with haptic rain sensors, sonic anemometers, along with local barometric pressure sensors provide ground truth observations.
- Apple Watch compatibility
- Live wind from our stations support a better windy conditions flow map – augmented by current station reports with advanced quality control.
- Proprietary AI-enhanced Nearcast forecasting supplies enhanced forecasting for temperature, wind gust, speed, direction, humidity, dewpoint, precipitation rate, probability of precipitation, and cloud cover percentage.
- Multiple public domain forecast models including High Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR), North American Mesoscale Forecast System (NAM), Global Forecast System (GFS), Canadian Meteorological Centre Model (CMC) and Icosahedral Non Hydrostatic Model (ICON).
- Free subscription for unlimited wind notifications/alerts with customizable thresholds to email, text, or in-app.
- Advanced location management: create your own Favorite station list to keep a constant eye on your go-to weather stations.
- Maps: Live and Forecasted Wind Map, Forecasted Temperature, Radar, Satellite, Precipitation and Clouds, as well as Nautical Charts.
- Customized map visualization based on prioritizing impacted activities such as drone pilot, small aircraft, farming, running, dog walking, gardening, trucking, hauling, kayaking, surfing, you name it!
- National Weather Service (NWS) Marine Forecast
- All the additional weather parameters you want in a wind speed app:
 - Tides charts
 - Wave Height, Wave Period
 - Water Temperature
 - Sunrise / Sunset
 - Moonrise / Moonset
 - Historical Wind Statistics
 - Windy days per month based on average and gust
 - Wind direction distribution
Want more weather?
- Upgrade to plus, pro, or gold membership to gain access to more weather stations and forecast locations.
- Pro and Gold members have access to professional hurricane-proof weather stations in partnership with WeatherFlow Networks for high risk coastal locations. 
- Detailed weather at points of interest to coastal residents and property owners near the ocean, rivers, and other bodies of water.
- On the water features
 - Sea Surface Temperatures
 - Sea Surface Currents
 - Detailed Historical Wind Statistics
 - Historical wind statistics by year 
What else can you do?
 - Join the Tempest Weather Network!
 - Add a Tempest Weather System for your backyard.
 - Tempest observations can be displayed in the WindAlert application.
 - Share information with the broader community and increase the science record.

 - YouTube: @tempestwx
 - Instagram:tempest.earth
Contact us: help.weatherflow.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

Create Job Quotes as a Team
Multiple Users & Devices
Create and send professional job quotes instantly. Turn quotes into invoices with a single tap and close more business deals faster.
How It Works
* Enter your info
* Add customers manually or import from Contacts
* Add your products or services
You’ll be ready to create and send quotes in just minutes.
Flexibility
* Edit document titles (e.g. Quote → Quotation, Cita, Estimate)
* Customize subtitles (e.g. Billing address → Bill to, Signature → Approved by)
* Support for multiple currencies—manually enter your currency code
* Choose your preferred date format (e.g. 04/18/2014, 18/04/2014, 18/Apr/2014)
* Works offline
* Import or manually add contacts
* Set default or custom payment terms per customer (7 days default)
* Supports decimal hours or quantities
* Choose from five beautifully designed templates
* Swipe left to delete items (quotes, products, customers)
* Edit existing quotes at any time
* Add signature and date on the spot
* Fields like icons, notes, and comments will be hidden if left empty
* Preview quotes before sending
* Send quotes as PDFs or print wirelessly
* Export data as CSV
* Compatible with all languages
* Add custom background images
* Create up to 5 quotes for free
Professional Features
* Add your business registration name (e.g. ABN) and number
* Tax setup options (no tax, single tax, compound tax)
* Apply discounts (fixed amount or percentage)
* Define payment terms (Immediate, 7 days, up to 180 days)
* Add your company logo to quotes
Mobility
* Send quotes directly from iPhone or iPad
* Keep your quoting system in your pocket

The subscription version includes cloud sync and backup so you can store and access all your data across multiple iOS devices.

bluejetty:00161644:ios.description:
Your plans in order. Your ideas close at hand.
Keep appointments, tasks and notes together, with Hijri and Gregorian calendars, reminders you can customize and a countdown to your upcoming events. All without ads.
From work appointments to personal occasions and everyday to-dos, organize what matters to you.
• Hijri and Gregorian calendars
View dates in either calendar or both, and browse your appointments in a list or calendar view.
• Quick to add, easy to build on
Start with a title and time, then add photos, voice notes, details and a checklist to keep everything you need with the event.
• Reminders that fit your routine
Choose when to be reminded and which sound to hear. Set recurring events and check how much time is left.
• Your categories, your colors
Create categories for work, family, special occasions and more. Give each a color so your plans are easier to find.
• A place for notes and ideas
Save notes without setting a date. Add photos and colors, and search by title or content.
• Your schedule on the Home Screen
See upcoming appointments and time remaining in widgets. Tap an event to open its details.
• Share plans and add them to your calendar
Share events and notes through WhatsApp or your device’s sharing options. Add appointments to your device’s calendar.
• Keep past events within reach
Choose when ended events move to the archive. Keep your main view organized without deleting your history.
• Make it feel like yours
Choose light or dark mode, text size, time format and reminder sound. Available in Arabic, English and French, with layouts for iPhone and iPad.
Start as a guest to keep your events and notes on your device, or sign in to sync them across your devices.
Add your first event and bring a little more order to your day.

bluejetty:00069679:ios.description:
Ever wonder which songs, artists, and albums you keep coming back to?
Statiks helps you look back at the music you play every day. See the tracks you keep coming back to, the artists that shape your weeks, and the albums that stay in your rotation longer than you expected.
Connect your Spotify account to explore your top tracks, artists, and albums across different time ranges. Check what you played recently, open songs and artists in Spotify, and turn your current top tracks into a playlist.
Statiks is made for the little moments music people care about: finding out which song owned your month, noticing an artist slowly climb your rankings, or sharing the five tracks that defined a stretch of your life.
With Statiks Plus, you can go deeper into your listening history. Import your Spotify Streaming History, and once the import is complete, Statiks unlocks long-term stats based on your full Spotify history.
Statiks Plus includes:
- Stream counts and listening time
- Long-term trends and timelines
- Listening patterns by day and time
- Profile stats and listening streaks
- Top 100 lists for tracks and artists
- Deeper detail pages for tracks, artists, and albums
You can also create share cards for your top music, save them to your gallery, or prepare them for an Instagram Story.
Statiks is for people who do not just listen to music, but like remembering what they listened to, when they found it, and what kept pulling them back.
Privacy Policy: https://statiks.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://statiks.app/terms

bluejetty:00083315:ios.description:
NO NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Everyone is welcome to try Red Light, Green Light, Dalgona and more.
You win some, you die some. Use skill and killer instinct to survive twisted competitions in this multiplayer action game inspired by the hit series.
Prepare for fast, heart-pounding action and brutal competition in this multiplayer battle royale game. Play Red Light, Green Light or Glass Bridge — and more iconic games from the series — with friends (or enemies) online. See if you have what it takes to outlast and defeat all the other players in each twisted contest.
With deadly challenges you'll recognize from all three seasons of "Squid Game" and more new games inspired by classic childhood activities, each round is a dark trip down memory lane. Can you make it through playtime alive?
NEW UPDATES FOR SEASON 3: 
• Try out three completely new game types, from a deadly Hide & Seek labyrinth to a sky-high version of Squid Game — plus new characters and weapons.
• Frenemies forever: Form a regular Crew of players to collaborate and compete together. Use new chat features to hang out and talk strategy with other players.
• Netflix members can unlock new content and earn unique Play-Along rewards in the game by watching episodes of "Squid Game" Season 3.
BRING "SQUID GAME" TO LIFE
• Find out how long you'd survive as a "Squid Game" contestant by playing Red Light, Green Light, Glass Bridge, Dalgona and more lethal games.
• Use special items to gain a competitive edge. Get a boost from dalgona candy or stun someone with a well-aimed dodgeball.
• Are you a natural Front Man, or more of a Geum-ja? Choose the perfect character and express yourself in this online battle royale with a huge range of outfits, animations and emoji reactions.
NO-MERCY MULTIPLAYER MAYHEM
• Play with up to 32 of your friends in Party mode and team up against online opponents in each multiplayer tournament — but always be prepared for betrayal.
• Fast online multiplayer matchmaking brings you into each round of the battle royale in seconds.
• Die early, but want to see who survives? Spectator mode lets your ghostly presence stay and watch the next round of Red Light, Green Light unfold.
THE ONLY WAY OUT IS UP
• Climb the Squid Ladder as you compete in multiplayer contests and complete challenges, unlocking new games and features as your rank rises.
• Spend hard-won (virtual) cash and tokens to collect new characters, outfits and more rewards that will let you strut your stuff in the arena.
• Keep your survival skills sharp with special events inspired by whatever's new in the "Squid Game" universe.
- Created by Boss Fight, a Netflix Game Studio.

Win the battles and earn rewards by strategically positioning and upgrading obst
bluejetty:00135580:ios.description:
"Defend against enemies rushing through the house!
Monster House is an easy and simple defense game to defeat enemies by placing traps and monsters in houses.
Win the battles and earn rewards by strategically positioning and upgrading obstacles! 
Monster game requires strategic plays but also with some element of luck, is designed as an immersive and an enjoyable game to play.
Show off your own play styles by combining various types of traps and monsters with different performance levels.
Monster house features
Strategic play style by deploying various traps 
Strategically place various types of traps such as beds, dinosaur bones, ghosts, carpets and more! 
It's fun to watch the results of the play by observing and taking consideration of the enemy's paths, trap locations, and trap properties! 
Various Monster Objects
Monsters in our Monster games have a variety of characteristics/strengths/attributes such as how they are placed, attack ranges, and damage ranges.
Target the monsters using their characteristics and efficiently defend your enemies! 
You can feel the excitement of destroying your enemies with the strategy deployed by yourself. 
Create a powerful monster
Collect card pieces and level up to strengthen your monster!
By merging monsters you can create more powerful monsters.
Challenge yourself on the Monster games World map mode. 
Try the World Map Mode and fight your enemy at the Houses of the World!
Clear the map to acquire monster cards and draw monster cards from the collection to achieve a new monster.
As you learn from playing the game, you will experience the fun and intense immersion that comes from strategic choices you make. 
Play the monster house defense game with your defense strategy!
See you in monster house now!"

bluejetty:00162325:ios.description:
تطبيق خطواتي - تطبيق لحساب الخطوات والسعرات الحرارية بكل دقة، تعرف على المزيد حول نشاطك اليومي وعدد الخطوات والسعرات الحرارية والمسافات التي تمشيها كل يوم. كما يساعدك تطبيق خطواتي على معرفة كل الأنشطة التي تقوم بها وما هي السعرات الحرارية التي تستهلكها كل يوم. من خلال التطبيق يمكنك التخطيط للوجبات اليومية التي يحتاجها جسمك سواء كانت ترغب في إنقاص أو زيادة أو المحافظة على وزنك. ويحتوي التطبيق أيضًا على قائمة بالوجبات الأكثر شيوعًا مصنفة إلى مجموعات مع معلومات عن كل وجبة من حيث عدد السعرات الحرارية والبروتينات والكربوهيدرات والدهون التي تحتوي عليها. يساعدك التطبيق على معرفة الوزن المثالي والطول والسعرات الحرارية التي يحتاجها جسمك يوميا.
تطبيق حارق لحساب الخطوات والسعرات والتمارين الرياضية والرجيم يوفر لكم الخدمات التالية:
1- حساب السعرات الحرارية بكل دقة.
2- حساب الخطوات اليومية والشهرية.
3- حساب السعرات اللازمة لانقاص الوزن.
3- حساب كتلة الجسم.
4- حساب الوزن المثالي.
5- حساب احتياج الماء اليومي.
6- حساب النوم الصحي.
7- حساب وقت النوم المناسب صحيا.
8- تمارين منزلية لحرق السعرات.
9- تقارير مميزة عن جميع انشطتكم.
10- حساب السعرات الحرارية في الطعام.
11- تطبيق خطواتي متوفر لساعة ابل.
12- ودجت لعرض الخطوات والسعرات
تطبيق حارق - خطوات وسعرات يعتمد على البيانات الواردة من تطبيق صحتي لمتابعة خطواتك والمسافات المقطوعة والطوابق بالإضافة الى البيانات التاريخية.
The Khatwati App - An application that calculates steps and calories with accuracy, learn more about your daily activity, the number of steps, calories and distances you walk each day. The App also helps you to know all the activities you do and what calories you consume every day. Through the application, you can plan the daily meals that your body needs, whether you want to lose, increase or maintain your weight. The app also contains a list of the most popular meals categorized into groups with information on each meal in terms of the number of calories, proteins, carbohydrates and fats it contains. The application helps you to know the ideal weight, height and calories that your body needs daily.
Services provided by the application:
1- Accurately count calories.
2- Calculating daily and monthly steps.
3- Calculate the calories needed to lose weight.
3- Calculation of body mass.
4- Calculating the ideal weight.
5- Calculate the daily water requirement.
6- Calculating healthy sleep.
7- Calculate a healthy sleep time.
8- Home exercises to burn calories.
9- Distinguished reports on all your activities.
The App- Steps and Calories Application integrates with HealthKit APIs to track your steps, distance، flights climbed and to show you more history.

bluejetty:00031973:android.description:
Embark on an enchanting journey in manor renovation. 
This game offers a unique twist with its manor renovation element, where each successful puzzle challenge unlocks new opportunities to decorate and restore a grand manor. Dive into a world of intricate tile matching, where each level presents a challenging puzzle to solve. Your goal is to match tiles in groups of three, testing your skills and training your brain.
As you progress, discover various rooms and areas of the manor, each requiring your creative touch. The game features various themes and styles, giving you the freedom to personalize your manor. But the journey is not just about decoration; it's a puzzle adventure, with each tile match bringing you closer to unveiling the manor's hidden secrets.
Key Features:
-- Combine the joy of mahjong and the excitement of triple-match puzzles.
-- Engage in challenging and strategic tile-matching gameplay.
-- Renovate and decorate a manor with your unique style.
-- Unveil hidden stories and secrets as you progress.
-- Enjoy a blend of relaxation and brain training in each level.
"Manor Match" is not just a game; it's a journey of puzzle-solving, creativity, and discovery. Get ready to challenge your mind and unleash your interior design skills!

Please note: To use Lace Pro, you need to be registered with an Audiologist professional.

bluejetty:00024162:ios.description:
Play Parchis Club - The World`s #1 loved Parchis board game to play with friends, family and online players worldwide.
Parchis Club is the free online multiplayer version of the epic hit dice game Parchis (featuring variations like Ludo, Ludo Parchis, Parchis Ludo, Parchisi, and Parcheesi). Join an exclusive club of pro players in this multiplayer adventure—roll the dice, move your tokens, beat your opponents, and reach home to win the game!
When it comes to lively, colorful board games, Parchis Club is second to none! Master the art of moving your red, yellow, green, or blue pieces with strategy and luck on the most stunning Parchis boards. Compete against top players worldwide and climb the leaderboard! This fast-paced, dice-based game combines luck and skill, just like Ludo, Parchis, and Parcheesi. Become a champion and claim your title as a star!
Parchisi Club has several exciting features!
◆ Play with Friends and Family: Roll the dice and enjoy the Parchis game together.
◆ Low Data Usage: Runs smoothly on 2G, 3G, and 4G networks. Enjoy this colorful board game without worrying about data usage!
◆ Offline Mode: Play solo or against the computer when you're offline.
◆ Chat While You Play: Interact with your buddies in real time as you play on the game board. If you’ve already played Ludo with friends, Parchis Club will be a breeze!
◆ Flexible Gameplay: Choose between 2-player games for quick fun or 4-player matches for a more competitive experience.
◆ Completely Free: Win coins daily with the Daily Bonus feature so you never run out!
Looking for hours of non-stop fun on your phone? Install Parchis Club today and enjoy everyone’s favorite childhood board game, reimagined for the digital age. Developed by the creators of globally loved games like Ludo Club, this Parchis game features striking visuals, vibrant colors, and beautifully designed boards and dice for your phone's HD display.
Play this exciting variation of Ludo, make friends, become a star, and dive into the colorful world of Parchis Club!
What are you waiting for? Let’s roll the dice!

bluejetty:00149082:ios.description:
Reach your wellbeing goals while boosting your long-term wholistic* health. At Roundglass Living, we create a daily routine filled with affirmations, expert-led practices, and behavioral science tools just for you to help you build healthy habits. Whether you want to reduce stress, improve sleep, eat
healthier, or enhance daily performance, we’ll guide you every step of the way.
Our practices range from 30 seconds to 30 minutes, making it easy to fit mindfulness into your day. Discover breathwork sessions, guided meditations, yoga classes, healthy recipes, and relaxing sleep music, all developed by world-renowned experts.
Follow your structured daily plan and stay engaged with tools like reminders, timers, mood check-ins, and progress tracking. Living Previews, quick video introductions, give you a feel for each practice and help you discover what resonates.
Roundglass Living is built on our belief in democratizing wholistic wellbeing, making it accessible to everyone regardless of background or means. It’s free to download and use, and designed for a wide range of people, including students, professionals, athletes, and families, who are seeking meaningful ways to support their wellbeing.
If you’ve received a code from your employer, school, or university, you can use it in the app to unlock additional features as part of your organization’s wellbeing program.
We spell “wholistic” with a “w” to reflect our belief that true wellbeing addresses the whole person to create health and synergy in all aspects of their life.
OVERVIEW
• A daily plan curated for your wellbeing goals
• Expert-led practices for any level
• The best of breathwork and meditation sessions, yoga courses, plant-based healthy recipes, and sleep music
• Behavioral science tools, like reminders, timers, progress stats, mood tracker, and group challenges
FEATURES
Behavioral science tools
• Mood tracker for emotional awareness
• Timers to stay on task
• Dashboard for progress tracking
• Reminders for healthy habits
PRACTICES BACKED BY NEUROSCIENCE
Breathwork
• Breathwork classes for any level
• Proven techniques for better sleep, anxiety relief, and increased energy
Guided meditation
• Mindfulness for real-world challenges
• Practices for coping with stress, increasing focus, and managing emotions like anger and loneliness
• Guided meditation for sleep
• Custom timers with relaxing music for meditation
Yoga and mindful movement
• Yoga practices to support physical and mental health
• Sessions for sleep, energy, and relaxation
• Asanas for flexibility or targeted tension relief
• Styles like vinyasa, yoga nidra, and restorative
Healthy eating
• Recipes and cooking courses with plant-based ingredients
• Guidance for healthy eating habits
Music
• Relaxing meditation music: chanting, chimes, nature sounds, and music for sleep
• Wellbeing music for stress relief: binaural beats and colored noise
• Mindfulness music albums and original music by award-winning artists
DAILY ROUTINES FOR LIFELONG HABITS
Better sleep
• Sleep meditation practices for insomnia and anxiety relief
• Relaxing sleep stories to invite deep rest
• Bedtime breathwork and habits for a calming nightly routine
Stress relief
• Breathwork classes to ease tension
• Mindful movement practices to aid emotional resilience and mental health
• Guided meditations and daily habits to lower stress
Roundglass Living is more than a meditation app or yoga app. We’re here to support the whole you.
For additional support, email support@roundglass.com.
Privacy Policy: https://roundglass.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://roundglass.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00062064:ios.name: Chess King - Learn to Play
bluejetty:00062064:ios.summary:
Don't just play chess. Train like a master.
Chess King teaches the game the way strong players are actually built — with a rigorous, structured curriculum, not a random feed of puzzles. 147 complete courses take you from your first move to
bluejetty:00062064:ios.description:
Don't just play chess. Train like a master.
Chess King teaches the game the way strong players are actually built — with a rigorous, structured curriculum, not a random feed of puzzles. 147 complete courses take you from your first move to advanced play, step by step.
WHY CHESS KING IS DIFFERENT
Most chess apps let you play. Chess King trains you. Every course is a real lesson built on classical training methods refined over 30 years — the same approach behind CT-ART, the tactics trainer used by serious players worldwide.
You don't just solve a position and move on. Chess King gives you hints when you are stuck, explains the idea behind the right move, and shows you the striking refutation of the mistakes you might make. That is how understanding is built — not memorized.
WHAT YOU GET
- 147 structured courses covering tactics, strategy, openings, the middlegame, and endgames, organized by level from beginner to master.
- Chess King University: 7 guided learning paths and 44 courses that give you a clear, ordered route to real improvement — no guessing what to study next.
- Interactive theory: read the lesson, then play the moves on the board yourself. Learning by doing, not just reading.
- Thousands of carefully selected exercises with graphic hints and full explanations.
- Play against the computer to put what you have trained into practice.
- A progress report for every lesson, so you always see how far you have come.
TRAIN ON EVERY DEVICE
Your subscription, purchases, progress, and rating sync automatically across web, iPhone, iPad, and Android. Train on your phone on the commute, continue on the web at home — your progress follows you.
TRY IT FREE
Preview courses before you commit. When you are ready, choose a monthly or yearly plan, or buy individual courses to keep forever.
Chess King — train like a master.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Feel the adrenaline rush as you control every movement and cut down trees with precision and power.
Efficiency and Progress

Power-ups are at your disposal, enabling you to cut trees more efficiently and rapidly collect the scattered logs with your dozer. Each log you collect is a step toward building your lumber empire.
From Logs to Luxury: Your Sawmill Journey
As a budding lumber tycoon, your journey doesn't stop at felling trees. "Mega Harvester: Lumber Factory" offers you the chance to establish a lucrative sawmill business. Unlock the advanced timber machine, turning raw timber into valuable building materials to construct houses. The more houses you build, the greater your lumber empire becomes.
Machinery at Your Fingertips
An efficient lumber operation requires top-notch equipment. Build a garage to improve your machinery and increase efficiency. The better your equipment, the faster you can process timber, and the more you can sell. Your success depends on smart investments and upgrades.
Deliver Timber with Style
As your sawmill business flourishes, you'll want to ensure a smooth flow of products to your customers. Build a boat to transport your timber deliveries with style. Efficient transportation means satisfied customers, and satisfied customers mean more profit for your growing lumber empire.
A Clicker Game with Endless Possibilities
"Mega Harvester: Lumber Factory" combines the addictive clicker game mechanic with engaging gameplay. Click your way to success as you cut, collect, and build. Your journey in this immersive world of wood cutting and woodworking is only beginning.
Endless Harvest, Infinite Fun
With a focus on idle lumber and wood harvest, "Mega Harvester: Lumber Factory" offers endless entertainment. 
Get ready to embark on the ultimate logging adventure, become a master lumberjack, and craft your very own lumber empire. bluejetty:00089140:ios.description:
Caria helps you have a healthier, easier menopause. Use Caria to track and manage your symptoms, get personalized health insights, and connect with other women on a similar journey. 
Caria guides you through your personalized journey and helps understand the changes causes by menopause, as well as manage your symptoms. Developed with health and wellness experts specializing in women's health, Caria provides evidence-based approaches for managing menopause including cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), nutritional therapy, mindfulness, and fitness. 
Here's what you get with Caria:
Health Tracking
- Log your symptoms and daily activities to track your health
- Use Siri Shortcuts to log easily with your voice
- Check your daily symptom score to assess your health today and over the week
- Complete your daily health goals to improve your score over time
Community
- Join discussions, share your questions, get advice, and find inspiration from other women who're on the same journey as you
- See product and treatment recommendations by other women on a similar journey 
Courses 
- Find tailored recipes and meal plans developed by expert nutritionists to manage your symptoms
- Access audio courses designed to help you relieve you symptoms 
- Learn how to use research-backed approaches like mindfulness and cognitive behavioral techniques to overcome your symptoms
Insights
- Get personalized health tips and recommendations based on your logs
- Learn about important patterns in your health to help you manage your symptoms
Quick Relief
- Access quick, evidence-based audio exercises to get relief whenever you're having hot flashes, insomnia, and other symptoms
Caria Premium
- Access unlimited expert-created programs for symptom management with purchase of an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase for $49.99/year or $9.99/month (local prices may vary)
- Subscription automatically renews unless it is cancelled at least 24h before the renewal date
- Your Apple ID will be charged for renewal within 24h prior to the end of the current period
- You can manage or turn off auto-renew by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase
- Read more about our Terms: hellocaria.com/terms and Privacy Policy: hellocaria.com/privacy
Caria is not a replacement for professional medical help - you should consult your doctor for medical advice on any symptoms or health concerns.

Open up "Pippi World :Princess Avatar" unlock different locations, dress up various styles and sizes of princesses and princes, and interact wi
bluejetty:00081626:ios.description:
Explore and experience the fun and super cute world of the Dream Ice Castle with Princess Pippi!
Open up "Pippi World :Princess Avatar" unlock different locations, dress up various styles and sizes of princesses and princes, and interact with countless items, furniture, and characters. Step into this mystical world and create your own princess story in the magnificent, dreamy castle!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A Day in the Life of a Princess
Ever wondered what it's like to live as a princess? Wake up in a luxurious princess bed, take a bath in an elegant tub, shop at your exclusive boutique, then enjoy afternoon tea at the dessert shop... In this beautiful ice world, you are the star! You can do anything you want, with no limits or restrictions, and the adventure never ends! Dive into this vast and mysterious world with your friends and family!
Create New Characters
Unleash your endless imagination and create any character you like! Choose from hundreds of unique facial features, outfits, hairstyles, accessories, jewelry, and wings, make up and makeover to make them one-of-a-kind! Do you prefer a character that's elegant, glamorous, cute, or quirky? Or maybe stylish, handsome, or even wacky? Your creativity brings them to life, giving each character a unique personality and charm!
Of course, the characters you create can also experience all the activities in Pippi World! They can interact with all the items, explore every location, and discover the magic and surprises hidden around every corner. Make your mark in this world by leaving unique footprints of your adventures!
Explore Everything
Create unique interactive stories! You can be a princess or even the hairstylist at the salon – why not? It's all up to you!
Find all the hidden plots and Easter eggs! Where's the key to the treasure chest? What cute things will hatch from the eggs? Dive into the game and explore!
Solve all the puzzles! Clues on the notes will guide you – but where are the notes? I'm sure you can find them!
And what else is special? That's for you to discover when you enter Pippi World!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"Pippi World :Princess Avatar" isn't just a regular dress up games, princess games, or doll games. In this rich virtual world, players can develop important skills like creativity, exploration, imagination, and design, as well as problem-solving abilities in real life! Download "Pippi World :Princess Avatar" now, and create your own princess story in this adorable game!

bluejetty:00147583:android.description:
OKash makes it efficient for you to access credit anytime, anywhere. 🎉🎉🎉
💸Loan Products
Tenure: We will require your repayment from 91 days to 365 days*.
Loan Amount: from NGN 3,000 to NGN2,000,000.
Interest Rate: With a minimum of 3% up to 15% monthly
Our interest rate is calculated on a daily basis. Annual Percentage Rate(APR) from 36.5% to 360%.
💸An example of a OKash loan
For example, 91-day loan payment terms，the interest is 9.1%. For the loan processed with a principal amount of NGN 3,000, the interest would be NGN 273, the total amount due would be NGN 3,237.The total amount due in the first month would be N1,093, the interest would be N93, the total amount due in the second month would be N1,090, the interest would be N90, the total amount due in the third month would be N1,090, the interest would be N90.
🚀OKash is a Convenient Personal Loan Platform for Nigeria mobile users. Presented by OPay Microfinance Bank Limited, duly licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria(CBN). 
OKash fulfills customers’ financial needs 7*24 completely online. The application process takes just a few steps with minimal documentation and the approved loan amount is transferred to the applicant’s bank account. 
🚀Why OKash?
1.You can apply a loan by your credit. Don't need any deposits or guarantees.
2. Up to NGN2,000,000. Disburse to your bank account.
3.Paperless and digital process on your mobile. All the steps can be done online.
4.We do not share your data with any third parties without your consent. Your data is totally safe with us.
5.Don't worry about forgetting repayment. We'll send messages to remind you.
💡How it works？
1. Install the OKash APP from the Play Store.
2. Register an account.
3. Select the product you would like to apply for.
4. Fill out your basic information, then submit the application.
5. After the submission, you may receive a call for verification. The final application result will be shown in the APP and you will be informed by SMS if approved.
6. E-sign the loan agreement after the approval.
7. After the E-sign, the approved loan amount will be disbursed into your account shortly and a SMS notification will be sent.
Eligibility:
1. Nigeria Resident.
2. 20-55 years old.
3. Source of a monthly income.
📞Contact Us
Customer Service Email: okash@opaymfb.com
Customer Service Hotline: 02018884549/07001235051
Address: 6 Adeniyi Jones, Ikeja, Lagos. Nigeria
*Please note we will give you several options for you to select when do you want to repay the loan.
OKash will NOT ask you repay into personal account!

bluejetty:00161560:ios.description:
Dandapani is a Hindu priest, speaker on self-development, former Hindu monk of ten years and an entrepreneur who teaches simple, practical life-changing courses on Focus & Meditation. The Dandapani App is a custom-built app designed to give you the best learning experience and to empower you with spiritual tools and teachings delivered via in-app courses to help you live a life of purpose and joy.
The Unwavering Focus course is a simple, practical life-changing in-app course outlining a step-by-step and goal-orientated approach to learning how to concentrate. Empower yourself with tools and teachings to handle and overcome worry, fear, anxiety, and stress and start living a life focused on purpose and joy. 
The Introduction to Meditation course is a simple, practical in-app meditation course sharing tools, techniques, and teachings to unlock your greatest potential. Learn to define your meditation goal, outline the path to it, and create a sustainable practice that eventually brings forth insights, the discovery of life’s purpose and spiritual unfoldment.
Since Dandapani released his Introduction to Meditation course in 2015 thousands of students from more than 150 countries around the world have gone through this training.
WHAT YOU’LL GET:
– Courses: Simple, practical life-changing courses on Focus & Meditation
– RItuals: Our custom-built rituals feature designed to help you sustain change by allowing you to create your own daily practices and track your progress.
– In-app Notes: Take and save notes of your course learnings in-app and download them anytime in rich-text or PDF format. 
– Journal: Downloadable morning and nightly journal for your daily reflections and cultivating gratitude and selflessness. 
– Quotes: Daily insightful quotes from Dandapani and inspirational photography highlighting the beautiful planet we live on. 
– Audio talks: Listen to an array of audio talks by Dandapani covering spirituality, life, energy, reincarnation, karma and more. 
– Videos: Watch a vast collection of videos of Dandapani’s talks, interviews and more.
Privacy Policy:
https://app.dandapani.org/privacy-policy
Terms of Use:
https://dandapani.org/terms-and-conditions/

- Private responses
- No public profiles
- No social feed
- Clear privacy controls

bluejetty:00088969:ios.description:
EDUS es la aplicación oficial de salud de la Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social que te permitirá tener acceso desde tu dispositivo inteligente a información relevante de tu Expediente Digital Único en Salud (EDUS).
Tendrá acceso a consultar y gestionar sus datos personales, citas médicas personales y las de sus dependientes en el establecimiento de salud adscrito, validar el derecho a la atención en salud, medicamentos prescritos, diagnósticos y alergias, entre otros datos.
También puede contar con su información relacionada al régimen de Pensiones del IVM, donde, si es cotizante podrá contar con su proyección de pensión, su estado de aportaciones y en caso de ser pensionado tendrá información importante asociada a su pensión, y en ambos casos, si cuenta con una línea crediticia con el régimen IVM podrá tener la información de la operación.
Mediante esta aplicación puede registrar de manera manual y automática los signos vitales, resultados y medidas corporales, además si le otorga los permisos requeridos, puede integrar el app con la aplicación de Apple Health de su teléfono, con lo cual los datos registrados en Apple Health y que estén acordes a los disponibles en la funcionalidad de registro de signos de la app pasarán a ser registrados en la aplicación, para que posteriormente estos cómo los registrados manualmente puedan ser sincronizados y enviados a la CCSS para ser vistos por un profesional en salud a través del EDUS.
Así mismo la aplicación se mantiene en continua mejora, con la finalidad de agregar nuevas funcionalidades.
¿Qué se requiere para poder utilizar la App?
Se requiere una cuenta que puede ser creada directamente en la app a través del botón “Registrarse” que se encuentra en la pantalla inicial o bien realizar el mismo proceso en la página de Solicitud de citas por Internet disponible en la web Institucional (https://edus.ccss.sa.cr/eduscitasweb/). Quienes ya posean una cuenta para gestionar citas en la web podrán utilizar esa misma cuenta para la app.
¿Qué se requiere para crear una cuenta?
El App podrá ser utilizado por todos aquellas personas adscritas que tengan un correo registrado en la institución, de no tener un correo registrado deberá presentarse al establecimiento de salud para actualizar sus datos.
¿Mis datos pueden ser vistos por otras personas sin mi autorización desde el App?
Sus datos sólo pueden ser vistos en el app haciendo uso de la respectiva cuenta de usuario y su contraseña, razón por la cual, usted debe velar por la privacidad de su contraseña y no facilitarla a nadie. Adicionalmente, permite gestionar las citas de sus dependientes autorizados.
